<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Source;

use PhpToken;

/**
 * Finds the class-likes, methods, functions and properties a PHP file declares.
 *
 * Bodies of methods and functions are skipped, so closures and classes inside
 * them are not reported; anonymous classes are skipped as well.
 */
final class DeclarationScanner
{
    /**
     * The modifiers that may precede a declaration keyword.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    private const MODIFIERS = ['public', 'protected', 'private', 'static', 'abstract', 'final', 'readonly', 'var'];

    /**
     * Returns every declaration in source order.
     *
     * @return list<Declaration>
     */
    public function scan(Tokens $tokens): array
    {
        $declarations = [];
        $namespace = '';
        $owners = [];
        $index = 0;
        while ($index < $tokens->count()) {
            $token = $tokens->at($index);
            $owner = $owners === [] ? null : $owners[count($owners) - 1];
            if ($token->is(T_NAMESPACE)) {
                $namespace = $this->namespaceName($tokens, $index);
            } elseif ($this->isClassLikeKeyword($tokens, $index)) {
                $declaration = $this->classLike($tokens, $index, $namespace, $owner['name'] ?? null);
                $declarations[] = $declaration;
                $owners[] = ['name' => $declaration->name, 'end' => $declaration->end];
                $index = $tokens->find($index, ['{']) ?? $declaration->end;
            } elseif ($token->is(T_FUNCTION) && $this->isNamedFunction($tokens, $index)) {
                $declaration = $this->function($tokens, $index, $namespace, $owner['name'] ?? null);
                $declarations[] = $declaration;
                $index = $declaration->end;
            } elseif ($owner !== null && $this->startsProperty($tokens, $index)) {
                $declaration = $this->property($tokens, $index, $namespace, $owner['name']);
                $declarations[] = $declaration;
                $index = $declaration->end;
            } elseif ($owner !== null && $index === $owner['end']) {
                array_pop($owners);
            }
            ++$index;
        }

        return $declarations;
    }

    /**
     * Reads the name after a namespace keyword, or an empty string for the global namespace block.
     */
    public function namespaceName(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        if ($next === null || !$tokens->at($next)->is([T_STRING, T_NAME_QUALIFIED])) {
            return '';
        }

        return $tokens->at($next)->text;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether the token at an index is the keyword of a named class, interface, trait or enum declaration.
     */
    public function isClassLikeKeyword(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $token = $tokens->at($index);
        $keyword = strtolower($token->text);
        if (!in_array($keyword, ['class', 'interface', 'trait', 'enum'], true) || !$token->is([T_CLASS, T_INTERFACE, T_TRAIT, T_STRING]) && !$token->is($keyword === 'enum' ? [T_STRING] : [])) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($keyword === 'enum' && !$token->is(T_STRING) && $token->getTokenName() !== 'T_ENUM') {
            return false;
        }
        $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($index);
        if ($previous !== null && $tokens->at($previous)->is([T_NEW, T_DOUBLE_COLON])) {
            return false;
        }
        $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($index);

        return $next !== null && $tokens->at($next)->is(T_STRING) && $this->followsClassName($tokens, $next);
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether the token after a class-like name is one that may follow it: a brace, extends, implements or an enum backing type.
     */
    public function followsClassName(Tokens $tokens, int $nameIndex): bool
    {
        $after = $tokens->nextSignificant($nameIndex);
        if ($after === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $token = $tokens->at($after);

        return $token->text === '{' || $token->text === ':' || $token->is([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS]);
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a function keyword starts a named function or method rather than a closure.
     */
    public function isNamedFunction(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        if ($next !== null && $tokens->at($next)->text === '&') {

        }

        return $next !== null && $tokens->at($next)->is(T_STRING);
    }

            return false;
        }

            if ($tokens->at($i)->is([T_FUNCTION, T_CONST, T_CASE, T_USE])) {

            }

     */
    public function function(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $namespace, ?string $owner): Declaration
    {
        $nameIndex = (int) $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        if ($tokens->at($nameIndex)->text === '&') {

        }

        $end = $tokens->at($bodyStart)->text === '{' ? $tokens->closing($bodyStart) : $bodyStart;
        $start = $this->declarationStart($tokens, $index);

        return new Declaration($owner === null ? 'function' : 'method', $tokens->at($nameIndex)->text, $namespace, $owner, $this->docStart($tokens, $start), $start, (int) $tokens->previousSignificant($bodyStart), $end, $this->modifiers($tokens, $start, $index));
    }

    /**
     * Describes the property declaration whose first modifier is at an index.
     */
    public function property(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $namespace, string $owner): Declaration
    {
        $end = (int) $tokens->find($index, [';']);
        $variable = $index;
        for ($i = $index; $i < $end; ++$i) {
            if ($tokens->at($i)->is(T_VARIABLE)) {
                $variable = $i;
                break;
            }
        }

        return new Declaration('property', ltrim($tokens->at($variable)->text, '$'), $namespace, $owner, $this->docStart($tokens, $index), $index, $end, $end, $this->modifiers($tokens, $index, $variable));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the first modifier before a declaration keyword, or the keyword index itself.
     */
    public function declarationStart(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $start = $index;
        $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($index);
        while ($previous !== null && in_array(strtolower($tokens->at($previous)->text), self::MODIFIERS, true)) {
            $start = $previous;
            $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($previous);
        }

        return $start;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the docblock directly above a declaration start, or the start itself.
     */
    public function docStart(Tokens $tokens, int $start): int
    {
        for ($i = $start - 1; $i >= 0; --$i) {
            $token = $tokens->at($i);
            if ($token->is(T_DOC_COMMENT)) {
                return $i;
            }
            if (!$token->is(T_WHITESPACE)) {
                return $start;
            }
        }

        return $start;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the lower-case modifier keywords between two indexes.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function modifiers(Tokens $tokens, int $from, int $to): array
    {
        $modifiers = [];
        for ($i = $from; $i < $to; ++$i) {

            }

    }

     * Tells whether a token is a PHP 8.1 enum keyword, which PHP 8.0 tokenizes as a plain string.
     */
    public function isEnumKeyword(PhpToken $token): bool
    {
        return strtolower($token->text) === 'enum' && ($token->is(T_STRING) || $token->getTokenName() === 'T_ENUM');
    }

/**
 * Fills `{name}` placeholders in rule instructions, messages and fixes.
 */
final class Template
{
    /**
     * The placeholders every template may use, filled from the target, the rule and the answer.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    public const PLACEHOLDERS = [
        'file', 'line', 'column', 'kind', 'name', 'class', 'namespace', 'qualified_name', 'signature', 'visibility',
        'rule', 'answer', 'probability', 'confidence', 'choice', 'score', 'threshold',
    ];

    /**
     * Returns the placeholder names a template uses, in order of first appearance.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function placeholders(string $template): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/\{([a-z_]+)\}/', $template, $matches);

        return array_values(array_unique($matches[1]));
    }

    /**
     * Rejects a template that uses a placeholder no value is ever supplied for.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the template names an unknown placeholder
     */
    public function check(string $template, string $context): void
    {
        foreach ($this->placeholders($template) as $placeholder) {
            if (!in_array($placeholder, self::PLACEHOLDERS, true)) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('%s uses the unknown placeholder {%s}. Use one of: {%s}.', $context, $placeholder, implode('}, {', self::PLACEHOLDERS)));
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Replaces every placeholder that has a value; the others are left as written.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $values
     */
    public function render(string $template, array $values): string
    {
        $replacements = [];
        foreach ($values as $name => $value) {
            $replacements['{' . $name . '}'] = $value;
        }

        return strtr($template, $replacements);
    }
}

 * @property-read list<string> $excludeNames name globs to drop

{
    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param list<string> $visibility
     * @param list<string> $names
     * @param list<string> $excludeNames
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $kind,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $visibility = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $names = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $excludeNames = [],
        /** @readonly */

    ) {
    }

     *

    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'kind' => $this->kind,
            'visibility' => $this->visibility,
            'names' => $this->names,
            'excludeNames' => $this->excludeNames,
            'static' => $this->static,
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a target is one the rule judges.
     */
    public function selects(Target $target): bool
    {
        if ($target->kind !== $this->kind) {

        return $this->excludeNames === [] || !$matcher->matchesAny($this->excludeNames, $target->name);

use DecisionsLint\Source\GlobMatcher;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;

/**
 * Which declarations of a file a rule judges.
 *
 * @property-read string $kind file, class, interface, trait, enum, method, function or property
 * @property-read list<string> $visibility the visibilities to keep; empty keeps all
 * @property-read list<string> $names name globs to keep; empty keeps all
 * @property-read list<string> $excludeNames name globs to drop
 * @property-read ?bool $static whether to keep only static or only non-static declarations; null keeps both
 */
final class TargetSelector
{
    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param list<string> $visibility
     * @param list<string> $names
     * @param list<string> $excludeNames
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $kind,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $visibility = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $names = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $excludeNames = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private ?bool $static = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns a declared immutable property.
     *
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'kind' => $this->kind,
            'visibility' => $this->visibility,
            'names' => $this->names,
            'excludeNames' => $this->excludeNames,
            'static' => $this->static,
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a target is one the rule judges.
     */
    public function selects(Target $target): bool
    {
        if ($target->kind !== $this->kind) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($this->visibility !== [] && !in_array($target->visibility, $this->visibility, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($this->static !== null && in_array('static', $target->modifiers, true) !== $this->static) {
            return false;
        }
        $matcher = new GlobMatcher();
        if ($this->names !== [] && !$matcher->matchesAny($this->names, $target->name)) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->excludeNames === [] || !$matcher->matchesAny($this->excludeNames, $target->name);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Rule;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;

/**
 * Builds the question and the subject a rule sends to the model for one target.
 */
final class QuestionBuilder
{
    /**
     * Creates a builder, optionally with a shared template renderer.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Template $template = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the question of a rule with the target's values filled into the instructions.
     */
    public function question(Rule $rule, Target $target): Question
    {
        $values = $target->variables() + ['rule' => $rule->id, 'threshold' => (string) $rule->decision->threshold];

        return new Question($rule->id, $rule->decision->type, ($this->template ?? new Template())->render($rule->decision->instructions, $values), $rule->decision->choices, $rule->decision->levels);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the named sections the model reads about a target, with the source its context mode asks for.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function subject(Target $target, string $context): array
    {
        $subject = [
            'file' => $target->file,
            'kind' => $target->kind,
            'name' => $target->qualifiedName,
            'signature' => $target->signature,
            'declaration' => $target->declaration,
        ];
        if ($context !== 'declaration') {
            $subject[$context === 'class' ? 'class_source' : 'file_source'] = $target->context($context);
        }

        return $subject;
    }

    /**
     * Returns one inquiry for a target with every question of the given rules.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     */
    public function inquiry(Target $target, string $context, array $rules): Inquiry
    {
        $questions = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            $questions[] = $this->question($rule, $target);
        }

        return new Inquiry($this->subject($target, $context), $questions);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Rule;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;

/**
 * Turns the model's answer about a target into a finding when the rule says that answer violates it.
 */
final class ViolationMatcher
{
    /**
     * Creates a matcher, optionally with a shared template renderer.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Template $template = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the finding for the first violation the answer satisfies, or null when the target passes.
     */
    public function match(Rule $rule, Target $target, Answer $answer): ?Finding
    {
        if ($answer->type !== $rule->decision->type) {
            return null;
        }
        foreach ($rule->violations as $violation) {
            if ($this->violates($rule->decision, $violation, $answer)) {
                return $this->finding($rule, $target, $violation, $answer);
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether an answer is the one a violation describes, with at least the threshold's certainty.
     */
    public function violates(DecisionSpec $decision, Violation $violation, Answer $answer): bool
    {
        if ($answer->type === Question::PREDICATE) {

 * @property-read int $timeout seconds to wait for one response
 * @property-read int $concurrency how many requests are in flight at once
 */
final class ProviderSettings
{
    /**
     * The TypeSafe AI decision model.
     */
    public const JEV = 'jev';

    /**
     * The OpenAI Decisions API.
     */
    public const OPENAI = 'openai';

    /**
     * Every supported provider.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    public const NAMES = [self::JEV, self::OPENAI];

     * Creates the immutable value.
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $name,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $model,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $apiKeyEnv,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $baseUrl,
        /** @readonly */
        private int $timeout = 60,
        /** @readonly */
        private int $concurrency = 8,
    ) {
    }

     * Returns the settings a provider uses when the configuration names only the provider.
     */

    {
        return $name === self::OPENAI

    }
}

/**
 * The TypeSafe AI System One endpoint that runs Jev: POST /v1/systemone.
 *
 * A request carries a `state` and a `questions` object keyed by question id,
 * each question being `noul`, `choice` or `score`. The response carries an
 * `answers` object with the same keys, the `model` version and token `usage`.
 */
final class JevClient
{
    /**
     * The path of the System One endpoint.
     */
    public const PATH = '/v1/systemone';

    /**
     * Creates a client over a configured endpoint and a model identifier.
     */
    public function __construct(private JsonEndpoint $endpoint, private string $model)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Sends one System One request per state and returns the decoded responses in order.
     *
     * @param list<array{state: array<string, string>|string, questions: array<string, array<string, mixed>>}> $requests
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     * @throws LintException when the API rejects a request or cannot be reached
     */
    public function systemOne(array $requests): array
    {
        $payloads = [];
        foreach ($requests as $request) {
            $payloads[] = ['model' => $this->model, 'state' => $request['state'], 'questions' => $request['questions']];
        }

        return $this->endpoint->post(self::PATH, $payloads);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider\Jev;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Verdict;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Payload;

/**
 * Adapts Jev to the Decision interface.
 *
 * A predicate becomes a `noul`, a choice keeps its options as `criteria`, and a
 * score lists its levels as `criteria`. The subject sections become the state
 * object, so the model sees each section under its name.
 */
final class JevDecision implements Decision
{
    /**
     * Creates the adapter over a client.
     */
    public function __construct(private JevClient $client)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Answers every inquiry with one System One request each.
     *
     * @param list<Inquiry> $inquiries
     * @return list<Verdict>
     * @throws LintException when the API rejects a request, cannot be reached, or answers in an unexpected shape
     */
    public function decide(array $inquiries): array
    {
        $requests = [];
        foreach ($inquiries as $inquiry) {
            $requests[] = $this->request($inquiry);
        }
        $verdicts = [];
        foreach ($this->client->systemOne($requests) as $index => $response) {
            $verdicts[] = $this->verdict($response, $inquiries[$index]);
        }

        return $verdicts;
    }

    /**
     * Translates an inquiry into the state and questions of a System One request.
     *
     * @return array{state: array<string, string>, questions: array<string, array<string, mixed>>}
     */
    public function request(Inquiry $inquiry): array
    {
        $questions = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $questions[$question->name] = $this->question($question);
        }

        return ['state' => $inquiry->subject, 'questions' => $questions];
    }

    /**
     * Translates one question into its Jev form.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function question(Question $question): array
    {
        return match ($question->type) {
            Question::CHOICE => ['type' => 'choice', 'instructions' => $question->instructions, 'criteria' => $question->choices],
            Question::SCORE => ['type' => 'score', 'instructions' => $question->instructions, 'criteria' => $question->levels],
            default => ['type' => 'noul', 'instructions' => $question->instructions],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Reads the answers of a response into a verdict.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $response
     * @throws LintException when the response lacks an answer or an answer field
     */
    public function verdict(array $response, Inquiry $inquiry): Verdict
    {
        $payload = new Payload($response, 'Jev response');
        $answers = $payload->nested('answers');
        $result = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $result[$question->name] = $answers->has($question->name) ? $this->answer($answers->nested($question->name), $question) : Answer::refusal();
        }

        return new Verdict($payload->stringOr('model', 'jev'), $result);
    }

    /**

/**

     * Creates a client over a configured endpoint and a model identifier.
     */
    public function __construct(private JsonEndpoint $endpoint, private string $model)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Sends one Decisions request per input and returns the decoded responses in order.
     *
     * @param list<array{input: string, questions: list<array<string, mixed>>}> $requests
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     * @throws LintException when the API rejects a request or cannot be reached

    {
        $payloads = [];
        foreach ($requests as $request) {
            $payloads[] = ['model' => $this->model, 'input' => $request['input'], 'questions' => $request['questions']];
        }

        return $this->endpoint->post(self::PATH, $payloads);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi;

/**
 * Lays the named sections of a subject out as one text document for an API that takes plain input.
 */
final class InputRenderer
{
    /**
     * Returns the sections as Markdown headings followed by their text, source sections fenced as PHP.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $subject
     */
    public function render(array $subject): string
    {
        $blocks = [];
        foreach ($subject as $name => $text) {
            $heading = '## ' . str_replace('_', ' ', $name);
            $blocks[] = str_ends_with($name, 'source') || $name === 'declaration'
                ? $heading . "\n\n```php\n" . rtrim($text, "\n") . "\n```"
                : $heading . "\n\n" . $text;
        }

        return implode("\n\n", $blocks) . "\n";
    }
}

 * The subject sections are rendered into one text input. Choices become
 * `{value, description}` entries and score levels become `{label, description}`
 * entries. Answers are read back by name; a refusal becomes a refusal answer.
 */
final class OpenAiDecision implements Decision
{
    /**
     * Creates the adapter over a client.
     */
    public function __construct(private OpenAiClient $client, private ?InputRenderer $renderer = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Answers every inquiry with one Decisions request each.
     *
     * @param list<Inquiry> $inquiries
     * @return list<Verdict>
     * @throws LintException when the API rejects a request, cannot be reached, or answers in an unexpected shape
     */
    public function decide(array $inquiries): array
    {
        $requests = [];
        foreach ($inquiries as $inquiry) {
            $requests[] = $this->request($inquiry);
        }
        $verdicts = [];
        foreach ($this->client->decisions($requests) as $index => $response) {
            $verdicts[] = $this->verdict($response, $inquiries[$index]);
        }

        return $verdicts;
    }

    /**
     * Translates an inquiry into the input and questions of a Decisions request.
     *
     * @return array{input: string, questions: list<array<string, mixed>>}
     */
    public function request(Inquiry $inquiry): array
    {
        $questions = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $questions[] = $this->question($question);
        }

        return ['input' => ($this->renderer ?? new InputRenderer())->render($inquiry->subject), 'questions' => $questions];
    }

    /**
     * Translates one question into its Decisions form.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function question(Question $question): array
    {
        $base = ['type' => $question->type, 'name' => $question->name, 'instructions' => $question->instructions];
        if ($question->type === Question::CHOICE) {
            $choices = [];
            foreach ($question->choices as $value => $description) {
                $choices[] = ['value' => $value, 'description' => $description];
            }

            return $base + ['choices' => $choices];
        }
        if ($question->type === Question::SCORE) {
            $levels = [];
            foreach ($question->levels as $index => $description) {
                $levels[] = ['label' => (string) $index, 'description' => $description];
            }

            return $base + ['levels' => $levels];
        }

        return $base;
    }

    /**
     * Reads the answers of a response into a verdict.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $response
     * @throws LintException when the response lacks the answers list or an answer field
     */
    public function verdict(array $response, Inquiry $inquiry): Verdict
    {
        $payload = new Payload($response, 'OpenAI response');
        $byName = [];
        foreach ($payload->entries('answers') as $entry) {
            $byName[$entry->string('name')] = $entry;
        }
        $result = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $entry = $byName[$question->name] ?? null;
            $result[$question->name] = $entry === null || $entry->stringOr('type', '') === Answer::REFUSAL ? Answer::refusal() : $this->answer($entry, $question);
        }

        return new Verdict($payload->stringOr('model', 'openai'), $result);
    }

    /**
     * Reads one answer in the shape the question's type promises.
     *
     * @throws LintException when a field is missing or malformed
     */
    public function answer(Payload $answer, Question $question): Answer
    {
        return match ($question->type) {
            Question::CHOICE => Answer::choice($answer->string('choice'), $answer->float('confidence'), $this->distribution($answer)),
            Question::SCORE => Answer::score($answer->float('score'), $answer->float('confidence'), $this->distribution($answer)),
            default => Answer::predicate($answer->float('probability')),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Reads a `probabilities` list of `{value, probability}` entries into a map.
     *
     * @return array<string, float>
     * @throws LintException when an entry lacks its value or probability
     */
    public function distribution(Payload $answer): array
    {
        $probabilities = [];
        foreach ($answer->entries('probabilities') as $entry) {
            $value = $entry->has('value') ? $entry->string('value') : $entry->string('label');
            $probabilities[$value] = $entry->float('probability');
        }

        return $probabilities;
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Jev\JevClient;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Jev\JevDecision;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi\OpenAiClient;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi\OpenAiDecision;

/**
 * Builds the Decision adapter the configuration names, with the API key from the environment.
 */
final class ProviderFactory
{
    /**
     * Returns the adapter for the configured provider.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the API key is not in the environment or the provider is unknown
     */
    public function create(ProviderSettings $settings, Transport $transport): Decision
    {
        $endpoint = new JsonEndpoint($transport, $settings, $this->apiKey($settings));

        return match ($settings->name) {
            ProviderSettings::JEV => new JevDecision(new JevClient($endpoint, $settings->model)),
            ProviderSettings::OPENAI => new OpenAiDecision(new OpenAiClient($endpoint, $settings->model)),
            default => throw new LintException(sprintf('Unknown provider "%s". Set provider.name in decisions.yaml to %s.', $settings->name, implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES))),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Reads the API key from the configured environment variable.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the variable is unset or empty
     */
    public function apiKey(ProviderSettings $settings): string
    {
        $key = getenv($settings->apiKeyEnv);
        if ($key === false || trim($key) === '') {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('The %s environment variable is not set. Export the %s API key in it, or set provider.api_key_env in decisions.yaml to the variable that holds the key.', $settings->apiKeyEnv, $settings->name));
        }

        return trim($key);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Source;

use PhpToken;

/**
 * Finds the class-likes, methods, functions and properties a PHP file declares.
 *
 * Bodies of methods and functions are skipped, so closures and classes inside
 * them are not reported; anonymous classes are skipped as well.
 */
final class DeclarationScanner
{
    /**
     * The modifiers that may precede a declaration keyword.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    private const MODIFIERS = ['public', 'protected', 'private', 'static', 'abstract', 'final', 'readonly', 'var'];

    /**
     * Returns every declaration in source order.
     *
     * @return list<Declaration>
     */
    public function scan(Tokens $tokens): array
    {
        $declarations = [];
        $namespace = '';
        $owners = [];
        $index = 0;
        while ($index < $tokens->count()) {
            $token = $tokens->at($index);
            $owner = $owners === [] ? null : $owners[count($owners) - 1];
            if ($token->is(T_NAMESPACE)) {
                $namespace = $this->namespaceName($tokens, $index);
            } elseif ($this->isClassLikeKeyword($tokens, $index)) {
                $declaration = $this->classLike($tokens, $index, $namespace, $owner['name'] ?? null);
                $declarations[] = $declaration;
                $owners[] = ['name' => $declaration->name, 'end' => $declaration->end];
                $index = $tokens->find($index, ['{']) ?? $declaration->end;
            } elseif ($token->is(T_FUNCTION) && $this->isNamedFunction($tokens, $index)) {
                $declaration = $this->function($tokens, $index, $namespace, $owner['name'] ?? null);
                $declarations[] = $declaration;
                $index = $declaration->end;
            } elseif ($owner !== null && $this->startsProperty($tokens, $index)) {
                $declaration = $this->property($tokens, $index, $namespace, $owner['name']);
                $declarations[] = $declaration;
                $index = $declaration->end;
            } elseif ($owner !== null && $index === $owner['end']) {
                array_pop($owners);
            }
            ++$index;
        }

        return $declarations;
    }

    /**
     * Reads the name after a namespace keyword, or an empty string for the global namespace block.
     */
    public function namespaceName(Tokens $tokens, int $index): string
    {
        $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        if ($next === null || !$tokens->at($next)->is([T_STRING, T_NAME_QUALIFIED])) {
            return '';
        }

        return $tokens->at($next)->text;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether the token at an index is the keyword of a named class, interface, trait or enum declaration.
     */
    public function isClassLikeKeyword(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $token = $tokens->at($index);
        if (!$token->is([T_CLASS, T_INTERFACE, T_TRAIT]) && !$this->isEnumKeyword($token)) {
            return false;
        }
        $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($index);
        if ($previous !== null && $tokens->at($previous)->is([T_NEW, T_DOUBLE_COLON])) {
            return false;
        }
        $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($index);

        return $next !== null && $tokens->at($next)->is(T_STRING) && $this->followsClassName($tokens, $next);
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a token is an enum keyword, which PHP 8.0 tokenizes as a plain string.
     */
    public function isEnumKeyword(PhpToken $token): bool
    {
        return strtolower($token->text) === 'enum' && ($token->is(T_STRING) || $token->getTokenName() === 'T_ENUM');
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether the token after a class-like name is one that may follow it: a brace, extends, implements or an enum backing type.
     */
    public function followsClassName(Tokens $tokens, int $nameIndex): bool
    {
        $after = $tokens->nextSignificant($nameIndex);
        if ($after === null) {
            return false;
        }
        $token = $tokens->at($after);

        return $token->text === '{' || $token->text === ':' || $token->is([T_EXTENDS, T_IMPLEMENTS]);
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a function keyword starts a named function or method rather than a closure.
     */
    public function isNamedFunction(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        if ($next !== null && $tokens->at($next)->text === '&') {
            $next = $tokens->nextSignificant($next);
        }

        return $next !== null && $tokens->at($next)->is(T_STRING);
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a token at class member level begins a property declaration: the first modifier of a statement that declares a variable and is not a method, constant or case.
     */
    public function startsProperty(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if (!in_array(strtolower($tokens->at($index)->text), self::MODIFIERS, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($index);
        if ($previous !== null && in_array(strtolower($tokens->at($previous)->text), self::MODIFIERS, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        $end = $tokens->find($index, [';', '{', '}']);
        if ($end === null || $tokens->at($end)->text !== ';') {
            return false;
        }
        $variable = false;
        for ($i = $index; $i < $end; ++$i) {
            if ($tokens->at($i)->is([T_FUNCTION, T_CONST, T_CASE, T_USE])) {
                return false;
            }
            $variable = $variable || $tokens->at($i)->is(T_VARIABLE);
        }

        return $variable;
    }

    /**
     * Describes the class-like declaration whose keyword is at an index.
     */
    public function classLike(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $namespace, ?string $owner): Declaration
    {
        $nameIndex = (int) $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        $open = (int) $tokens->find($nameIndex, ['{']);
        $start = $this->declarationStart($tokens, $index);

        return new Declaration(strtolower($tokens->at($index)->text), $tokens->at($nameIndex)->text, $namespace, $owner, $this->docStart($tokens, $start), $start, (int) $tokens->previousSignificant($open), $tokens->closing($open), $this->modifiers($tokens, $start, $index));
    }

    /**
     * Describes the function or method whose keyword is at an index.
     */
    public function function(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $namespace, ?string $owner): Declaration
    {
        $nameIndex = (int) $tokens->nextSignificant($index);
        if ($tokens->at($nameIndex)->text === '&') {
            $nameIndex = (int) $tokens->nextSignificant($nameIndex);
        }
        $parameters = (int) $tokens->find($nameIndex, ['(']);
        $bodyStart = (int) $tokens->find($tokens->closing($parameters, '(', ')'), ['{', ';']);
        $end = $tokens->at($bodyStart)->text === '{' ? $tokens->closing($bodyStart) : $bodyStart;
        $start = $this->declarationStart($tokens, $index);

        return new Declaration($owner === null ? 'function' : 'method', $tokens->at($nameIndex)->text, $namespace, $owner, $this->docStart($tokens, $start), $start, (int) $tokens->previousSignificant($bodyStart), $end, $this->modifiers($tokens, $start, $index));
    }

    /**
     * Describes the property declaration whose first modifier is at an index.
     */
    public function property(Tokens $tokens, int $index, string $namespace, string $owner): Declaration
    {
        $end = (int) $tokens->find($index, [';']);
        $variable = $index;
        for ($i = $index; $i < $end; ++$i) {
            if ($tokens->at($i)->is(T_VARIABLE)) {
                $variable = $i;
                break;
            }
        }

        return new Declaration('property', ltrim($tokens->at($variable)->text, '$'), $namespace, $owner, $this->docStart($tokens, $index), $index, $end, $end, $this->modifiers($tokens, $index, $variable));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the first modifier before a declaration keyword, or the keyword index itself.
     */
    public function declarationStart(Tokens $tokens, int $index): int
    {
        $start = $index;
        $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($index);
        while ($previous !== null && in_array(strtolower($tokens->at($previous)->text), self::MODIFIERS, true)) {
            $start = $previous;
            $previous = $tokens->previousSignificant($previous);
        }

        return $start;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the docblock directly above a declaration start, or the start itself.
     */
    public function docStart(Tokens $tokens, int $start): int
    {
        for ($i = $start - 1; $i >= 0; --$i) {
            $token = $tokens->at($i);
            if ($token->is(T_DOC_COMMENT)) {
                return $i;
            }
            if (!$token->is(T_WHITESPACE)) {
                return $start;
            }
        }

        return $start;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the lower-case modifier keywords between two indexes.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function modifiers(Tokens $tokens, int $from, int $to): array
    {
        $modifiers = [];
        for ($i = $from; $i < $to; ++$i) {
            $text = strtolower($tokens->at($i)->text);
            if (in_array($text, self::MODIFIERS, true)) {
                $modifiers[] = $text;
            }
        }

        return $modifiers;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Rule;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Fills `{name}` placeholders in rule instructions, messages and fixes.
 */
final class Template
{
    /**
     * The placeholders every template may use, filled from the target, the rule and the answer.
     *
     * @var list<string>
     */
    public const PLACEHOLDERS = [
        'file', 'line', 'column', 'kind', 'name', 'class', 'namespace', 'qualified_name', 'signature', 'visibility',
        'rule', 'answer', 'probability', 'confidence', 'choice', 'score', 'threshold',
    ];

    /**
     * Returns the placeholder names a template uses, in order of first appearance.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function placeholders(string $template): array
    {
        preg_match_all('/\{([a-z_]+)\}/', $template, $matches);

        return array_values(array_unique($matches[1]));
    }

    /**
     * Rejects a template that uses a placeholder no value is ever supplied for.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the template names an unknown placeholder
     */
    public function check(string $template, string $context): void
    {
        foreach ($this->placeholders($template) as $placeholder) {
            if (!in_array($placeholder, self::PLACEHOLDERS, true)) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('%s uses the unknown placeholder {%s}. Use one of: {%s}.', $context, $placeholder, implode('}, {', self::PLACEHOLDERS)));
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Replaces every placeholder that has a value; the others are left as written.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $values
     */
    public function render(string $template, array $values): string
    {
        $replacements = [];
        foreach ($values as $name => $value) {
            $replacements['{' . $name . '}'] = $value;
        }

        return strtr($template, $replacements);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Rule;

use DecisionsLint\Source\GlobMatcher;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;

/**
 * Which declarations of a file a rule judges.
 *
 * @property-read string $kind file, class, interface, trait, enum, method, function or property
 * @property-read list<string> $visibility the visibilities to keep; empty keeps all
 * @property-read list<string> $names name globs to keep; empty keeps all
 * @property-read list<string> $excludeNames name globs to drop
 * @property-read ?bool $static whether to keep only static or only non-static declarations; null keeps both
 */
final class TargetSelector
{
    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param list<string> $visibility
     * @param list<string> $names
     * @param list<string> $excludeNames
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $kind,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $visibility = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $names = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $excludeNames = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private ?bool $static = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns a declared immutable property.
     *
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'kind' => $this->kind,
            'visibility' => $this->visibility,
            'names' => $this->names,
            'excludeNames' => $this->excludeNames,
            'static' => $this->static,
            default => null,
        };
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a target is one the rule judges.
     */
    public function selects(Target $target): bool
    {
        if ($target->kind !== $this->kind) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($this->visibility !== [] && !in_array($target->visibility, $this->visibility, true)) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($this->static !== null && in_array('static', $target->modifiers, true) !== $this->static) {
            return false;
        }
        $matcher = new GlobMatcher();
        if ($this->names !== [] && !$matcher->matchesAny($this->names, $target->name)) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->excludeNames === [] || !$matcher->matchesAny($this->excludeNames, $target->name);
    }
}

{
    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $choices
     * @param list<string> $levels
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $type,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $instructions,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $choices = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private array $levels = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private float $threshold = 0.5,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns a declared immutable property.
     *
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'type' => $this->type,
            'instructions' => $this->instructions,
            'choices' => $this->choices,
            'levels' => $this->levels,
            'threshold' => $this->threshold,

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;

/**
 * Builds the question and the subject a rule sends to the model for one target.
 */
final class QuestionBuilder
{
    /**
     * Creates a builder, optionally with a shared template renderer.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Template $template = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the question of a rule with the target's values filled into the instructions.
     */
    public function question(Rule $rule, Target $target): Question
    {
        $values = $target->variables() + ['rule' => $rule->id, 'threshold' => (string) $rule->decision->threshold];

        return new Question($rule->id, $rule->decision->type, ($this->template ?? new Template())->render($rule->decision->instructions, $values), $rule->decision->choices, $rule->decision->levels);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the named sections the model reads about a target, with the source its context mode asks for.
     *
     * @return array<string, string>
     */
    public function subject(Target $target, string $context): array
    {
        $subject = [
            'file' => $target->file,
            'kind' => $target->kind,
            'name' => $target->qualifiedName,
            'signature' => $target->signature,
            'declaration' => $target->declaration,
        ];
        if ($context !== 'declaration') {
            $subject[$context === 'class' ? 'class_source' : 'file_source'] = $target->context($context);
        }

        return $subject;
    }

    /**
     * Returns one inquiry for a target with every question of the given rules.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     */
    public function inquiry(Target $target, string $context, array $rules): Inquiry
    {
        $questions = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            $questions[] = $this->question($rule, $target);
        }

        return new Inquiry($this->subject($target, $context), $questions);
    }

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Rule;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;

/**
 * Turns the model's answer about a target into a finding when the rule says that answer violates it.
 */
final class ViolationMatcher
{
    /**
     * Creates a matcher, optionally with a shared template renderer.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Template $template = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the finding for the first violation the answer satisfies, or null when the target passes.
     */
    public function match(Rule $rule, Target $target, Answer $answer): ?Finding
    {
        if ($answer->type !== $rule->decision->type) {
            return null;
        }
        foreach ($rule->violations as $violation) {
            if ($this->violates($rule->decision, $violation, $answer)) {
                return $this->finding($rule, $target, $violation, $answer);
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether an answer is the one a violation describes, with at least the threshold's certainty.
     */
    public function violates(DecisionSpec $decision, Violation $violation, Answer $answer): bool
    {
        if ($answer->type === Question::PREDICATE) {
            $probability = $violation->answer === true ? $answer->probability : 1.0 - $answer->probability;

            return $probability >= $decision->threshold;
        }
        if ($answer->confidence < $decision->threshold) {
            return false;
        }
        if ($answer->type === Question::CHOICE) {
            return $answer->choice === $violation->answer;
        }

        return ($violation->minScore === null || $answer->score >= $violation->minScore)
            && ($violation->maxScore === null || $answer->score <= $violation->maxScore);
    }

    /**
     * Renders the message and fix of a violation for a target and answer.
     */
    public function finding(Rule $rule, Target $target, Violation $violation, Answer $answer): Finding
    {
        $template = $this->template ?? new Template();
        $confidence = $answer->type === Question::PREDICATE ? max($answer->probability, 1.0 - $answer->probability) : $answer->confidence;
        $values = $target->variables() + [
            'rule' => $rule->id,
            'answer' => $this->answerText($answer),
            'probability' => number_format($answer->probability, 2, '.', ''),
            'confidence' => number_format($confidence, 2, '.', ''),
            'choice' => $answer->choice,
            'score' => number_format($answer->score, 2, '.', ''),
            'threshold' => (string) $rule->decision->threshold,
        ];

        return new Finding($target->file, $target->line, $target->column, $rule->id, $rule->severity, $target->qualifiedName, $template->render($violation->message, $values), $template->render($violation->fix, $values), round($confidence, 4));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the answer as text: yes or no for a predicate, the option for a choice, the score otherwise.
     */
    public function answerText(Answer $answer): string
    {
        return match ($answer->type) {
            Question::PREDICATE => $answer->probability >= 0.5 ? 'yes' : 'no',
            Question::CHOICE => $answer->choice,
            default => number_format($answer->score, 2, '.', ''),
        };
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Reads typed fields out of a decoded provider response, naming the field when it is missing or malformed.
 */
final class Payload
{
    /**
     * Creates a reader for one decoded document described by a context such as "Jev answer for rule x".
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function __construct(private array $data, private string $context)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Reads a number.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or not a number
     */
    public function float(string $key): float
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_int($value) && !is_float($value)) {
            throw new LintException($this->problem($key, 'a number', $value));
        }

        return (float) $value;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a string.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or not a string
     */
    public function string(string $key): string
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($value)) {
            throw new LintException($this->problem($key, 'a string', $value));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a string, or returns a default when the field is absent.
     */
    public function stringOr(string $key, string $default): string
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;

        return is_string($value) ? $value : $default;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a mapping or list of values as a nested payload.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or not an array
     */
    public function nested(string $key): self
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new LintException($this->problem($key, 'a mapping or list', $value));
        }
        $nested = [];
        foreach ($value as $nestedKey => $entry) {
            $nested[(string) $nestedKey] = $entry;
        }

        return new self($nested, $this->context . '.' . $key);
    }

    /**
     * Reads a mapping of names to numbers, such as a probability distribution.
     *
     * @return array<string, float>
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or a value is not a number
     */
    public function floats(string $key): array
    {
        $nested = $this->nested($key);
        $floats = [];
        foreach ($nested->keys() as $name) {
            $floats[$name] = $nested->float($name);
        }

        return $floats;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a list of mappings as nested payloads.
     *
     * @return list<self>
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or an entry is not a mapping
     */
    public function entries(string $key): array
    {
        $nested = $this->nested($key);
        $entries = [];
        foreach ($nested->keys() as $index) {
            $entries[] = $nested->nested($index);
        }

        return $entries;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the keys of the document.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function keys(): array
    {
        return array_map('strval', array_keys($this->data));
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a field is present.
     */
    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->data);
    }

    /**
     * Describes a field that does not hold what the API promised.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     */
    public function problem(string $key, string $expected, $value): string
    {
        $actual = $value === null ? 'it is missing' : 'it is ' . (is_scalar($value) ? var_export($value, true) : gettype($value));

        return sprintf('%s: field "%s" must be %s, but %s. The provider returned a response this version does not understand; report the response or update decisions-lint.', $this->context, $key, $expected, $actual);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpRequest;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpResponse;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use JsonException;

/**
 * Posts JSON documents to a bearer-authenticated API and decodes what comes back.
 *
 * The two decision APIs share this shape; each client adds its path and body.
 */
final class JsonEndpoint
{
    /**
     * Creates an endpoint for one provider over a transport.
     */
    public function __construct(private Transport $transport, private ProviderSettings $settings, private string $apiKey)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Posts every payload to a path and returns the decoded responses in the same order.
     *
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $payloads
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails or a response is not a JSON object
     */
    public function post(string $path, array $payloads): array
    {
        $requests = [];
        foreach ($payloads as $payload) {
            $requests[] = $this->request($path, $payload);
        }
        $documents = [];
        foreach ($this->transport->send($requests) as $index => $response) {
            $documents[] = $this->decode($response, $requests[$index]);
        }

        return $documents;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the request for one payload.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
     * @throws LintException when the payload cannot be encoded
     */
    public function request(string $path, array $payload): HttpRequest
    {
        try {
            $body = json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        } catch (JsonException $exception) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not encode a request for %s: %s. Make sure the linted files are valid UTF-8.', $this->settings->name, $exception->getMessage()), 0, $exception);
        }

        return new HttpRequest('POST', rtrim($this->settings->baseUrl, '/') . $path, [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $this->apiKey,
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
            'User-Agent' => 'decisions-lint',
        ], $body);
    }

    /**
     * Decodes a successful response, or explains the failure.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     * @throws LintException when the status is not 2xx or the body is not a JSON object
     */
    public function decode(HttpResponse $response, HttpRequest $request): array
    {
        $document = null;
        try {
            $document = json_decode($response->body, true, 64, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException $exception) {
            if ($response->ok()) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('%s returned HTTP %d for %s with a body that is not JSON: %s. Check provider.base_url in decisions.yaml.', $this->settings->name, $response->status, $request->url, $exception->getMessage()), 0, $exception);
            }
        }
        if (!$response->ok()) {
            throw new LintException($this->failure($response, $request, is_array($document) ? $document : []));
        }
        if (!is_array($document)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s returned HTTP %d for %s with a JSON body that is not an object. Check provider.base_url in decisions.yaml.', $this->settings->name, $response->status, $request->url));
        }
        $object = [];
        foreach ($document as $key => $value) {
            $object[(string) $key] = $value;
        }

        return $object;
    }

    /**
     * Explains a non-2xx response with the provider's own message and the configuration to check.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $document
     */
    public function failure(HttpResponse $response, HttpRequest $request, array $document): string
    {
        $detail = $this->detail($document, $response->body);
        $hint = match (true) {
            $response->status === 401 || $response->status === 403 => sprintf('Check that the %s environment variable holds a valid %s API key.', $this->settings->apiKeyEnv, $this->settings->name),
            $response->status === 404 => 'Check provider.base_url in decisions.yaml.',
            $response->status === 422 || $response->status === 400 => sprintf('Check provider.model ("%s") and the rule questions in decisions.yaml.', $this->settings->model),
            $response->status === 429 => 'Lower provider.concurrency in decisions.yaml or retry later.',
            $response->status >= 500 => 'The provider is unavailable; retry later.',
            default => 'Check the provider status and decisions.yaml.',
        };

        return sprintf('%s returned HTTP %d for POST %s%s. %s', $this->settings->name, $response->status, $request->url, $detail === '' ? '' : ': ' . $detail, $hint);
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the error message of a failure body, falling back to a short excerpt of the body.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $document
     */
    public function detail(array $document, string $body): string
    {
        $error = $document['error'] ?? $document['message'] ?? $document['detail'] ?? null;
        if (is_array($error)) {
            $error = $error['message'] ?? $error['detail'] ?? null;
        }
        if (is_string($error) && $error !== '') {
            return $error;
        }
        $excerpt = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $body));

        return strlen($excerpt) > 200 ? substr($excerpt, 0, 200) . '…' : $excerpt;
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider\Jev;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Verdict;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Payload;

/**
 * Adapts Jev to the Decision interface.
 *
 * A predicate becomes a `noul`, a choice keeps its options as `criteria`, and a
 * score lists its levels as `criteria`. The subject sections become the state
 * object, so the model sees each section under its name.
 */
final class JevDecision implements Decision
{
    /**
     * Creates the adapter over a client.
     */
    public function __construct(private JevClient $client)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Answers every inquiry with one System One request each.
     *
     * @param list<Inquiry> $inquiries
     * @return list<Verdict>
     * @throws LintException when the API rejects a request, cannot be reached, or answers in an unexpected shape
     */
    public function decide(array $inquiries): array
    {
        $requests = [];
        foreach ($inquiries as $inquiry) {
            $requests[] = $this->request($inquiry);
        }
        $verdicts = [];
        foreach ($this->client->systemOne($requests) as $index => $response) {
            $verdicts[] = $this->verdict($response, $inquiries[$index]);
        }

        return $verdicts;
    }

    /**
     * Translates an inquiry into the state and questions of a System One request.
     *
     * @return array{state: array<string, string>, questions: array<string, array<string, mixed>>}
     */
    public function request(Inquiry $inquiry): array
    {
        $questions = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $questions[$question->name] = $this->question($question);
        }

        return ['state' => $inquiry->subject, 'questions' => $questions];
    }

    /**
     * Translates one question into its Jev form.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function question(Question $question): array
    {
        return match ($question->type) {
            Question::CHOICE => ['type' => 'choice', 'instructions' => $question->instructions, 'criteria' => $question->choices],
            Question::SCORE => ['type' => 'score', 'instructions' => $question->instructions, 'criteria' => $question->levels],
            default => ['type' => 'noul', 'instructions' => $question->instructions],
        };
    }

    /**
     * Reads the answers of a response into a verdict.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $response
     * @throws LintException when the response lacks an answer or an answer field
     */
    public function verdict(array $response, Inquiry $inquiry): Verdict
    {
        $payload = new Payload($response, 'Jev response');
        $answers = $payload->nested('answers');
        $result = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $result[$question->name] = $answers->has($question->name) ? $this->answer($answers->nested($question->name), $question) : Answer::refusal();
        }

        return new Verdict($payload->stringOr('model', 'jev'), $result);
    }

    /**
     * Reads one answer in the shape the question's type promises.
     *
     * @throws LintException when a field is missing or malformed
     */
    public function answer(Payload $answer, Question $question): Answer
    {
        return match ($question->type) {
            Question::CHOICE => Answer::choice($answer->string('choice'), $answer->float('confidence'), $answer->floats('probabilities')),
            Question::SCORE => Answer::score($answer->float('score'), $answer->float('confidence'), $answer->floats('probabilities')),
            default => Answer::predicate($answer->float('noul')),
        };
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi;

/**
 * Lays the named sections of a subject out as one text document for an API that takes plain input.
 */
final class InputRenderer
{
    /**
     * Returns the sections as Markdown headings followed by their text, source sections fenced as PHP.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $subject
     */
    public function render(array $subject): string
    {
        $blocks = [];
        foreach ($subject as $name => $text) {
            $heading = '## ' . str_replace('_', ' ', $name);
            $blocks[] = str_ends_with($name, 'source') || $name === 'declaration'
                ? $heading . "\n\n```php\n" . rtrim($text, "\n") . "\n```"
                : $heading . "\n\n" . $text;
        }

        return implode("\n\n", $blocks) . "\n";
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Verdict;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Payload;

/**
 * Adapts the OpenAI Decisions API to the Decision interface.
 *
 * The subject sections are rendered into one text input. Choices become
 * `{value, description}` entries and score levels become `{label, description}`
 * entries. Answers are read back by name; a refusal becomes a refusal answer.
 */
final class OpenAiDecision implements Decision
{
    /**
     * Creates the adapter over a client.
     */
    public function __construct(private OpenAiClient $client, private ?InputRenderer $renderer = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Answers every inquiry with one Decisions request each.
     *
     * @param list<Inquiry> $inquiries
     * @return list<Verdict>
     * @throws LintException when the API rejects a request, cannot be reached, or answers in an unexpected shape
     */
    public function decide(array $inquiries): array
    {
        $requests = [];
        foreach ($inquiries as $inquiry) {
            $requests[] = $this->request($inquiry);
        }
        $verdicts = [];
        foreach ($this->client->decisions($requests) as $index => $response) {
            $verdicts[] = $this->verdict($response, $inquiries[$index]);
        }

        return $verdicts;
    }

    /**
     * Translates an inquiry into the input and questions of a Decisions request.
     *
     * @return array{input: string, questions: list<array<string, mixed>>}
     */
    public function request(Inquiry $inquiry): array
    {
        $questions = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $questions[] = $this->question($question);
        }

        return ['input' => ($this->renderer ?? new InputRenderer())->render($inquiry->subject), 'questions' => $questions];
    }

    /**
     * Translates one question into its Decisions form.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function question(Question $question): array
    {
        $base = ['type' => $question->type, 'name' => $question->name, 'instructions' => $question->instructions];
        if ($question->type === Question::CHOICE) {
            $choices = [];
            foreach ($question->choices as $value => $description) {
                $choices[] = ['value' => $value, 'description' => $description];
            }

            return $base + ['choices' => $choices];
        }
        if ($question->type === Question::SCORE) {
            $levels = [];
            foreach ($question->levels as $index => $description) {
                $levels[] = ['label' => (string) $index, 'description' => $description];
            }

            return $base + ['levels' => $levels];
        }

        return $base;
    }

    /**
     * Reads the answers of a response into a verdict.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $response
     * @throws LintException when the response lacks the answers list or an answer field
     */
    public function verdict(array $response, Inquiry $inquiry): Verdict
    {
        $payload = new Payload($response, 'OpenAI response');
        $byName = [];
        foreach ($payload->entries('answers') as $entry) {
            $byName[$entry->string('name')] = $entry;
        }
        $result = [];
        foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
            $entry = $byName[$question->name] ?? null;
            $result[$question->name] = $entry === null || $entry->stringOr('type', '') === Answer::REFUSAL ? Answer::refusal() : $this->answer($entry, $question);
        }

        return new Verdict($payload->stringOr('model', 'openai'), $result);
    }

    /**
     * Reads one answer in the shape the question's type promises.
     *
     * @throws LintException when a field is missing or malformed
     */
    public function answer(Payload $answer, Question $question): Answer
    {
        return match ($question->type) {
            Question::CHOICE => Answer::choice($answer->string('choice'), $answer->float('confidence'), $this->distribution($answer)),
            Question::SCORE => Answer::score($answer->float('score'), $answer->float('confidence'), $this->distribution($answer)),
            default => Answer::predicate($answer->float('probability')),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Reads a `probabilities` list of `{value, probability}` entries into a map.
     *
     * @return array<string, float>
     * @throws LintException when an entry lacks its value or probability
     */
    public function distribution(Payload $answer): array
    {
        $probabilities = [];
        foreach ($answer->entries('probabilities') as $entry) {
            $value = $entry->has('value') ? $entry->string('value') : $entry->string('label');
            $probabilities[$value] = $entry->float('probability');
        }

        return $probabilities;
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Jev\JevClient;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\Jev\JevDecision;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi\OpenAiClient;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\OpenAi\OpenAiDecision;

/**
 * Builds the Decision adapter the configuration names, with the API key from the environment.
 */
final class ProviderFactory
{
    /**
     * Returns the adapter for the configured provider.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the API key is not in the environment or the provider is unknown
     */
    public function create(ProviderSettings $settings, Transport $transport): Decision
    {
        $endpoint = new JsonEndpoint($transport, $settings, $this->apiKey($settings));

        return match ($settings->name) {
            ProviderSettings::JEV => new JevDecision(new JevClient($endpoint, $settings->model)),
            ProviderSettings::OPENAI => new OpenAiDecision(new OpenAiClient($endpoint, $settings->model)),
            default => throw new LintException(sprintf('Unknown provider "%s". Set provider.name in decisions.yaml to %s.', $settings->name, implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES))),
        };
    }

    /**
     * Reads the API key from the configured environment variable.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the variable is unset or empty
     */
    public function apiKey(ProviderSettings $settings): string
    {
        $key = getenv($settings->apiKeyEnv);
        if ($key === false || trim($key) === '') {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('The %s environment variable is not set. Export the %s API key in it, or set provider.api_key_env in decisions.yaml to the variable that holds the key.', $settings->apiKeyEnv, $settings->name));
        }

        return trim($key);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Config;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Checks a decoded YAML document against one of the shipped JSON schemas.
 *
 * It implements the keywords those schemas use: $ref, allOf, type, const,
 * enum, required, properties, additionalProperties, propertyNames, items,
 * minItems, maxItems, minimum, maximum, minLength and pattern. The first
 * problem stops validation and is reported with its path and how to fix it.
 */
final class SchemaValidator
{
    /**
     * Creates a validator over the shipped schemas, or over another catalog.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?SchemaCatalog $catalog = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Validates a whole document against a named schema.
     *
     * @param mixed $document
     * @throws LintException when the document departs from the schema
     */
    public function validate($document, string $schemaName, string $file): void
    {
        $catalog = $this->catalog ?? new SchemaCatalog();
        $this->check($document, $catalog->schema($schemaName), $catalog->schema($schemaName), $catalog, $file, '');
    }

    /**
     * Validates one value against one schema node.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root the schema document the node belongs to, for local references
     * @throws LintException when the value departs from the node
     */
    public function check($value, array $schema, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['$ref']) && is_string($schema['$ref'])) {
            [$resolved, $resolvedRoot] = $this->resolve($schema['$ref'], $root, $catalog);
            $this->check($value, $resolved, $resolvedRoot, $catalog, $file, $path);
        }
        foreach ($this->list($schema['allOf'] ?? null) as $member) {
            $this->check($value, $this->object($member), $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
        }
        $this->checkScalar($value, $schema, $file, $path);
        if (is_array($value)) {
            $this->checkObject($value, $schema, $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
            $this->checkList($value, $schema, $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies the keywords that concern the value itself: type, const, enum, bounds, length and pattern.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @throws LintException when the value departs from the node
     */
    public function checkScalar($value, array $schema, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['type']) && !$this->hasType($value, $this->types($schema['type']))) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be %s, not %s', $this->describeTypes($this->types($schema['type'])), $this->describe($value)), sprintf('Change the value to %s.', $this->describeTypes($this->types($schema['type']))));
        }
        if (array_key_exists('const', $schema) && $value !== $schema['const']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, 'must be ' . $this->describe($schema['const']), sprintf('Set it to %s.', $this->describe($schema['const'])));
        }
        if (isset($schema['enum']) && !in_array($value, $this->list($schema['enum']), true)) {
            $allowed = implode(', ', array_map(fn ($entry): string => $this->describe($entry), $this->list($schema['enum'])));
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, 'must be one of ' . $allowed . ', not ' . $this->describe($value), 'Replace it with one of those values.');
        }
        if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) {
            $this->checkBounds($value, $schema, $file, $path);
        }
        if (is_string($value)) {
            $this->checkString($value, $schema, $file, $path);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies minimum and maximum to a number.
     *
     * @param int|float $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @throws LintException when the number is out of bounds
     */
    public function checkBounds($value, array $schema, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['minimum']) && is_numeric($schema['minimum']) && $value < $schema['minimum']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be at least %s, not %s', $this->describe($schema['minimum']), $this->describe($value)), 'Raise the value.');
        }
        if (isset($schema['maximum']) && is_numeric($schema['maximum']) && $value > $schema['maximum']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be at most %s, not %s', $this->describe($schema['maximum']), $this->describe($value)), 'Lower the value.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies minLength and pattern to a string.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @throws LintException when the string is too short or does not match
     */
    public function checkString(string $value, array $schema, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        if (isset($schema['minLength']) && is_int($schema['minLength']) && strlen($value) < $schema['minLength']) {
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, $schema['minLength'] === 1 ? 'must not be empty' : sprintf('must be at least %d characters long', $schema['minLength']), 'Write a value.');
        }
        if (isset($schema['pattern']) && is_string($schema['pattern']) && preg_match('#' . str_replace('#', '\#', $schema['pattern']) . '#', $value) !== 1) {
            $expected = isset($schema['description']) && is_string($schema['description']) ? $schema['description'] : 'a value matching ' . $schema['pattern'];
            throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('must be %s, not %s', $expected, $this->describe($value)), 'Change the value.');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Applies required, properties, additionalProperties and propertyNames to a mapping.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     * @param array<string, mixed> $schema
     * @param array<string, mixed> $root
     * @throws LintException when a key is missing, unknown, misnamed or invalid
     */
    public function checkObject(array $value, array $schema, array $root, SchemaCatalog $catalog, string $file, string $path): void
    {
        $properties = $this->object($schema['properties'] ?? null);
        foreach ($this->list($schema['required'] ?? null) as $required) {
            if (is_string($required) && !array_key_exists($required, $value)) {
                $description = $this->object($properties[$required] ?? null)['description'] ?? null;
                throw $this->problem($file, $path, sprintf('is missing the key "%s"', $required), 'Add it' . (is_string($description) ? ': ' . lcfirst($description) : '.'));
            }
        }
        if ($properties === [] && !isset($schema['additionalProperties']) && !isset($schema['propertyNames'])) {
            return;
        }
        foreach ($value as $key => $entry) {
            $key = (string) $key;
            $childPath = $path === '' ? $key : $path . '.' . $key;
            if (isset($properties[$key])) {
                $this->check($entry, $this->object($properties[$key]), $root, $catalog, $file, $childPath);
                continue;
            }
            if (isset($schema['propertyNames'])) {
                $this->checkPropertyName($key, $this->object($schema['propertyNames']), $root, $catalog, $file, $path);
            }

use Symfony\Component\Yaml\Yaml;

/**

 */
final class DocumentLoader
{
    /**
     * Creates a loader, optionally with a shared validator.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?SchemaValidator $validator = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the mapping a file holds once it passes the named schema.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     * @throws LintException when the file is missing, not YAML, or departs from the schema
     */
    public function load(string $path, string $schemaName, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_file($path)) {
            $hint = $schemaName === SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS ? 'Run decisions-lint init to create it, or pass --config.' : 'Check that the path is relative to the file that imports it.';
