use JsonException;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Loads the configuration, plans the questions, asks the provider and writes the report.
 */
final class CheckRun
{
    /**
     * Creates a run that reaches the provider over a transport, or over cURL when none is given.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Runs a check and returns 1 when a finding reaches the failing severity, 0 otherwise.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths paths to lint instead of the configured ones, or empty
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds rule ids to run instead of every enabled rule, or empty
     * @param ?string $failOn the severity that fails the run, or null for the configured one
     * @throws LintException when the configuration, an input or the provider is invalid
     * @throws JsonException when the report cannot be encoded
     */
    public function run(string $configPath, string $format, array $paths, array $ruleIds, ?string $failOn, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $configuration = (new ConfigurationLoader())->load($configPath);
        $failOn = $this->failOn($failOn ?? $configuration->failOn);
        $plan = (new Planner())->plan($configuration, $paths, $ruleIds);
        $decision = (new ProviderFactory())->create($configuration->provider, $this->transport($configuration));
        $report = (new Linter())->lint($plan, $decision, $failOn);
        $output->write((new ReporterFactory())->create($format)->render($report, $output->isDecorated()), false, OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

        return $report->failed() ? 1 : 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the transport to use: the injected one, or cURL with the configured timeout and concurrency.
     */
    public function transport(Configuration $configuration): Transport
    {
        return $this->transport ?? new CurlTransport($configuration->provider->concurrency, $configuration->provider->timeout);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a failing severity, rejecting one that is not a severity or never.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the value is unknown
     */
    public function failOn(string $failOn): string
    {
        if ($failOn !== 'never' && !in_array($failOn, Severity::ALL, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --fail-on "%s". Use --fail-on=%s or never.', $failOn, implode(', ', Severity::ALL)));
        }

        return $failOn;
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Writes a starting decisions.yaml that imports the shipped rule files.
 */
final class InitCommand extends LintCommand
{
    /**
     * Creates the init command for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory, private ?string $rulesDirectory = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($directory, 'init');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the description and options.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setDescription('Create a decisions.yaml that imports the shipped rule files');
        $this->addConfigOption();
        $this->addOption('provider', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Decision API: ' . implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES), ProviderSettings::JEV);
        $this->addOption('path', 'p', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED | InputOption::VALUE_IS_ARRAY, 'Directory to lint; repeat for several', ['src']);
    }

    /**
     * Writes the configuration, refusing to overwrite one.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the file exists, the provider is unknown, or the file cannot be written
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $path = $this->configPath($input);
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s already exists. Edit it, or pass --config to write another file.', $path));
        }
        $provider = $input->getOption('provider');
        if (!is_string($provider) || !in_array($provider, ProviderSettings::NAMES, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --provider "%s". Use --provider=%s.', is_string($provider) ? $provider : '', implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES)));
        }
        $paths = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getOption('path')) ? $input->getOption('path') : [] as $entry) {
            if (is_string($entry) && trim($entry) !== '') {
                $paths[] = trim($entry);
            }
        }
        $content = $this->document(ProviderSettings::defaults($provider), $paths === [] ? ['src'] : $paths, $this->imports(dirname($path)));
        if (file_put_contents($path, $content) === false) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not write %s. Check the directory permissions.', $path));
        }
        $output->writeln(sprintf('Wrote %s. Export %s, review the imported rules with decisions-lint rules, then run decisions-lint check.', $path, ProviderSettings::defaults($provider)->apiKeyEnv), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the YAML of a starting configuration.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths
     * @param list<string> $imports
     */
    public function document(ProviderSettings $provider, array $paths, array $imports): string
    {
        $lines = [
            '# yaml-language-server: $schema=' . $this->schemaPath($imports),
            '# Nuanced rules judged by a decision model. Imported rules can be overridden below by id.',
            'version: 1',
            'provider:',
            '  name: ' . $provider->name,
            '  model: ' . $provider->model,
            '  api_key_env: ' . $provider->apiKeyEnv,
            'paths:',
        ];
        foreach ($paths as $entry) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $entry;
        }
        $lines[] = 'exclude: []';
        $lines[] = 'fail_on: error';
        $lines[] = $imports === [] ? 'imports: []' : 'imports:';
        foreach ($imports as $import) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $import;
        }
        $lines[] = 'rules: {}';

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Returns the shipped rule files as paths relative to the configuration directory.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function imports(string $directory): array
    {
        $rules = $this->rulesDirectory ?? dirname(__DIR__, 3) . '/rules';
        $vendor = $directory . '/vendor/k-kinzal/decisions-lint/rules';
        $prefix = is_dir($vendor) ? 'vendor/k-kinzal/decisions-lint/rules' : $this->relative($directory, $rules);
        $imports = [];
        foreach (glob($rules . '/*.yaml') ?: [] as $file) {
            $imports[] = $prefix . '/' . basename($file);
        }
        sort($imports);

        return $imports;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the schema path the editor hint points to, next to the imported rules.
     *
     * @param list<string> $imports
     */
    public function schemaPath(array $imports): string
    {
        return $imports === [] ? 'https://k-kinzal.github.io/php-ai-toolkit/decisions-lint/decisions.schema.json' : dirname(dirname($imports[0])) . '/schema/decisions.schema.json';
    }

    /**
     * Returns a path relative to a directory, using .. where needed.
     */
    public function relative(string $from, string $to): string
    {
        $fromParts = explode('/', trim((string) (realpath($from) ?: $from), '/'));
        $toParts = explode('/', trim((string) (realpath($to) ?: $to), '/'));
        while ($fromParts !== [] && $toParts !== [] && $fromParts[0] === $toParts[0]) {
            array_shift($fromParts);
            array_shift($toParts);
        }

        return implode('/', array_merge(array_fill(0, count($fromParts), '..'), $toParts));
    }
}

        while ($fromParts !== [] && $toParts !== [] && $fromParts[0] === $toParts[0]) {
            array_shift($fromParts);
            array_shift($toParts);
        }

        return implode('/', array_merge(array_fill(0, count($fromParts), '..'), $toParts));
    }

     * caller that runs the console in-process still gets --quiet, --verbose

    public function restoreShellVerbosity($process, $env, $server): void

            $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] = $server;
        }
    }

    public function output(): OutputInterface

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use Closure;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArgvInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * The public decisions-lint command boundary.
 *
 * It builds the Symfony Console application for a project directory and
 * runs it in-process, writing to the process streams or to one injected sink,
 * and reaching the provider over cURL or over one injected transport.
 */
final class Application
{
    /**
     * @param ?Closure(string): void $output receives standard output and standard error, or null for the process streams
     * @param ?Transport $transport reaches the provider, or null for cURL
     */
    public function __construct(private string $directory, private ?Closure $output = null, private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command line and returns its exit code.
     *
     * @param list<string> $arguments arguments without the executable name
     */
    public function run(array $arguments): int
    {
        return $this->console()->doRun(new ArgvInput(array_merge(['decisions-lint'], $arguments)), $this->output());
    }

    /**
     * Builds the console application with the decisions-lint commands.
     */
    public function console(): DecisionsConsole
    {
        return new DecisionsConsole($this->directory, $this->transport);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the output the run writes to: the process streams, or the injected sink.
     */
    public function output(): OutputInterface
    {
        return $this->output === null ? new ConsoleOutput() : new ClosureOutput($this->output);
    }
}

# A class name is a promise about what the class does. These rules ask the
# decision model whether each public member keeps that promise.
version: 1
rules:
  cohesion.method-belongs-to-class:
    description: A public method does the kind of work its class name promises.
    severity: warning
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class
    decision:
      type: predicate
      instructions: >-
        The class {class} is named for one responsibility. Read the whole class,
        then judge whether the public method {name} is an operation a reader
        would expect {class} to own. Yes when the method is part of the
        responsibility the class name states, or supports it directly. No when
        the method serves another concept and would read as misplaced, such as
        a method that formats output, sends mail or persists data in a class
        named for analysis.
      threshold: 0.7
    violations:
      - answer: false
        message: 'Method {name}() does not belong to {class}: it is not part of the responsibility the class name promises.'
        fix: 'Move {name}() to the class that owns that responsibility and have {class} call it, or rename {class} so its name covers {name}().'

  cohesion.property-belongs-to-class:
    description: A property holds state the class needs for its own responsibility.
    severity: info
    target:
      kind: property
    context: class
    decision:
      type: predicate
      instructions: >-
        Read the class {class}. Judge whether the property {name} holds state
        {class} needs to carry out the responsibility its name states. Yes
        when the methods of the class read or write it for that purpose. No
        when it exists only to pass data through to another concept, caches
        something unrelated, or is never used by the class's own behaviour.
      threshold: 0.75
    violations:
      - answer: false
        message: 'Property {name} of {class} holds state that is not part of the class''s responsibility.'
        fix: 'Move {name} to the class whose behaviour uses it, or pass the value as a parameter where it is needed.'

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/rules.schema.json
# Domain-driven design keeps business rules in the domain layer. These rules
# ask the decision model what kind of knowledge each use case and repository
# method encodes, which no static analyser can tell from the syntax.
version: 1
rules:
  ddd.usecase-domain-leak:
    description: A use case coordinates the domain; it does not encode business rules or talk to infrastructure itself.
    severity: error
    paths:
      - 'src/**/UseCase/**/*.php'
      - 'src/**/UseCases/**/*.php'
      - 'src/**/Application/**/*.php'
      - 'src/**/*UseCase.php'
      - 'src/**/*Handler.php'
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class
    decision:
      type: choice
      instructions: >-
        {class}::{name} is a use case method in an application layer. Classify
        the knowledge its body encodes. Delegating to repositories, domain
        services, entities and value objects is orchestration. A conditional,
        calculation or validation that expresses a business policy, such as a
        discount, an eligibility check or a state transition, is a domain
        rule. Building SQL, HTTP calls, file paths or framework specifics is
        infrastructure.
      choices:
        orchestration: Loads domain objects, calls their behaviour, persists results and returns; contains no business policy of its own.
        domain_rule: Encodes a business rule, invariant, calculation or policy that belongs in an entity, value object or domain service.
        infrastructure: Contains database, HTTP, file system or framework details that belong behind a repository or gateway interface.
      threshold: 0.6
    violations:
      - answer: domain_rule
        message: 'Use case {class}::{name} encodes a business rule that belongs in the domain layer.'
        fix: 'Move the rule into the entity, value object or domain service it describes, and have {name}() call that method so the use case only orchestrates.'
      - answer: infrastructure
        message: 'Use case {class}::{name} talks to infrastructure directly.'
        fix: 'Put the database, HTTP or file access behind a repository or gateway interface in the domain layer, inject the interface into {class}, and call it from {name}().'

  ddd.repository-business-rule:
    description: A repository loads and stores aggregates; it does not decide business outcomes.
    severity: warning
    paths:
      - 'src/**/*Repository.php'
    exclude:
      - 'src/**/*RepositoryInterface.php'
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class
    decision:
      type: predicate
      instructions: >-
        {class} is a repository. Judge whether the method {name} stays within
        persistence: finding, loading, saving, deleting or counting aggregates,
        including query criteria. Yes when it does. No when it applies a
        business policy, such as deciding eligibility, computing a price or
        changing an aggregate's state based on a rule.
      threshold: 0.7
    violations:
      - answer: false
        message: 'Repository method {class}::{name} applies a business rule instead of only persisting aggregates.'
        fix: 'Move the decision into the aggregate or a domain service, and reduce {name}() to loading or storing what that code needs.'

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/rules.schema.json
# A name is read far more often than its body. These rules ask the decision
# model how well each name states what the code actually does.
version: 1
rules:
  naming.method-says-what-it-does:
    description: A method name states what the method does, so a caller need not read the body.
    severity: warning
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public, protected]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: declaration
    decision:
      type: score
      instructions: >-
        Read the method {name} of {class} with its signature and body. Rate how
        well the name tells a caller what the method does and returns.
      levels:
        - The name misleads; the body does something the name does not say, or omits a side effect such as writing or sending.
        - The name is vague; words such as handle, process, manage, do or data leave the caller to read the body.
        - The name states what the method does and what it returns; the body matches it.
      threshold: 0.5
    violations:
      - max_score: 0.5
        message: 'Method {name}() of {class} does something its name does not say.'
        fix: 'Rename {name}() after what the body actually does, including any side effect, or split the body so one name covers it.'
      - min_score: 0.5
        max_score: 1.5
        message: 'Method name {name}() is too vague to tell a caller what it does.'
        fix: 'Rename {name}() with a verb and object that state the effect and the result, such as calculateTotal or sendInvoice.'

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use Closure;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Formatter\OutputFormatterInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleSectionOutput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\Output;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Console output that hands every written message to a closure.
 *
 * It lets the console application write into a sink a caller injected, with
 * standard error kept apart when the caller gives one.
 */
final class ClosureOutput extends Output implements ConsoleOutputInterface
{
    /** @readonly */
    private Closure $sink;

    private OutputInterface $errorOutput;

    /**
     * Creates an output that writes to a sink, and its errors to another output.
     *
     * @param Closure(string): void $sink receives every written message
     * @param ?OutputInterface $errorOutput receives the errors, or null to keep them in this output
     */
    public function __construct(Closure $sink, ?OutputInterface $errorOutput = null)
    {
        parent::__construct();
        $this->sink = $sink;
        $this->errorOutput = $errorOutput ?? $this;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the output the errors are written to.
     */
    public function getErrorOutput(): OutputInterface
    {
        return $this->errorOutput;
    }

    /**
     * Replaces the output the errors are written to.
     */
    public function setErrorOutput(OutputInterface $error): void
    {
        $this->errorOutput = $error;
    }

    /**
     * Refuses sections, which need a terminal stream to redraw.
     *
     * @throws LintException always
     */
    public function section(): ConsoleSectionOutput
    {
        throw new LintException('Output sections need a terminal stream; write to the console output instead.');
    }

    /**
     * Sets the verbosity of this output and of its error output.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function setVerbosity(int $level): void
    {
        parent::setVerbosity($level);
        if ($this->errorOutput !== $this) {
            $this->errorOutput->setVerbosity($level);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Turns decoration on or off for this output and its error output.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function setDecorated(bool $decorated): void
    {
        parent::setDecorated($decorated);
        if ($this->errorOutput !== $this) {
            $this->errorOutput->setDecorated($decorated);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Sets the formatter of this output and of its error output.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function setFormatter(OutputFormatterInterface $formatter): void
    {
        parent::setFormatter($formatter);
        if ($this->errorOutput !== $this) {
            $this->errorOutput->setFormatter($formatter);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Hands one formatted message to the sink.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function doWrite(string $message, bool $newline): void
    {
        ($this->sink)($newline ? $message . "\n" : $message);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

/**
 * Detects agent sessions using the same markers as the toolkit reporters.
 */
final class FormatDetector
{
    /**
     * @var list<string>
     */
    private const MARKERS = [
        'AI_AGENT', 'CLAUDE_CODE', 'CLAUDECODE', 'CURSOR_TRACE_ID', 'CURSOR_AGENT',
        'GEMINI_CLI', 'CODEX_SANDBOX', 'CODEX_THREAD_ID', 'AUGMENT_AGENT', 'OPENCODE',
        'DEVIN', 'WINDSURF_SESSION_ID', 'AIDER', 'CLINE', 'CONTINUE_GLOBAL_DIR',
    ];

    /**
     * Returns the compact agent format or the human format for this invocation.
     */
    public function detect(): string
    {
        foreach (self::MARKERS as $marker) {
            $value = getenv($marker);
            if ($value !== false && ($marker !== 'AI_AGENT' || trim($value) !== '')) {
                return 'ai';
            }
        }

        return is_file('/opt/.devin') || is_dir('/opt/.devin') ? 'ai' : 'text';
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Cli\FormatDetector;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Reporting\ReporterFactory;
use JsonException;
use Override;
use RuntimeException;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Completion\CompletionInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Completion\CompletionSuggestions;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Exception\ExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * A decisions-lint console command: shared options, error reporting and exit codes.
 *
 * Every failure is reported in one line on standard error that names the
 * problem and how to fix it, and exits 2, so a caller can tell a broken
 * command line, configuration or provider apart from a violated rule, which exits 1.
 */
abstract class LintCommand extends Command
{
    /**
     * The configuration a command reads when --config is not given.
     */
    public const DEFAULT_CONFIG = 'decisions.yaml';

    /**
     * The exit code of an invalid command line, configuration, rule file or provider response.
     */
    public const INVALID = 2;

    /**
     * Creates a command that works on one project directory.
     *
     * @param ?Transport $transport the transport to reach the provider with, or null for cURL
     */
    public function __construct(private string $directory, string $name, private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($name);
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command, reporting a command line it cannot read.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function run(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        try {
            return parent::run($input, $output);
        } catch (ExceptionInterface $exception) {
            $this->error($output, $exception->getMessage(), sprintf('Run "decisions-lint %s --help" to see its options.', $this->getName() ?? ''));

            return self::INVALID;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Suggests the values of the options every command shares.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function complete(CompletionInput $input, CompletionSuggestions $suggestions): void
    {
        if ($input->mustSuggestOptionValuesFor('format')) {
            $suggestions->suggestValues(ReporterFactory::FORMATS);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Returns the project directory the command works on.
     */
    public function directory(): string
    {
        return $this->directory;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the injected transport, or null when the provider is reached over cURL.
     */
    public function transport(): ?Transport
    {
        return $this->transport;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the absolute path of the configuration --config names.
     *
     * @throws LintException when --config was given an empty value
     */
    public function configPath(InputInterface $input): string
    {
        $config = $input->getOption('config');
        if (!is_string($config) || $config === '') {
            throw new LintException('Provide a non-empty --config path, such as --config=decisions.yaml.');
        }

        return str_starts_with($config, '/') ? $config : $this->directory . '/' . $config;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the output format --format names, or the one the session suggests.
     *
     * @param list<string> $allowed the formats this command supports
     * @throws LintException when the format is not supported
     */
    public function format(InputInterface $input, array $allowed): string
    {
        $format = $input->getOption('format');
        if ($format === null) {
            $detected = (new FormatDetector())->detect();

            return in_array($detected, $allowed, true) ? $detected : 'text';
        }
        if (!is_string($format) || !in_array($format, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --format "%s". Use --format=%s.', is_string($format) ? $format : '', implode(', ', $allowed)));
        }

        return $format;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rule ids --rule names.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     * @throws LintException when --rule was given an empty value
     */
    public function ruleIds(InputInterface $input): array
    {
        $ids = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getOption('rule')) ? $input->getOption('rule') : [] as $id) {
            if (!is_string($id) || trim($id) === '') {
                throw new LintException('Provide a rule id for --rule, such as --rule=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class.');
            }
            $ids[] = trim($id);
        }

        return $ids;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the paths given as arguments, relative to the configuration directory.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function paths(InputInterface $input): array
    {
        $paths = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getArgument('paths')) ? $input->getArgument('paths') : [] as $path) {
            if (is_string($path) && trim($path) !== '') {
                $paths[] = trim($path);
            }
        }

        return $paths;
    }

    /**
     * Writes one error to standard error, visible even under --quiet.
     */
    public function error(OutputInterface $output, string $message, string ...$hints): void
    {
        $errorOutput = $output instanceof ConsoleOutputInterface ? $output->getErrorOutput() : $output;
        $errorOutput->writeln(array_merge(['Decisions error: ' . $message], $hints), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW | OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_QUIET);
    }

    /**
     * Declares the --config option.
     */
    protected function addConfigOption(): void
    {
        $this->addOption('config', 'c', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Configuration file, relative to the working directory', self::DEFAULT_CONFIG);
    }

    /**
     * Declares the --format option with the formats a command supports.
     *
     * @param list<string> $formats
     */
    protected function addFormatOption(array $formats): void
    {
        $this->addOption('format', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Output format: ' . implode(', ', $formats) . '; defaults to ai in agent sessions');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the repeatable --rule option.
     */
    protected function addRuleOption(): void
    {
        $this->addOption('rule', 'r', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED | InputOption::VALUE_IS_ARRAY, 'Run only this rule id; repeat for several');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the optional paths argument.
     */
    protected function addPathsArgument(): void
    {
        $this->addArgument('paths', InputArgument::IS_ARRAY | InputArgument::OPTIONAL, 'Files, directories or globs relative to the configuration directory; defaults to the configured paths');
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command, reporting an invalid configuration, rule file or provider response.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        try {
            return $this->handle($input, $output);
        } catch (RuntimeException | JsonException $exception) {
            $this->error($output, $exception->getMessage());

            return self::INVALID;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Does the work of the command.
     *
     * @throws RuntimeException when the configuration, a rule file, an input or a provider response is invalid
     * @throws JsonException when a report cannot be encoded
     */
    abstract protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int;
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use DecisionsLint\Config\Configuration;
use DecisionsLint\Config\ConfigurationLoader;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Severity;
use DecisionsLint\Http\CurlTransport;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Lint\Linter;
use DecisionsLint\Lint\Planner;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\ProviderFactory;
use DecisionsLint\Reporting\ReporterFactory;
use JsonException;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Loads the configuration, plans the questions, asks the provider and writes the report.
 */
final class CheckRun
{
    /**
     * Creates a run that reaches the provider over a transport, or over cURL when none is given.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Runs a check and returns 1 when a finding reaches the failing severity, 0 otherwise.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths paths to lint instead of the configured ones, or empty
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds rule ids to run instead of every enabled rule, or empty
     * @param ?string $failOn the severity that fails the run, or null for the configured one
     * @throws LintException when the configuration, an input or the provider is invalid
     * @throws JsonException when the report cannot be encoded
     */
    public function run(string $configPath, string $format, array $paths, array $ruleIds, ?string $failOn, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $configuration = (new ConfigurationLoader())->load($configPath);
        $failOn = $this->failOn($failOn ?? $configuration->failOn);
        $plan = (new Planner())->plan($configuration, $paths, $ruleIds);
        $decision = (new ProviderFactory())->create($configuration->provider, $this->transport($configuration));
        $report = (new Linter())->lint($plan, $decision, $failOn);
        $output->write((new ReporterFactory())->create($format)->render($report, $output->isDecorated()), false, OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

        return $report->failed() ? 1 : 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the transport to use: the injected one, or cURL with the configured timeout and concurrency.
     */
    public function transport(Configuration $configuration): Transport
    {
        return $this->transport ?? new CurlTransport($configuration->provider->concurrency, $configuration->provider->timeout);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a failing severity, rejecting one that is not a severity or never.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the value is unknown
     */
    public function failOn(string $failOn): string
    {
        if ($failOn !== 'never' && !in_array($failOn, Severity::ALL, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --fail-on "%s". Use --fail-on=%s or never.', $failOn, implode(', ', Severity::ALL)));
        }

        return $failOn;
    }
}

    {

        $this->addFormatOption(ReporterFactory::FORMATS);

        $this->addPathsArgument();

        }

        return (new CheckRun($this->transport()))->run($this->configPath($input), $this->format($input, ReporterFactory::FORMATS), $this->paths($input), $this->ruleIds($input), is_string($failOn) ? trim($failOn) : null, $output);
    }

     */
    #[Override]
    protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $configPath = $this->configPath($input);
        $configuration = (new ConfigurationLoader())->load($configPath);
        $enabled = count($configuration->activeRules());
        $output->writeln(sprintf('%s is valid: %d %s, %d enabled, provider %s (%s).', basename($configPath), count($configuration->rules), count($configuration->rules) === 1 ? 'rule' : 'rules', $enabled, $configuration->provider->name, $configuration->provider->model), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);
        $loader = new DocumentLoader();
        $reader = new RuleReader();
        foreach ($this->files($input) as $file) {
            $path = str_starts_with($file, '/') ? $file : $this->directory() . '/' . $file;
            $document = $loader->load($path, SchemaCatalog::RULES, $file);
            $rules = is_array($document['rules'] ?? null) ? $document['rules'] : [];
            foreach ($rules as $id => $definition) {
                $reader->read((string) $id, is_array($definition) ? ['source' => [$file]] + $this->mapping($definition) : []);
            }
            $output->writeln(sprintf('%s is valid: %d %s.', $file, count($rules), count($rules) === 1 ? 'rule' : 'rules'), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rule files given as arguments.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function files(InputInterface $input): array
    {
        $files = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getArgument('files')) ? $input->getArgument('files') : [] as $file) {
            if (is_string($file) && trim($file) !== '') {
                $files[] = trim($file);
            }
        }

        return $files;
    }

    /**
     * Reads an array as a mapping with string keys.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $value
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function mapping(array $value): array
    {
        $mapping = [];
        foreach ($value as $key => $entry) {
            $mapping[(string) $key] = $entry;
        }

        return $mapping;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Provider\ProviderSettings;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Writes a starting decisions.yaml that imports the shipped rule files.
 */
final class InitCommand extends LintCommand
{
    /**
     * Creates the init command for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory, private ?string $rulesDirectory = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($directory, 'init');
    }

    /**
     * Declares the description and options.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setDescription('Create a decisions.yaml that imports the shipped rule files');
        $this->addConfigOption();
        $this->addOption('provider', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Decision API: ' . implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES), ProviderSettings::JEV);
        $this->addOption('path', 'p', InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED | InputOption::VALUE_IS_ARRAY, 'Directory to lint; repeat for several', ['src']);
    }

    /**
     * Writes the configuration, refusing to overwrite one.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the file exists, the provider is unknown, or the file cannot be written
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $path = $this->configPath($input);
        if (file_exists($path)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s already exists. Edit it, or pass --config to write another file.', $path));
        }
        $provider = $input->getOption('provider');
        if (!is_string($provider) || !in_array($provider, ProviderSettings::NAMES, true)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Unsupported --provider "%s". Use --provider=%s.', is_string($provider) ? $provider : '', implode(' or ', ProviderSettings::NAMES)));
        }
        $paths = [];
        foreach (is_array($input->getOption('path')) ? $input->getOption('path') : [] as $entry) {
            if (is_string($entry) && trim($entry) !== '') {
                $paths[] = trim($entry);
            }
        }
        $content = $this->document(ProviderSettings::defaults($provider), $paths === [] ? ['src'] : $paths, $this->imports(dirname($path)));
        if (file_put_contents($path, $content) === false) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not write %s. Check the directory permissions.', $path));
        }
        $output->writeln(sprintf('Wrote %s. Export %s, review the imported rules with decisions-lint rules, then run decisions-lint check.', $path, ProviderSettings::defaults($provider)->apiKeyEnv), OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW);

        return 0;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the YAML of a starting configuration.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths
     * @param list<string> $imports
     */
    public function document(ProviderSettings $provider, array $paths, array $imports): string
    {
        $lines = [
            '# yaml-language-server: $schema=' . $this->schemaPath($imports),
            '# Nuanced rules judged by a decision model. Imported rules can be overridden below by id.',
            'version: 1',
            'provider:',
            '  name: ' . $provider->name,
            '  model: ' . $provider->model,
            '  api_key_env: ' . $provider->apiKeyEnv,
            'paths:',
        ];
        foreach ($paths as $entry) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $entry;
        }
        $lines[] = 'exclude: []';
        $lines[] = 'fail_on: error';
        $lines[] = $imports === [] ? 'imports: []' : 'imports:';
        foreach ($imports as $import) {
            $lines[] = '  - ' . $import;
        }
        $lines[] = 'rules: {}';

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Returns the shipped rule files as paths relative to the configuration directory.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function imports(string $directory): array
    {
        $rules = $this->rulesDirectory ?? dirname(__DIR__, 3) . '/rules';
        $vendor = $directory . '/vendor/k-kinzal/decisions-lint/rules';
        $prefix = is_dir($vendor) ? 'vendor/k-kinzal/decisions-lint/rules' : $this->relative($directory, $rules);
        $imports = [];
        foreach (glob($rules . '/*.yaml') ?: [] as $file) {
            $imports[] = $prefix . '/' . basename($file);
        }
        sort($imports);

        return $imports;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the schema path the editor hint points to, next to the imported rules.
     *
     * @param list<string> $imports
     */
    public function schemaPath(array $imports): string
    {
        return $imports === [] ? 'https://k-kinzal.github.io/php-ai-toolkit/decisions-lint/decisions.schema.json' : dirname(dirname($imports[0])) . '/schema/decisions.schema.json';
    }

    /**
     * Returns a path relative to a directory, using .. where needed.
     */
    public function relative(string $from, string $to): string
    {
        $fromParts = explode('/', trim((string) (realpath($from) ?: $from), '/'));
        $toParts = explode('/', trim((string) (realpath($to) ?: $to), '/'));
        while ($fromParts !== [] && $toParts !== [] && $fromParts[0] === $toParts[0]) {
            array_shift($fromParts);
            array_shift($toParts);
        }

        return implode('/', array_merge(array_fill(0, count($fromParts), '..'), $toParts));
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\CheckCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\InitCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\LintCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\PlanCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\RulesCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\ValidateCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Application as ConsoleApplication;
use Symfony\Component\Console\CommandLoader\FactoryCommandLoader;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArrayInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputDefinition;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * The Symfony Console application with the check, plan, rules, validate and init commands.
 *
 * decisions-lint alone runs check, decisions-lint --help lists the commands,
 * and a command name it does not know exits 2.
 */
final class DecisionsConsole extends ConsoleApplication
{
    /**
     * The version the CLI reports.
     */
    public const VERSION = '1.0.0';

    /**
     * Creates the console for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory, ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
        parent::__construct('decisions-lint', self::VERSION);
        $this->setAutoExit(false);
        $this->setCommandLoader(new FactoryCommandLoader([
            'check' => static fn (): CheckCommand => new CheckCommand($directory, $transport),
            'plan' => static fn (): PlanCommand => new PlanCommand($directory),
            'rules' => static fn (): RulesCommand => new RulesCommand($directory),
            'validate' => static fn (): ValidateCommand => new ValidateCommand($directory),
            'init' => static fn (): InitCommand => new InitCommand($directory),
        ]));
        $this->setDefaultCommand('check');
    }

    /**
     * Returns the text decisions-lint list opens with.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function getHelp(): string
    {
        return $this->getLongVersion() . "\n\nJudges PHP code against nuanced rules with a decision model, as configured in decisions.yaml. Running decisions-lint without a command runs check.";
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command the input names.
     *
     * The input and output are configured here as well as in run(), so a
     * caller that runs the console in-process still gets --quiet, --verbose
     * and --no-ansi honoured. The verbosity Symfony Console leaves in the
     * environment is put back afterwards, so one in-process run does not
     * silence the next.
     */
    #[Override]
    public function doRun(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $shellVerbosity = [getenv('SHELL_VERBOSITY'), $_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] ?? null, $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] ?? null];
        $this->configureIO($input, $output);
        try {
            $name = $this->getCommandName($input);
            if ($name === null && $input->hasParameterOption(['--help', '-h'], true)) {
                return parent::doRun(new ArrayInput(['command' => 'list']), $output);
            }
            $problem = $name === null ? null : $this->unknownCommand($name);
            if ($problem !== null) {
                $errorOutput = $output instanceof ConsoleOutputInterface ? $output->getErrorOutput() : $output;
                $errorOutput->writeln(['Decisions error: ' . $problem, 'Run "decisions-lint list" to see the available commands.'], OutputInterface::OUTPUT_RAW | OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_QUIET);

                return LintCommand::INVALID;
            }

            return parent::doRun($input, $output);
        } finally {
            $this->restoreShellVerbosity(...$shellVerbosity);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Explains why a command name names no single command, or returns null when it does.
     */
    public function unknownCommand(string $name): ?string
    {
        $names = array_keys($this->all());
        if (in_array($name, $names, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        $matches = array_values(array_filter($names, static fn (string $command): bool => str_starts_with($command, $name) && !str_starts_with($command, '_')));
        if (count($matches) === 1) {
            return null;
        }
        if ($matches !== []) {
            sort($matches);

            return sprintf('Command "%s" is ambiguous. Name one of: %s.', $name, implode(', ', $matches));
        }
        $similar = array_values(array_filter($names, static fn (string $command): bool => !str_starts_with($command, '_') && levenshtein($name, $command) <= max(2, intdiv(strlen($name), 3))));

        return sprintf('Command "%s" is not defined.', $name) . ($similar === [] ? '' : sprintf(' Did you mean %s?', implode(' or ', $similar)));
    }

    /**
     * Returns the global options, with --help described the way decisions-lint treats it.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function getDefaultInputDefinition(): InputDefinition
    {
        $definition = parent::getDefaultInputDefinition();
        $options = $definition->getOptions();
        $options['help'] = new InputOption('help', 'h', InputOption::VALUE_NONE, 'Display help for the given command, or list the commands when none is given');
        $definition->setOptions(array_values($options));

        return $definition;
    }

    /**
     * Puts the shell verbosity of the environment back to what it was.
     *
     * @param false|string $process the process environment value, or false when unset
     * @param mixed $env the $_ENV value, or null when unset
     * @param mixed $server the $_SERVER value, or null when unset
     */
    public function restoreShellVerbosity($process, $env, $server): void
    {
        putenv($process === false ? 'SHELL_VERBOSITY' : 'SHELL_VERBOSITY=' . $process);
        unset($_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'], $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY']);
        if ($env !== null) {
            $_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] = $env;
        }
        if ($server !== null) {
            $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY'] = $server;
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli;

use Closure;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArgvInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\ConsoleOutput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * The public decisions-lint command boundary.
 *
 * It builds the Symfony Console application for a project directory and
 * runs it in-process, writing to the process streams or to one injected sink,
 * and reaching the provider over cURL or over one injected transport.
 */
final class Application
{
    /**
     * @param ?Closure(string): void $output receives standard output and standard error, or null for the process streams
     * @param ?Transport $transport reaches the provider, or null for cURL
     */
    public function __construct(private string $directory, private ?Closure $output = null, private ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Runs the command line and returns its exit code.
     *
     * @param list<string> $arguments arguments without the executable name
     */
    public function run(array $arguments): int
    {
        return $this->console()->doRun(new ArgvInput(array_merge(['decisions-lint'], $arguments)), $this->output());
    }

    /**
     * Builds the console application with the decisions-lint commands.
     */
    public function console(): DecisionsConsole
    {
        return new DecisionsConsole($this->directory, $this->transport);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the output the run writes to: the process streams, or the injected sink.
     */
    public function output(): OutputInterface
    {
        return $this->output === null ? new ConsoleOutput() : new ClosureOutput($this->output);
    }
}

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/rules.schema.json
# A class name is a promise about what the class does. These rules ask the
# decision model whether each public member keeps that promise.
version: 1
rules:
  cohesion.method-belongs-to-class:
    description: A public method does the kind of work its class name promises.
    severity: warning
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class
    decision:
      type: predicate
      instructions: >-
        The class {class} is named for one responsibility. Read the whole class,
        then judge whether the public method {name} is an operation a reader
        would expect {class} to own. Yes when the method is part of the
        responsibility the class name states, or supports it directly. No when
        the method serves another concept and would read as misplaced, such as
        a method that formats output, sends mail or persists data in a class
        named for analysis.
      threshold: 0.7
    violations:
      - answer: false
        message: 'Method {name}() does not belong to {class}: it is not part of the responsibility the class name promises.'
        fix: 'Move {name}() to the class that owns that responsibility and have {class} call it, or rename {class} so its name covers {name}().'

  cohesion.property-belongs-to-class:
    description: A property holds state the class needs for its own responsibility.
    severity: info
    target:
      kind: property
    context: class
    decision:
      type: predicate
      instructions: >-
        Read the class {class}. Judge whether the property {name} holds state
        {class} needs to carry out the responsibility its name states. Yes
        when the methods of the class read or write it for that purpose. No
        when it exists only to pass data through to another concept, caches
        something unrelated, or is never used by the class's own behaviour.
      threshold: 0.75
    violations:
      - answer: false
        message: 'Property {name} of {class} holds state that is not part of the class''s responsibility.'
        fix: 'Move {name} to the class whose behaviour uses it, or pass the value as a parameter where it is needed.'

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/rules.schema.json
# Domain-driven design keeps business rules in the domain layer. These rules
# ask the decision model what kind of knowledge each use case and repository
# method encodes, which no static analyser can tell from the syntax.
version: 1
rules:
  ddd.usecase-domain-leak:
    description: A use case coordinates the domain; it does not encode business rules or talk to infrastructure itself.
    severity: error
    paths:
      - 'src/**/UseCase/**/*.php'
      - 'src/**/UseCases/**/*.php'
      - 'src/**/Application/**/*.php'
      - 'src/**/*UseCase.php'
      - 'src/**/*Handler.php'
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class
    decision:
      type: choice
      instructions: >-
        {class}::{name} is a use case method in an application layer. Classify
        the knowledge its body encodes. Delegating to repositories, domain
        services, entities and value objects is orchestration. A conditional,
        calculation or validation that expresses a business policy, such as a
        discount, an eligibility check or a state transition, is a domain
        rule. Building SQL, HTTP calls, file paths or framework specifics is
        infrastructure.
      choices:
        orchestration: Loads domain objects, calls their behaviour, persists results and returns; contains no business policy of its own.
        domain_rule: Encodes a business rule, invariant, calculation or policy that belongs in an entity, value object or domain service.
        infrastructure: Contains database, HTTP, file system or framework details that belong behind a repository or gateway interface.
      threshold: 0.6
    violations:
      - answer: domain_rule
        message: 'Use case {class}::{name} encodes a business rule that belongs in the domain layer.'
        fix: 'Move the rule into the entity, value object or domain service it describes, and have {name}() call that method so the use case only orchestrates.'
      - answer: infrastructure
        message: 'Use case {class}::{name} talks to infrastructure directly.'
        fix: 'Put the database, HTTP or file access behind a repository or gateway interface in the domain layer, inject the interface into {class}, and call it from {name}().'

  ddd.repository-business-rule:
    description: A repository loads and stores aggregates; it does not decide business outcomes.
    severity: warning
    paths:
      - 'src/**/*Repository.php'
    exclude:
      - 'src/**/*RepositoryInterface.php'
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: class
    decision:
      type: predicate
      instructions: >-
        {class} is a repository. Judge whether the method {name} stays within
        persistence: finding, loading, saving, deleting or counting aggregates,
        including query criteria. Yes when it does. No when it applies a
        business policy, such as deciding eligibility, computing a price or
        changing an aggregate's state based on a rule.
      threshold: 0.7
    violations:
      - answer: false
        message: 'Repository method {class}::{name} applies a business rule instead of only persisting aggregates.'
        fix: 'Move the decision into the aggregate or a domain service, and reduce {name}() to loading or storing what that code needs.'

# yaml-language-server: $schema=../schema/rules.schema.json
# A name is read far more often than its body. These rules ask the decision
# model how well each name states what the code actually does.
version: 1
rules:
  naming.method-says-what-it-does:
    description: A method name states what the method does, so a caller need not read the body.
    severity: warning
    target:
      kind: method
      visibility: [public, protected]
      exclude_names: ['__*']
    context: declaration
    decision:
      type: score
      instructions: >-
        Read the method {name} of {class} with its signature and body. Rate how
        well the name tells a caller what the method does and returns.
      levels:
        - The name misleads; the body does something the name does not say, or omits a side effect such as writing or sending.
        - The name is vague; words such as handle, process, manage, do or data leave the caller to read the body.
        - The name states what the method does and what it returns; the body matches it.
      threshold: 0.5
    violations:
      - max_score: 0.5
        message: 'Method {name}() of {class} does something its name does not say.'
        fix: 'Rename {name}() after what the body actually does, including any side effect, or split the body so one name covers it.'
      - min_score: 0.5
        max_score: 1.5
        message: 'Method name {name}() is too vague to tell a caller what it does.'
        fix: 'Rename {name}() with a verb and object that state the effect and the result, such as calculateTotal or sendInvoice.'

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Cli\CheckRun;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Reporting\ReporterFactory;
use Override;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputOption;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * Lints the configured files against the rules and reports the violations.
 */
final class CheckCommand extends LintCommand
{
    /**
     * Creates the check command for a project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(string $directory, ?Transport $transport = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($directory, 'check', $transport);
    }

    /**
     * Declares the description, options and arguments.
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->setDescription('Judge the configured files against the rules with the decision model and report violations');
        $this->addConfigOption();
        $this->addFormatOption(ReporterFactory::FORMATS);
        $this->addRuleOption();
        $this->addOption('fail-on', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Weakest severity that exits 1: error, warning, info or never; defaults to fail_on in the configuration');
        $this->addPathsArgument();
    }

    /**
     * Runs the check.
     *
     * @throws LintException when --fail-on is not a severity
     */
    #[Override]
    protected function handle(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $failOn = $input->getOption('fail-on');
        if ($failOn !== null && (!is_string($failOn) || trim($failOn) === '')) {
            throw new LintException('Provide a severity for --fail-on, such as --fail-on=warning.');
        }

        return (new CheckRun($this->transport()))->run($this->configPath($input), $this->format($input, ReporterFactory::FORMATS), $this->paths($input), $this->ruleIds($input), is_string($failOn) ? trim($failOn) : null, $output);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Reads typed fields out of a decoded provider response, naming the field when it is missing or malformed.
 */
final class Payload
{
    /**
     * Creates a reader for one decoded document described by a context such as "Jev answer for rule x".
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    public function __construct(private array $data, private string $context)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Reads a number.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or not a number
     */
    public function float(string $key): float
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_int($value) && !is_float($value)) {
            throw new LintException($this->problem($key, 'a number', $value));
        }

        return (float) $value;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a string.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or not a string
     */
    public function string(string $key): string
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($value)) {
            throw new LintException($this->problem($key, 'a string', $value));
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a string, or returns a default when the field is absent.
     */
    public function stringOr(string $key, string $default): string
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;

        return is_string($value) ? $value : $default;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a mapping or list of values as a nested payload.
     *
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or not an array
     */
    public function nested(string $key): self
    {
        $value = $this->data[$key] ?? null;
        if (!is_array($value)) {
            throw new LintException($this->problem($key, 'a mapping or list', $value));
        }
        $nested = [];
        foreach ($value as $nestedKey => $entry) {
            $nested[(string) $nestedKey] = $entry;
        }

        return new self($nested, $this->context . '.' . $key);
    }

    /**
     * Reads a mapping of names to numbers, such as a probability distribution.
     *
     * @return array<string, float>
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or a value is not a number
     */
    public function floats(string $key): array
    {
        $nested = $this->nested($key);
        $floats = [];
        foreach ($nested->keys() as $name) {
            $floats[$name] = $nested->float($name);
        }

        return $floats;
    }

    /**
     * Reads a list of mappings as nested payloads.
     *
     * @return list<self>
     * @throws LintException when the field is missing or an entry is not a mapping
     */
    public function entries(string $key): array
    {
        $nested = $this->nested($key);
        $entries = [];
        foreach ($nested->keys() as $index) {
            $entries[] = $nested->nested($index);
        }

        return $entries;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the keys of the document.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function keys(): array
    {
        return array_map('strval', array_keys($this->data));
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a field is present.
     */
    public function has(string $key): bool
    {
        return array_key_exists($key, $this->data);
    }

    /**
     * Describes a field that does not hold what the API promised.
     *
     * @param mixed $value
     */
    public function problem(string $key, string $expected, $value): string
    {
        $actual = $value === null ? 'it is missing' : 'it is ' . (is_scalar($value) ? var_export($value, true) : gettype($value));

        return sprintf('%s: field "%s" must be %s, but %s. The provider returned a response this version does not understand; report the response or update decisions-lint.', $this->context, $key, $expected, $actual);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Http;

use CurlHandle;
use CurlMultiHandle;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Sends requests over cURL, several at a time, so a lint run is bounded by the provider and not by one connection.
 */
final class CurlTransport implements Transport
{
    /**
     * Creates a transport that keeps at most a number of requests in flight and gives up on each after a timeout.
     */
    public function __construct(private int $concurrency = 8, private int $timeout = 60)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Sends every request, at most the configured number at a time, and returns the responses in request order.
     *
     * @param list<HttpRequest> $requests
     * @return list<HttpResponse>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails before a response arrives
     */
    public function send(array $requests): array
    {
        $responses = [];
        foreach (array_chunk($requests, max(1, $this->concurrency), true) as $chunk) {
            foreach ($this->sendChunk($chunk) as $index => $response) {
                $responses[$index] = $response;
            }
        }
        ksort($responses);

        return array_values($responses);
    }

    /**
     * Sends one group of requests concurrently and returns the responses keyed like the requests.
     *
     * @param array<int, HttpRequest> $requests
     * @return array<int, HttpResponse>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails before a response arrives
     */
    public function sendChunk(array $requests): array
    {
        $multi = curl_multi_init();
        $handles = [];
        foreach ($requests as $index => $request) {
            $handles[$index] = $this->handle($request);
            curl_multi_add_handle($multi, $handles[$index]);
        }
        $this->drive($multi);

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Http;

use CurlHandle;
use CurlMultiHandle;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Sends requests over cURL, several at a time, so a lint run is bounded by the provider and not by one connection.
 */
final class CurlTransport implements Transport
{
    /**
     * Creates a transport that keeps at most a number of requests in flight and gives up on each after a timeout.
     */
    public function __construct(private int $concurrency = 8, private int $timeout = 60)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Sends every request, at most the configured number at a time, and returns the responses in request order.
     *
     * @param list<HttpRequest> $requests
     * @return list<HttpResponse>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails before a response arrives
     */
    public function send(array $requests): array
    {
        $responses = [];
        foreach (array_chunk($requests, max(1, $this->concurrency), true) as $chunk) {
            foreach ($this->sendChunk($chunk) as $index => $response) {
                $responses[$index] = $response;
            }
        }
        ksort($responses);

        return array_values($responses);
    }

    /**
     * Sends one group of requests concurrently and returns the responses keyed like the requests.
     *
     * @param array<int, HttpRequest> $requests
     * @return array<int, HttpResponse>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails before a response arrives
     */
    public function sendChunk(array $requests): array
    {
        $multi = curl_multi_init();
        $handles = [];
        foreach ($requests as $index => $request) {
            $handles[$index] = $this->handle($request);
            curl_multi_add_handle($multi, $handles[$index]);
        }
        $this->drive($multi);
        $responses = [];
        foreach ($handles as $index => $handle) {
            $responses[$index] = $this->response($handle, $requests[$index]);
            curl_multi_remove_handle($multi, $handle);
        }
        curl_multi_close($multi);

        return $responses;
    }

     * Builds the cURL handle for one request.
     */
    public function handle(HttpRequest $request): CurlHandle
    {
        $handle = curl_init();

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Reporting;

use DecisionsLint\Lint\Report;

/**
 * Renders the report as Checkstyle XML, which editors and CI systems already read.
 */
final class CheckstyleReporter implements Reporter
{
    /**
     * Returns a `checkstyle` document with one `file` element per path and one `error` element per finding.
     */
    public function render(Report $report, bool $decorated): string
    {
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($report->findings as $finding) {
            $groups[$finding->path][] = $finding;
        }
        $lines = ['<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>', '<checkstyle version="decisions-lint">'];
        foreach ($groups as $path => $findings) {
            $lines[] = '  <file name="' . $this->escape((string) $path) . '">';
            foreach ($findings as $finding) {
                $lines[] = sprintf('    <error line="%d" column="%d" severity="%s" message="%s" source="%s"/>', $finding->line, $finding->column, $finding->severity, $this->escape($finding->message . ' Fix: ' . $finding->fix), $this->escape($finding->rule));
            }
            $lines[] = '  </file>';
        }
        $lines[] = '</checkstyle>';

        return implode("\n", $lines) . "\n";
    }

    /**
     * Escapes text for an XML attribute.
     */
    public function escape(string $text): string
    {
        return htmlspecialchars($text, ENT_QUOTES | ENT_XML1, 'UTF-8');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Reporting;

use DecisionsLint\Lint\Report;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Formatter\OutputFormatter;

/**
 * Renders findings for a person at a terminal, grouped by file and coloured by severity.
 */
final class TextReporter implements Reporter
{
    /**
     * Creates a reporter, optionally with a shared summary.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?Summary $summary = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the report grouped by file, each finding with its position, rule, symbol, message and fix.
     */
    public function render(Report $report, bool $decorated): string
    {
        $formatter = new OutputFormatter($decorated);
        $summary = $this->summary ?? new Summary();
        $lines = ['', '<options=bold>Decisions check</>', ''];
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($report->findings as $finding) {
            $groups[$finding->path][] = $finding;
        }
        foreach ($groups as $path => $findings) {
            $lines[] = '<options=bold>' . OutputFormatter::escape((string) $path) . '</>';
            foreach ($findings as $finding) {
                $color = $this->color($finding->severity);
                $lines[] = sprintf('  <fg=%s>%d:%d %s</> <fg=cyan>%s</> %s <fg=gray>(confidence %.2f)</>', $color, $finding->line, $finding->column, $finding->severity, OutputFormatter::escape($finding->rule), OutputFormatter::escape($finding->symbol), $finding->confidence);
                $lines[] = '    ' . OutputFormatter::escape($finding->message);
                $lines[] = '    <fg=green>Fix:</> ' . OutputFormatter::escape($finding->fix);
            }
            $lines[] = '';
        }
        $lines[] = '<options=bold>' . OutputFormatter::escape($summary->counts($report, ' · ')) . '</>';
        $lines[] = ($report->failed() ? '<fg=red>' : '<fg=green>') . OutputFormatter::escape($summary->verdict($report)) . '</>';

        return $formatter->format(implode("\n", $lines) . "\n") ?? '';
    }

    /**
     * Returns the terminal colour of a severity.
     */
    public function color(string $severity): string
    {
        return match ($severity) {
            'error' => 'red',
            'warning' => 'yellow',
            default => 'blue',
        };
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Source;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use FilesystemIterator;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use SplFileInfo;

/**
 * Lists the files a run reads: everything under the configured paths, minus the excluded globs.
 */
final class FileFinder
{
    /**
     * Creates a finder for one project directory.
     */
    public function __construct(private string $root, private ?GlobMatcher $matcher = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Returns the sorted relative paths of the files the paths select and the excludes keep.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths directories, files or globs relative to the root
     * @param list<string> $exclude globs relative to the root
     * @return list<string>
     * @throws LintException when a path names nothing that exists
     */
    public function find(array $paths, array $exclude): array
    {
        $matcher = $this->matcher ?? new GlobMatcher();
        $found = [];
        foreach ($paths as $pattern) {
            $base = $matcher->base($pattern);
            $absolute = $this->root . ($base === '' ? '' : '/' . $base);
            if (is_file($absolute)) {
                $found[$base] = true;
                continue;
            }
            if (!is_dir($absolute)) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('Path "%s" does not exist under %s. List existing directories, files or globs in paths.', $pattern, $this->root));
            }
            foreach ($this->walk($absolute) as $relative) {
                if ($matcher->matches($pattern, $relative)) {
                    $found[$relative] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        $files = [];
        foreach (array_keys($found) as $relative) {
            if (!$matcher->matchesAny($exclude, (string) $relative)) {
                $files[] = (string) $relative;
            }
        }
        sort($files);

        return $files;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the relative paths of every regular file below a directory, without following symbolic links.
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function walk(string $directory): array
    {
        $files = [];
        $iterator = new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($directory, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS), RecursiveIteratorIterator::LEAVES_ONLY);
        foreach ($iterator as $entry) {
            if (!$entry instanceof SplFileInfo || !$entry->isFile() || $entry->isLink()) {
                continue;
            }
            $files[] = ltrim(substr($entry->getPathname(), strlen($this->root)), '/');
        }

        return $files;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Source;

use PhpToken;

/**
 * The tokens of one PHP file, with the navigation a declaration scanner needs.
 */
final class Tokens
{
    /**
     * @var list<PhpToken>
     */
    private array $tokens;

    /**
     * Tokenizes the source text.
     */
    public function __construct(private string $code)
    {
        $this->tokens = PhpToken::tokenize($code);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the number of tokens.
     */
    public function count(): int
    {
        return count($this->tokens);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the token at an index.
     */
    public function at(int $index): PhpToken
    {
        return $this->tokens[$index];
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the next token after an index that is not whitespace or a comment, or null at the end.
     */
    public function nextSignificant(int $index): ?int
    {
        for ($i = $index + 1; $i < count($this->tokens); ++$i) {
            if (!$this->tokens[$i]->isIgnorable()) {
                return $i;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the previous token before an index that is not whitespace or a comment, or null at the start.
     */
    public function previousSignificant(int $index): ?int
    {
        for ($i = $index - 1; $i >= 0; --$i) {
            if (!$this->tokens[$i]->isIgnorable()) {
                return $i;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the closing token that balances the opening token at an index, or the last index when unbalanced.
     */
    public function closing(int $open, string $openText = '{', string $closeText = '}'): int
    {
        $depth = 0;
        for ($i = $open; $i < count($this->tokens); ++$i) {
            $text = $this->tokens[$i]->text;
            if ($text === $openText || ($openText === '{' && $this->opensBrace($this->tokens[$i]))) {
                ++$depth;
            } elseif ($text === $closeText) {
                --$depth;
                if ($depth === 0) {
                    return $i;
                }
            }
        }

        return count($this->tokens) - 1;
    }

    /**
     * Tells whether a token opens a brace scope with a token other than a bare brace, such as `${` or `"{$`.
     */
    public function opensBrace(PhpToken $token): bool
    {
        return $token->is([T_CURLY_OPEN, T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES]);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the index of the first token at or after an index whose text is one of the given, or null.
     *
     * @param list<string> $texts
     */
    public function find(int $from, array $texts): ?int
    {
        for ($i = $from; $i < count($this->tokens); ++$i) {
            if (in_array($this->tokens[$i]->text, $texts, true)) {
                return $i;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Returns the 1-based column at which a token starts.
     */
    public function column(int $index): int
    {
        $position = $this->tokens[$index]->pos;
        $lineStart = strrpos(substr($this->code, 0, $position), "\n");

        return $position - ($lineStart === false ? -1 : $lineStart);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the source text from one token to another, inclusive.
     */
    public function text(int $from, int $to): string
    {
        $start = $this->tokens[$from]->pos;
        $end = $this->tokens[$to]->pos + strlen($this->tokens[$to]->text);

        return substr($this->code, $start, $end - $start);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Http;

/**
 * One HTTP request with its body already encoded.
 *
 * @property-read string $method GET, POST and so on
 * @property-read string $url the absolute URL
 * @property-read array<string, string> $headers header name to value
 * @property-read string $body the encoded body, or an empty string
 */
final class HttpRequest
{
    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param array<string, string> $headers
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $method,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $url,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $headers = [],
        /** @readonly */
        private string $body = '',
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Returns a declared immutable property.
     *
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'method' => $this->method,
            'url' => $this->url,
            'headers' => $this->headers,
            'body' => $this->body,
            default => null,
        };
    }
}
