<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Provider;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpRequest;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpResponse;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use JsonException;

/**
 * Posts JSON documents to a bearer-authenticated API and decodes what comes back.
 *
 * The two decision APIs share this shape; each client adds its path and body.
 */
final class JsonEndpoint
{
    /**
     * Creates an endpoint for one provider over a transport.
     */
    public function __construct(private Transport $transport, private ProviderSettings $settings, private string $apiKey)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Posts every payload to a path and returns the decoded responses in the same order.
     *
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $payloads
     * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails or a response is not a JSON object
     */
    public function post(string $path, array $payloads): array
    {
        $requests = [];
        foreach ($payloads as $payload) {
            $requests[] = $this->request($path, $payload);
        }
        $documents = [];
        foreach ($this->transport->send($requests) as $index => $response) {
            $documents[] = $this->decode($response, $requests[$index]);
        }

        return $documents;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the request for one payload.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
     * @throws LintException when the payload cannot be encoded
     */
    public function request(string $path, array $payload): HttpRequest
    {
        try {
            $body = json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
        } catch (JsonException $exception) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not encode a request for %s: %s. Make sure the linted files are valid UTF-8.', $this->settings->name, $exception->getMessage()), 0, $exception);
        }

        return new HttpRequest('POST', rtrim($this->settings->baseUrl, '/') . $path, [
            'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . $this->apiKey,
            'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
            'Accept' => 'application/json',
            'User-Agent' => 'decisions-lint',
        ], $body);
    }

    /**
     * Decodes a successful response, or explains the failure.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     * @throws LintException when the status is not 2xx or the body is not a JSON object
     */
    public function decode(HttpResponse $response, HttpRequest $request): array
    {
        $document = null;
        try {
            $document = json_decode($response->body, true, 64, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (JsonException $exception) {
            if ($response->ok()) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('%s returned HTTP %d for %s with a body that is not JSON: %s. Check provider.base_url in decisions.yaml.', $this->settings->name, $response->status, $request->url, $exception->getMessage()), 0, $exception);
            }
        }
        if (!$response->ok()) {
            throw new LintException($this->failure($response, $request, is_array($document) ? $document : []));
        }
        if (!is_array($document)) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('%s returned HTTP %d for %s with a JSON body that is not an object. Check provider.base_url in decisions.yaml.', $this->settings->name, $response->status, $request->url));
        }
        $object = [];
        foreach ($document as $key => $value) {
            $object[(string) $key] = $value;
        }

        return $object;
    }

    /**
     * Explains a non-2xx response with the provider's own message and the configuration to check.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $document
     */
    public function failure(HttpResponse $response, HttpRequest $request, array $document): string
    {
        $detail = $this->detail($document, $response->body);
        $hint = match (true) {
            $response->status === 401 || $response->status === 403 => sprintf('Check that the %s environment variable holds a valid %s API key.', $this->settings->apiKeyEnv, $this->settings->name),
            $response->status === 404 => 'Check provider.base_url in decisions.yaml.',
            $response->status === 422 || $response->status === 400 => sprintf('Check provider.model ("%s") and the rule questions in decisions.yaml.', $this->settings->model),
            $response->status === 429 => 'Lower provider.concurrency in decisions.yaml or retry later.',
            $response->status >= 500 => 'The provider is unavailable; retry later.',
            default => 'Check the provider status and decisions.yaml.',
        };

        return sprintf('%s returned HTTP %d for POST %s%s. %s', $this->settings->name, $response->status, $request->url, $detail === '' ? '' : ': ' . $detail, $hint);
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the error message of a failure body, falling back to a short excerpt of the body.
     *
     * @param array<array-key, mixed> $document
     */
    public function detail(array $document, string $body): string
    {
        $error = $document['error'] ?? $document['message'] ?? $document['detail'] ?? null;
        if (is_array($error)) {
            $error = $error['message'] ?? $error['detail'] ?? null;
        }
        if (is_string($error) && $error !== '') {
            return $error;
        }
        $excerpt = trim((string) preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $body));

        return strlen($excerpt) > 200 ? substr($excerpt, 0, 200) . '…' : $excerpt;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Diagnostic;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Severity;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Severity
 */
#[CoversClass(Severity::class)]
final class SeverityTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRankOrdersErrorAboveWarningAboveInfo(): void
    {
        $severity = new Severity();
        self::assertSame(3, $severity->rank(Severity::ERROR));
        self::assertSame(2, $severity->rank(Severity::WARNING));
        self::assertSame(1, $severity->rank(Severity::INFO));
        self::assertSame(0, $severity->rank('never'));
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerAtLeast
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerAtLeast')]
    public function testAtLeastComparesAgainstAMinimum(string $severity, string $minimum, bool $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, (new Severity())->atLeast($severity, $minimum));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{string, string, bool}>
     */
    public static function providerAtLeast(): iterable
    {
        yield 'error reaches error' => [Severity::ERROR, Severity::ERROR, true];
        yield 'warning does not reach error' => [Severity::WARNING, Severity::ERROR, false];
        yield 'error reaches info' => [Severity::ERROR, Severity::INFO, true];
        yield 'nothing reaches never' => [Severity::ERROR, 'never', false];
    }
}

final class AnswerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPredicateDerivesConfidenceFromTheProbability(): void
    {
        $answer = Answer::predicate(0.2);
        self::assertSame('predicate', $answer->type);
        self::assertSame(0.2, $answer->probability);
        self::assertSame(0.8, $answer->confidence);
        self::assertSame(['true' => 0.2, 'false' => 0.8], $answer->probabilities);
    }

    public function testChoiceKeepsTheOptionAndTheDistribution(): void
    {
        $answer = Answer::choice('domain_rule', 0.7, ['domain_rule' => 0.7, 'orchestration' => 0.3]);
        self::assertSame('choice', $answer->type);
        self::assertSame('domain_rule', $answer->choice);
        self::assertSame(0.7, $answer->confidence);
        self::assertSame(['domain_rule' => 0.7, 'orchestration' => 0.3], $answer->probabilities);
    }

    public function testScoreKeepsTheWeightedLevel(): void
    {
        $answer = Answer::score(1.4, 0.6, ['0' => 0.1, '1' => 0.4, '2' => 0.5]);
        self::assertSame('score', $answer->type);
        self::assertSame(1.4, $answer->score);
        self::assertSame(0.6, $answer->confidence);
        self::assertNull($answer->unknown);
    }

    public function testRefusalCarriesNothingButItsType(): void
    {
        $answer = Answer::refusal();
        self::assertSame(Answer::REFUSAL, $answer->type);
        self::assertSame(0.0, $answer->probability);
        self::assertSame('', $answer->choice);
        self::assertSame([], $answer->probabilities);
    }
}

namespace Tests\Unit\Decision;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Decision;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Verdict;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversNothing;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @coversNothing
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Question
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Verdict
 */
#[CoversNothing]
#[UsesClass(Answer::class)]
#[UsesClass(Inquiry::class)]
#[UsesClass(Question::class)]
#[UsesClass(Verdict::class)]
final class DecisionTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testDecideReturnsOneVerdictPerInquiryInOrder(): void
    {
        $decision = new class () implements Decision {
            public function decide(array $inquiries): array
            {
                $verdicts = [];
                foreach ($inquiries as $inquiry) {
                    $answers = [];
                    foreach ($inquiry->questions as $question) {
                        $answers[$question->name] = Answer::predicate(0.5);
                    }
                    $verdicts[] = new Verdict('fake', $answers);
                }

                return $verdicts;
            }
        };
        $verdicts = $decision->decide([new Inquiry(['a' => '1'], [new Question('q', Question::PREDICATE, 'Q?')]), new Inquiry(['b' => '2'], [])]);
        self::assertCount(2, $verdicts);
        self::assertSame(0.5, $verdicts[0]->answer('q')->probability);
        self::assertSame([], $verdicts[1]->answers);
    }
}

namespace Tests\Unit\Http;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\CurlTransport;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpRequest;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Http\CurlTransport
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Http\HttpRequest
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Http\HttpResponse
 */
#[CoversClass(CurlTransport::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
#[UsesClass(HttpRequest::class)]
#[UsesClass(HttpResponse::class)]
final class CurlTransportTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSendReturnsNothingForNoRequests(): void
    {
        self::assertSame([], (new CurlTransport(2, 1))->send([]));
    }

    public function testSendExplainsAnUnreachableHost(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Could not reach http://127.0.0.1:9/v1/systemone');
        (new CurlTransport(1, 1))->send([new HttpRequest('POST', 'http://127.0.0.1:9/v1/systemone', ['Content-Type' => 'application/json'], '{}')]);
    }

    public function testSendChunkReturnsNothingForNoRequests(): void
    {
        self::assertSame([], (new CurlTransport())->sendChunk([]));
    }

    public function testHandleConfiguresTheUrl(): void
    {
        $handle = (new CurlTransport())->handle(new HttpRequest('POST', 'https://api.example.test/v1/x', ['Accept' => 'application/json'], '{}'));
        self::assertSame('https://api.example.test/v1/x', curl_getinfo($handle, CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL));
    }

    public function testDriveReturnsWhenNothingIsInFlight(): void
    {
        $multi = curl_multi_init();
        (new CurlTransport())->drive($multi);
        curl_multi_close($multi);
        self::assertTrue(true);
    }

    public function testResponseRejectsAHandleThatNeverGotAResponse(): void
    {
        $request = new HttpRequest('POST', 'https://api.example.test/v1/x', [], '{}');
        $transport = new CurlTransport();
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('no response');
        $transport->response($transport->handle($request), $request);
    }
}

namespace Tests\Unit\Source;

use DecisionsLint\Source\GlobMatcher;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Source\GlobMatcher
 */
#[CoversClass(GlobMatcher::class)]
final class GlobMatcherTest extends TestCase
{
    /**
     * @dataProvider providerMatches
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerMatches')]
    public function testMatchesSupportsSegmentsDoubleStarsAndDirectoryPrefixes(string $pattern, string $path, bool $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, (new GlobMatcher())->matches($pattern, $path));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{string, string, bool}>
     */
    public static function providerMatches(): iterable
    {
        yield 'directory prefix' => ['src', 'src/App/Foo.php', true];
        yield 'exact file' => ['src/Foo.php', 'src/Foo.php', true];
        yield 'star within a segment' => ['src/*.php', 'src/Foo.php', true];
        yield 'star does not cross segments' => ['src/*.php', 'src/App/Foo.php', false];
        yield 'double star crosses segments' => ['src/**/*Analyzer.php', 'src/App/Deep/FooAnalyzer.php', true];
        yield 'double star matches zero segments' => ['src/**/*.php', 'src/Foo.php', true];
        yield 'question mark' => ['src/?oo.php', 'src/Foo.php', true];
        yield 'dot is everything' => ['.', 'anything/at/all.txt', true];
        yield 'other directory' => ['tests', 'src/Foo.php', false];
        yield 'trailing double star' => ['src/Generated/**', 'src/Generated/A/B.php', true];
    }

    public function testMatchesAnyChecksEveryPattern(): void
    {
        $matcher = new GlobMatcher();
        self::assertTrue($matcher->matchesAny(['tests', 'src/**/*.php'], 'src/A.php'));
        self::assertFalse($matcher->matchesAny(['tests'], 'src/A.php'));
        self::assertFalse($matcher->matchesAny([], 'src/A.php'));
    }

    public function testBaseReturnsTheLeadingDirectoryWithoutWildcards(): void
    {
        $matcher = new GlobMatcher();
        self::assertSame('src/App', $matcher->base('src/App/**/*.php'));
        self::assertSame('src', $matcher->base('src'));
        self::assertSame('', $matcher->base('**/*.php'));
    }

    public function testRegexAnchorsThePattern(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('#^src/[^/]*\.php$#', (new GlobMatcher())->regex('src/*.php'));
        self::assertSame('#^(?:.*/)?[^/]\.php$#', (new GlobMatcher())->regex('**/?.php'));
    }
}

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Source\Tokens
 */
#[CoversClass(Tokens::class)]
final class TokensTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCountReturnsTheNumberOfTokens(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(3, (new Tokens("<?php\n\$a;"))->count());
    }

    public function testAtReturnsTheTokenAtAnIndex(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('$a', (new Tokens("<?php\n\$a;"))->at(1)->text);
    }

    public function testNextSignificantSkipsWhitespaceAndComments(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n/** doc */ // note\n\$a;");
        self::assertSame('$a', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->nextSignificant(0))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->nextSignificant($tokens->count() - 1));
    }

    public function testPreviousSignificantSkipsWhitespaceAndComments(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfoo /* x */ ;");
        $semicolon = $tokens->count() - 1;
        self::assertSame('foo', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->previousSignificant($semicolon))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->previousSignificant(0));
    }

    public function testClosingBalancesBracesIncludingInterpolationOpeners(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() { if (\$x) { echo \"{\$y}\"; } }\n\$after;");
        $open = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['{']);
        $close = $tokens->closing($open);
        self::assertSame('}', $tokens->at($close)->text);
        self::assertSame('$after', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->nextSignificant($close))->text);
        self::assertSame(')', $tokens->at($tokens->closing((int) $tokens->find(0, ['(']), '(', ')'))->text);
    }

    public function testClosingReturnsTheLastIndexWhenUnbalanced(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {");
        self::assertSame($tokens->count() - 1, $tokens->closing((int) $tokens->find(0, ['{'])));
    }

    public function testOpensBraceRecognisesInterpolationOpeners(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\necho \"{\$y} \${z}\";");
        self::assertTrue($tokens->opensBrace($tokens->at((int) $tokens->find(0, ['{$']))));
        self::assertFalse($tokens->opensBrace($tokens->at(0)));
    }

    public function testFindReturnsTheFirstMatchingTextOrNull(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n\$a = 1; \$b = 2;");
        self::assertSame(';', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->find(0, [';']))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->find(0, ['{']));
    }

    public function testColumnIsOneBasedWithinTheLine(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n    public function f() {}");
        $public = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['public']);
        self::assertSame(5, $tokens->column($public));
        self::assertSame(1, $tokens->column(0));
    }

    public function testTextReturnsTheSourceBetweenTwoTokensInclusive(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {}");
        self::assertSame('function f', $tokens->text(1, 3));
    }
}

        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $named = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A {}");
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($named, 1));
        $constant = new Tokens("<?php\n\$x = Foo::class;");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($constant, (int) $constant->find(0, ['class'])));
        $anonymous = new Tokens("<?php\n\$x = new class {};");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($anonymous, (int) $anonymous->find(0, ['class'])));
        $call = new Tokens("<?php\nenum(1);");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($call, 1));
    }

    public function testIsEnumKeywordAcceptsTheWordHoweverItIsTokenized(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nenum Suit {}");
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isEnumKeyword($tokens->at(1)));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isEnumKeyword($tokens->at(0)));
    }

    public function testFollowsClassNameAcceptsBraceExtendsImplementsAndBackingType(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        self::assertTrue($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A {}"), 3));
        self::assertTrue($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A extends B {}"), 3));
        self::assertTrue($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nenum A: string {}"), 3));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A"), 3));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A = 1;"), 3));
    }

    public function testIsNamedFunctionDistinguishesClosures(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isNamedFunction(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {}"), 1));
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isNamedFunction(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction &f() {}"), 1));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isNamedFunction(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction () {};"), 1));
    }

    public function testStartsPropertyRecognisesOnlyPropertyStatements(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $property = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public static ?int \$x = null; }");
        self::assertTrue($scanner->startsProperty($property, (int) $property->find(0, ['public'])));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($property, (int) $property->find(0, ['static'])));
        $method = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public function f(\$x) {} }");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($method, (int) $method->find(0, ['public'])));

    }

    {

    }

    {

    {

    {

        self::assertSame(['public', 'static', 'readonly'], (new DeclarationScanner())->modifiers($tokens, 1, (int) $tokens->find(0, ['function'])));
    }

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Rule\Template
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 */
#[CoversClass(Template::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
final class TemplateTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPlaceholdersListsEachNameOnce(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['name', 'class'], (new Template())->placeholders('Method {name}() of {class} is not part of {class}.'));
        self::assertSame([], (new Template())->placeholders('No placeholders.'));
    }

    public function testCheckAcceptsKnownPlaceholders(): void
    {
        (new Template())->check('{file}:{line}:{column} {kind} {name} {class} {namespace} {qualified_name} {signature} {visibility} {rule} {answer} {probability} {confidence} {choice} {score} {threshold}', 'rule.x');
        self::assertTrue(true);
    }

    public function testCheckRejectsAnUnknownPlaceholder(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Rule "x": decision.instructions uses the unknown placeholder {method}. Use one of: {file}, {line}');
        (new Template())->check('Is {method} right?', 'Rule "x": decision.instructions');
    }

{
    /**
     * @dataProvider providerSelects
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerSelects')]
    public function testSelectsFiltersByKindVisibilityStaticAndName(TargetSelector $selector, bool $expected): void
    {
        $target = new Target('method', '__construct', 'A::__construct', '', 'A', 'src/A.php', 1, 1, 'public static function __construct()', 'public', ['public', 'static'], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        self::assertSame($expected, $selector->selects($target));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{TargetSelector, bool}>
     */
    public static function providerSelects(): iterable
    {
        yield 'kind only' => [new TargetSelector('method'), true];
        yield 'other kind' => [new TargetSelector('property'), false];
        yield 'matching visibility' => [new TargetSelector('method', ['public', 'protected']), true];
        yield 'other visibility' => [new TargetSelector('method', ['private']), false];
        yield 'static wanted' => [new TargetSelector('method', [], [], [], true), true];
        yield 'non-static wanted' => [new TargetSelector('method', [], [], [], false), false];
        yield 'name glob' => [new TargetSelector('method', [], ['__*']), true];
        yield 'name glob misses' => [new TargetSelector('method', [], ['analyze*']), false];
        yield 'excluded name' => [new TargetSelector('method', [], [], ['__*']), false];
    }

    {

        self::assertSame(['*Id'], $selector->names);
        self::assertSame(['legacy*'], $selector->excludeNames);
        self::assertFalse($selector->static);

    }
}

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Rule\ViolationMatcher
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\DecisionSpec
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\TargetSelector
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Template
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Violation
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Source\Target

#[CoversClass(ViolationMatcher::class)]
#[UsesClass(Answer::class)]
#[UsesClass(Finding::class)]
#[UsesClass(DecisionSpec::class)]
#[UsesClass(Rule::class)]
#[UsesClass(TargetSelector::class)]
#[UsesClass(Template::class)]
#[UsesClass(Violation::class)]
#[UsesClass(Target::class)]
final class ViolationMatcherTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testMatchReturnsTheFirstViolationTheAnswerSatisfies(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('ddd.leak', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('choice', 'Classify.', ['ok' => 'fine', 'leak' => 'bad', 'infra' => 'worse'], [], 0.6), [
            new Violation('leak', null, null, 'Leak in {class}::{name} ({choice}, {confidence}).', 'Move it out of {name}().'),
            new Violation('infra', null, null, 'Infra.', 'Hide it.'),
        ]);
        $target = new Target('method', 'handle', 'App\UseCase::handle', 'App', 'UseCase', 'src/UseCase.php', 20, 5, 'public function handle()', 'public', ['public'], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $finding = (new ViolationMatcher(new Template()))->match($rule, $target, Answer::choice('leak', 0.9, ['leak' => 0.9]));
        self::assertNotNull($finding);
        self::assertSame('Leak in UseCase::handle (leak, 0.90).', $finding->message);
        self::assertSame('Move it out of handle().', $finding->fix);
        self::assertSame('error', $finding->severity);
        self::assertSame(20, $finding->line);
        self::assertSame(0.9, $finding->confidence);
        self::assertNull((new ViolationMatcher())->match($rule, $target, Answer::choice('ok', 0.9, [])));
        self::assertNull((new ViolationMatcher())->match($rule, $target, Answer::choice('leak', 0.3, [])));
        self::assertNull((new ViolationMatcher())->match($rule, $target, Answer::refusal()));
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerViolates
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerViolates')]
    public function testViolatesComparesTheAnswerWithTheThreshold(DecisionSpec $decision, Violation $violation, Answer $answer, bool $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, (new ViolationMatcher())->violates($decision, $violation, $answer));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{DecisionSpec, Violation, Answer, bool}>
     */
    public static function providerViolates(): iterable
    {
        $predicate = new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?', [], [], 0.7);
        yield 'predicate false confidently' => [$predicate, new Violation(false, null, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::predicate(0.2), true];
        yield 'predicate false weakly' => [$predicate, new Violation(false, null, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::predicate(0.4), false];
        yield 'predicate true confidently' => [$predicate, new Violation(true, null, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::predicate(0.8), true];
        $score = new DecisionSpec('score', 'Rate.', [], ['a', 'b', 'c'], 0.5);
        yield 'score within bounds' => [$score, new Violation(null, 0.5, 1.5, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.6, []), true];
        yield 'score above max' => [$score, new Violation(null, null, 0.5, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.6, []), false];
        yield 'score below min' => [$score, new Violation(null, 1.5, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.6, []), false];
        yield 'score with low confidence' => [$score, new Violation(null, 0.0, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.2, []), false];
    }

    public function testFindingRendersTheAnswerValuesIntoTheTemplates(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('naming.vague', '', 'warning', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'declaration', new DecisionSpec('score', 'Rate.', [], ['a', 'b', 'c'], 0.5), []);
        $target = new Target('method', 'doIt', 'App\A::doIt', 'App', 'A', 'src/A.php', 8, 5, 'public function doIt()', 'public', ['public'], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $finding = (new ViolationMatcher())->finding($rule, $target, new Violation(null, 0.5, 1.5, '{name} scored {score} ({answer}) for {rule}.', 'Rename; threshold {threshold}.'), Answer::score(1.25, 0.55, []));
        self::assertSame('doIt scored 1.25 (1.25) for naming.vague.', $finding->message);
        self::assertSame('Rename; threshold 0.5.', $finding->fix);
        self::assertSame('warning', $finding->severity);
        self::assertSame('App\A::doIt', $finding->symbol);
        self::assertSame(0.55, $finding->confidence);
    }

    public function testAnswerTextNamesTheAnswerForEachType(): void
    {
        $matcher = new ViolationMatcher();
        self::assertSame('yes', $matcher->answerText(Answer::predicate(0.6)));
        self::assertSame('no', $matcher->answerText(Answer::predicate(0.4)));
        self::assertSame('leak', $matcher->answerText(Answer::choice('leak', 1.0, [])));
        self::assertSame('1.50', $matcher->answerText(Answer::score(1.5, 1.0, [])));
    }
}

        file_put_contents($root . '/a/b/c.txt', 'c');
        try {
            self::assertSame(['a/b/c.txt'], (new FileFinder($root))->walk($root . '/a'));
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/a/b/c.txt');
            rmdir($root . '/a/b');
            rmdir($root . '/a');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }
}

/**

#[CoversClass(Tokens::class)]

{
    public function testCountReturnsTheNumberOfTokens(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(3, (new Tokens("<?php\n\$a;"))->count());
    }

    public function testAtReturnsTheTokenAtAnIndex(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('$a', (new Tokens("<?php\n\$a;"))->at(1)->text);
    }

    public function testNextSignificantSkipsWhitespaceAndComments(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n/** doc */ // note\n\$a;");
        self::assertSame('$a', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->nextSignificant(0))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->nextSignificant($tokens->count() - 1));
    }

    public function testPreviousSignificantSkipsWhitespaceAndComments(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfoo /* x */ ;");
        $semicolon = $tokens->count() - 1;
        self::assertSame('foo', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->previousSignificant($semicolon))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->previousSignificant(0));
    }

    public function testClosingBalancesBracesIncludingInterpolationOpeners(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() { if (\$x) { echo \"{\$y}\"; } }\n\$after;");
        $open = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['{']);
        $close = $tokens->closing($open);
        self::assertSame('}', $tokens->at($close)->text);
        self::assertSame('$after', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->nextSignificant($close))->text);
        self::assertSame(')', $tokens->at($tokens->closing((int) $tokens->find(0, ['(']), '(', ')'))->text);
    }

    public function testClosingReturnsTheLastIndexWhenUnbalanced(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {");
        self::assertSame($tokens->count() - 1, $tokens->closing((int) $tokens->find(0, ['{'])));
    }

    public function testOpensBraceRecognisesInterpolationOpeners(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\necho \"{\$y} \${z}\";");
        self::assertTrue($tokens->opensBrace($tokens->at((int) $tokens->find(0, ['{$']))));
        self::assertFalse($tokens->opensBrace($tokens->at(0)));
    }

    public function testFindReturnsTheFirstMatchingTextOrNull(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n\$a = 1; \$b = 2;");
        self::assertSame(';', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->find(0, [';']))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->find(0, ['{']));
    }

    public function testColumnIsOneBasedWithinTheLine(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n    public function f() {}");
        $public = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['public']);
        self::assertSame(5, $tokens->column($public));
        self::assertSame(1, $tokens->column(0));
    }

    public function testTextReturnsTheSourceBetweenTwoTokensInclusive(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {}");
        self::assertSame('function f', $tokens->text(1, 3));
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Source;

use DecisionsLint\Source\Declaration;
use DecisionsLint\Source\DeclarationScanner;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Tokens;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Source\DeclarationScanner
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Source\Declaration
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Source\Tokens
 */
#[CoversClass(DeclarationScanner::class)]
#[UsesClass(Declaration::class)]
#[UsesClass(Tokens::class)]
final class DeclarationScannerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testScanFindsClassLikesMembersAndFunctionsButSkipsBodies(): void
    {
        $code = <<<'PHP'
            <?php
            namespace App\Analysis;

            /**
             * Doc.
             */
            final class Analyzer extends Base
            {
                public const X = 1;
                /** @var list<string> */
                private array $items = [];
                public static ?int $count = null;
                use SomeTrait;

                public function __construct(private string $name) {}

                public function analyze(string $input): Result
                {
                    $f = function (): void { if (true) { echo "{$x}"; } };
                    $anon = new class { public function hidden() {} };
                    return Result::class;
                }

                abstract protected function foo(): void;
            }

            interface Contract { public function analyze(): void; }
            trait Mixin { public function help(): void {} }
            enum Suit: string { case Hearts = 'h'; public function label(): string { return 'x'; } }
            function standalone(int $a): int { return $a; }
            PHP;
        $declarations = (new DeclarationScanner())->scan(new Tokens($code));
        $summary = array_map(static fn (Declaration $declaration): string => $declaration->kind . ' ' . ($declaration->owner === null ? '' : $declaration->owner . '::') . $declaration->name, $declarations);
        self::assertSame([
            'class Analyzer',
            'property Analyzer::items',
            'property Analyzer::count',
            'method Analyzer::__construct',
            'method Analyzer::analyze',
            'method Analyzer::foo',
            'interface Contract',
            'method Contract::analyze',
            'trait Mixin',
            'method Mixin::help',
            'enum Suit',
            'method Suit::label',
            'function standalone',
        ], $summary);
        self::assertSame('App\Analysis', $declarations[0]->namespace);
        self::assertSame(['final'], $declarations[0]->modifiers);
        self::assertSame(['abstract', 'protected'], $declarations[5]->modifiers);
    }

    public function testNamespaceNameReadsQualifiedNamesAndTheGlobalBlock(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        self::assertSame('App\Deep', $scanner->namespaceName(new Tokens("<?php\nnamespace App\\Deep;"), 1));
        self::assertSame('', $scanner->namespaceName(new Tokens("<?php\nnamespace { }"), 1));
    }

    public function testIsClassLikeKeywordIgnoresClassConstantsAndAnonymousClasses(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $named = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A {}");
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($named, 1));
        $constant = new Tokens("<?php\n\$x = Foo::class;");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($constant, (int) $constant->find(0, ['class'])));
        $anonymous = new Tokens("<?php\n\$x = new class {};");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($anonymous, (int) $anonymous->find(0, ['class'])));
        $call = new Tokens("<?php\nenum(1);");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isClassLikeKeyword($call, 1));
    }

    public function testIsEnumKeywordAcceptsTheWordHoweverItIsTokenized(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nenum Suit {}");
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isEnumKeyword($tokens->at(1)));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isEnumKeyword($tokens->at(0)));
    }

    public function testFollowsClassNameAcceptsBraceExtendsImplementsAndBackingType(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        self::assertTrue($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A {}"), 3));
        self::assertTrue($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A extends B {}"), 3));
        self::assertTrue($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nenum A: string {}"), 3));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A"), 3));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->followsClassName(new Tokens("<?php\nclass A = 1;"), 3));
    }

    public function testIsNamedFunctionDistinguishesClosures(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isNamedFunction(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {}"), 1));
        self::assertTrue($scanner->isNamedFunction(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction &f() {}"), 1));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->isNamedFunction(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction () {};"), 1));
    }

    public function testStartsPropertyRecognisesOnlyPropertyStatements(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $property = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public static ?int \$x = null; }");
        self::assertTrue($scanner->startsProperty($property, (int) $property->find(0, ['public'])));
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($property, (int) $property->find(0, ['static'])));
        $method = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public function f(\$x) {} }");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($method, (int) $method->find(0, ['public'])));
        $constant = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public const X = 1; }");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($constant, (int) $constant->find(0, ['public'])));
        $unterminated = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public \$x");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($unterminated, (int) $unterminated->find(0, ['public'])));
        $other = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { use T; }");
        self::assertFalse($scanner->startsProperty($other, (int) $other->find(0, ['use'])));
    }

    public function testClassLikeDescribesTheDeclarationRange(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n/** doc */\nabstract class A extends B\n{\n}\n");
        $declaration = (new DeclarationScanner())->classLike($tokens, (int) $tokens->find(0, ['class']), 'App', null);
        self::assertSame('class', $declaration->kind);
        self::assertSame('A', $declaration->name);
        self::assertSame(['abstract'], $declaration->modifiers);
        self::assertSame('/** doc */', $tokens->at($declaration->docStart)->text);
        self::assertSame('abstract', $tokens->at($declaration->start)->text);
        self::assertSame('B', $tokens->at($declaration->nameEnd)->text);
        self::assertSame('}', $tokens->at($declaration->end)->text);
    }

    public function testFunctionDescribesMethodsAndBodilessDeclarations(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A { public static function &f(int \$a = 1): ?B { return null; } abstract function g(); }");
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $method = $scanner->function($tokens, (int) $tokens->find(0, ['function']), '', 'A');
        self::assertSame('method', $method->kind);
        self::assertSame('f', $method->name);
        self::assertSame(['public', 'static'], $method->modifiers);
        self::assertSame('}', $tokens->at($method->end)->text);
        self::assertSame('B', $tokens->at($method->nameEnd)->text);
        $abstract = $scanner->function($tokens, (int) $tokens->find($method->end, ['function']), '', null);
        self::assertSame('function', $abstract->kind);
        self::assertSame(';', $tokens->at($abstract->end)->text);
    }

    public function testPropertyNamesTheVariableAndEndsAtTheSemicolon(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nclass A {\n    /** @var int */\n    protected static int \$count = 0;\n}");
        $declaration = (new DeclarationScanner())->property($tokens, (int) $tokens->find(0, ['protected']), 'App', 'A');
        self::assertSame('property', $declaration->kind);
        self::assertSame('count', $declaration->name);
        self::assertSame('A', $declaration->owner);
        self::assertSame(['protected', 'static'], $declaration->modifiers);
        self::assertSame(';', $tokens->at($declaration->end)->text);
        self::assertSame('/** @var int */', $tokens->at($declaration->docStart)->text);
    }

    public function testDeclarationStartWalksBackOverModifiers(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfinal public static function f() {}");
        $function = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['function']);
        self::assertSame('final', $tokens->at((new DeclarationScanner())->declarationStart($tokens, $function))->text);
        self::assertSame(1, (new DeclarationScanner())->declarationStart(new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {}"), 1));
    }

    public function testDocStartReturnsTheDocblockOrTheStart(): void
    {
        $scanner = new DeclarationScanner();
        $documented = new Tokens("<?php\n/** doc */\nfunction f() {}");
        $function = (int) $documented->find(0, ['function']);
        self::assertSame('/** doc */', $documented->at($scanner->docStart($documented, $function))->text);
        $separated = new Tokens("<?php\n/** doc */\n\$x = 1;\nfunction f() {}");
        $function = (int) $separated->find(0, ['function']);
        self::assertSame($function, $scanner->docStart($separated, $function));
        self::assertSame(0, $scanner->docStart(new Tokens('<?php'), 0));
    }

    public function testModifiersCollectsTheLowerCaseKeywordsInARange(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nPublic STATIC readonly function f() {}");
        self::assertSame(['public', 'static', 'readonly'], (new DeclarationScanner())->modifiers($tokens, 1, (int) $tokens->find(0, ['function'])));
    }
}

namespace Tests\Unit\Rule;

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Rule\QuestionBuilder
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Question
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\DecisionSpec
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\TargetSelector
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Template
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Violation
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Source\Target
 */
#[CoversClass(QuestionBuilder::class)]
#[UsesClass(Inquiry::class)]
#[UsesClass(Question::class)]
#[UsesClass(DecisionSpec::class)]
#[UsesClass(Rule::class)]
#[UsesClass(TargetSelector::class)]
#[UsesClass(Template::class)]
#[UsesClass(Violation::class)]
#[UsesClass(Target::class)]
final class QuestionBuilderTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testQuestionFillsTheTargetIntoTheInstructions(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('cohesion.method', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('choice', 'Does {class}::{name} fit rule {rule} at {threshold}?', ['a' => 'A', 'b' => 'B']), []);
        $target = new Target('method', 'foo', 'App\Analyzer::foo', 'App', 'Analyzer', 'src/Analyzer.php', 3, 5, 'public function foo()', 'public', ['public'], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $question = (new QuestionBuilder(new Template()))->question($rule, $target);
        self::assertSame('cohesion.method', $question->name);
        self::assertSame('choice', $question->type);
        self::assertSame('Does Analyzer::foo fit rule cohesion.method at 0.5?', $question->instructions);
        self::assertSame(['a' => 'A', 'b' => 'B'], $question->choices);
    }

    public function testSubjectAddsTheContextSourceUnderItsOwnName(): void
    {
        $builder = new QuestionBuilder();
        $target = new Target('method', 'foo', 'App\Analyzer::foo', 'App', 'Analyzer', 'src/Analyzer.php', 3, 5, 'public function foo()', 'public', ['public'], 'DECL', 'CLASS', 'FILE');
        self::assertSame(['file' => 'src/Analyzer.php', 'kind' => 'method', 'name' => 'App\Analyzer::foo', 'signature' => 'public function foo()', 'declaration' => 'DECL'], $builder->subject($target, 'declaration'));
        self::assertSame('CLASS', $builder->subject($target, 'class')['class_source']);
        self::assertSame('FILE', $builder->subject($target, 'file')['file_source']);
    }

    public function testInquiryAsksEveryRuleAboutTheSameSubject(): void
    {
        $first = new Rule('a', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'A?'), [new Violation(false, null, null, 'm', 'f')]);
        $second = new Rule('b', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('score', 'B?', [], ['x', 'y']), []);
        $target = new Target('method', 'foo', 'A::foo', '', 'A', 'src/A.php', 1, 1, 'function foo()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $inquiry = (new QuestionBuilder())->inquiry($target, 'class', [$first, $second]);
        self::assertSame(['a', 'b'], array_map(static fn (Question $question): string => $question->name, $inquiry->questions));
        self::assertSame('C', $inquiry->subject['class_source']);
        self::assertSame(['x', 'y'], $inquiry->questions[1]->levels);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Rule;

use DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\DecisionSpec;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\TargetSelector;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Template;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Violation;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\ViolationMatcher;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Rule\ViolationMatcher
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Decision\Answer
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\Finding
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\DecisionSpec
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\TargetSelector
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Template
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Rule\Violation
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Source\Target
 */
#[CoversClass(ViolationMatcher::class)]
#[UsesClass(Answer::class)]
#[UsesClass(Finding::class)]
#[UsesClass(DecisionSpec::class)]
#[UsesClass(Rule::class)]
#[UsesClass(TargetSelector::class)]
#[UsesClass(Template::class)]
#[UsesClass(Violation::class)]
#[UsesClass(Target::class)]
final class ViolationMatcherTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testMatchReturnsTheFirstViolationTheAnswerSatisfies(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('ddd.leak', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('choice', 'Classify.', ['ok' => 'fine', 'leak' => 'bad', 'infra' => 'worse'], [], 0.6), [
            new Violation('leak', null, null, 'Leak in {class}::{name} ({choice}, {confidence}).', 'Move it out of {name}().'),
            new Violation('infra', null, null, 'Infra.', 'Hide it.'),
        ]);
        $target = new Target('method', 'handle', 'App\UseCase::handle', 'App', 'UseCase', 'src/UseCase.php', 20, 5, 'public function handle()', 'public', ['public'], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $finding = (new ViolationMatcher(new Template()))->match($rule, $target, Answer::choice('leak', 0.9, ['leak' => 0.9]));
        self::assertNotNull($finding);
        self::assertSame('Leak in UseCase::handle (leak, 0.90).', $finding->message);
        self::assertSame('Move it out of handle().', $finding->fix);
        self::assertSame('error', $finding->severity);
        self::assertSame(20, $finding->line);
        self::assertSame(0.9, $finding->confidence);
        self::assertNull((new ViolationMatcher())->match($rule, $target, Answer::choice('ok', 0.9, [])));
        self::assertNull((new ViolationMatcher())->match($rule, $target, Answer::choice('leak', 0.3, [])));
        self::assertNull((new ViolationMatcher())->match($rule, $target, Answer::refusal()));
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerViolates
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerViolates')]
    public function testViolatesComparesTheAnswerWithTheThreshold(DecisionSpec $decision, Violation $violation, Answer $answer, bool $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, (new ViolationMatcher())->violates($decision, $violation, $answer));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{DecisionSpec, Violation, Answer, bool}>
     */
    public static function providerViolates(): iterable
    {
        $predicate = new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?', [], [], 0.7);
        yield 'predicate false confidently' => [$predicate, new Violation(false, null, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::predicate(0.2), true];
        yield 'predicate false weakly' => [$predicate, new Violation(false, null, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::predicate(0.4), false];
        yield 'predicate true confidently' => [$predicate, new Violation(true, null, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::predicate(0.8), true];
        $score = new DecisionSpec('score', 'Rate.', [], ['a', 'b', 'c'], 0.5);
        yield 'score within bounds' => [$score, new Violation(null, 0.5, 1.5, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.6, []), true];
        yield 'score above max' => [$score, new Violation(null, null, 0.5, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.6, []), false];
        yield 'score below min' => [$score, new Violation(null, 1.5, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.6, []), false];
        yield 'score with low confidence' => [$score, new Violation(null, 0.0, null, 'm', 'f'), Answer::score(1.0, 0.2, []), false];
    }

    public function testFindingRendersTheAnswerValuesIntoTheTemplates(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('naming.vague', '', 'warning', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'declaration', new DecisionSpec('score', 'Rate.', [], ['a', 'b', 'c'], 0.5), []);
        $target = new Target('method', 'doIt', 'App\A::doIt', 'App', 'A', 'src/A.php', 8, 5, 'public function doIt()', 'public', ['public'], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $finding = (new ViolationMatcher())->finding($rule, $target, new Violation(null, 0.5, 1.5, '{name} scored {score} ({answer}) for {rule}.', 'Rename; threshold {threshold}.'), Answer::score(1.25, 0.55, []));
        self::assertSame('doIt scored 1.25 (1.25) for naming.vague.', $finding->message);
        self::assertSame('Rename; threshold 0.5.', $finding->fix);
        self::assertSame('warning', $finding->severity);
        self::assertSame('App\A::doIt', $finding->symbol);
        self::assertSame(0.55, $finding->confidence);
    }

    public function testAnswerTextNamesTheAnswerForEachType(): void
    {
        $matcher = new ViolationMatcher();
        self::assertSame('yes', $matcher->answerText(Answer::predicate(0.6)));
        self::assertSame('no', $matcher->answerText(Answer::predicate(0.4)));
        self::assertSame('leak', $matcher->answerText(Answer::choice('leak', 1.0, [])));
        self::assertSame('1.50', $matcher->answerText(Answer::score(1.5, 1.0, [])));
    }
}

namespace DecisionsLint\Http;

use CurlHandle;
use CurlMultiHandle;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Sends requests over cURL, several at a time, so a lint run is bounded by the provider and not by one connection.

namespace Tests\Unit\Http;

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\CurlTransport;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpRequest;
use DecisionsLint\Http\HttpResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Http\CurlTransport
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Http\HttpRequest
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Http\HttpResponse
 */
#[CoversClass(CurlTransport::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
#[UsesClass(HttpRequest::class)]
#[UsesClass(HttpResponse::class)]
final class CurlTransportTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testSendReturnsNothingForNoRequests(): void
    {
        self::assertSame([], (new CurlTransport(2, 1))->send([]));
    }

    public function testSendExplainsAnUnreachableHost(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Could not reach http://127.0.0.1:9/v1/systemone');
        (new CurlTransport(1, 1))->send([new HttpRequest('POST', 'http://127.0.0.1:9/v1/systemone', ['Content-Type' => 'application/json'], '{}')]);
    }

    public function testSendChunkReturnsNothingForNoRequests(): void
    {
        self::assertSame([], (new CurlTransport())->sendChunk([]));
    }

    public function testHandleConfiguresTheUrl(): void
    {
        $handle = (new CurlTransport())->handle(new HttpRequest('POST', 'https://api.example.test/v1/x', ['Accept' => 'application/json'], '{}'));
        self::assertSame('https://api.example.test/v1/x', curl_getinfo($handle, CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL));
    }

    public function testDriveReturnsNoResultsWhenNothingIsInFlight(): void
    {
        $multi = curl_multi_init();
        self::assertSame([], (new CurlTransport())->drive($multi));
        curl_multi_close($multi);
    }

    public function testResponseRejectsAHandleThatNeverGotAResponse(): void
    {
        $request = new HttpRequest('POST', 'https://api.example.test/v1/x', [], '{}');
        $transport = new CurlTransport();
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('no response');
        $transport->response($transport->handle($request), $request, CURLE_OK);
    }

    public function testResponseNamesTheTransferFailure(): void
    {
        $request = new HttpRequest('POST', 'https://api.example.test/v1/x', [], '{}');
        $transport = new CurlTransport();
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Could not reach https://api.example.test/v1/x: ' . curl_strerror(CURLE_COULDNT_CONNECT));
        $transport->response($transport->handle($request), $request, CURLE_COULDNT_CONNECT);
    }
}

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Source\Tokens
 */
#[CoversClass(Tokens::class)]
final class TokensTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testCountReturnsTheNumberOfTokens(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(3, (new Tokens("<?php\n\$a;"))->count());
    }

    public function testAtReturnsTheTokenAtAnIndex(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('$a', (new Tokens("<?php\n\$a;"))->at(1)->text);
    }

    public function testNextSignificantSkipsWhitespaceAndComments(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n/** doc */ // note\n\$a;");
        self::assertSame('$a', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->nextSignificant(0))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->nextSignificant($tokens->count() - 1));
    }

    public function testPreviousSignificantSkipsWhitespaceAndComments(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfoo /* x */ ;");
        $semicolon = $tokens->count() - 1;
        self::assertSame('foo', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->previousSignificant($semicolon))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->previousSignificant(0));
    }

    public function testClosingBalancesBracesIncludingInterpolationOpeners(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() { if (\$x) { echo \"{\$y}\"; } }\n\$after;");
        $open = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['{']);
        $close = $tokens->closing($open);
        self::assertSame('}', $tokens->at($close)->text);
        self::assertSame('$after', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->nextSignificant($close))->text);
        self::assertSame(')', $tokens->at($tokens->closing((int) $tokens->find(0, ['(']), '(', ')'))->text);
    }

    public function testClosingReturnsTheLastIndexWhenUnbalanced(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {");
        self::assertSame($tokens->count() - 1, $tokens->closing((int) $tokens->find(0, ['{'])));
    }

    public function testOpensBraceRecognisesInterpolationOpeners(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\necho \"{\$y} \${z}\";");
        self::assertTrue($tokens->opensBrace($tokens->at((int) $tokens->find(0, ['{$']))));
        self::assertFalse($tokens->opensBrace($tokens->at(0)));
    }

    public function testFindReturnsTheFirstMatchingTextOrNull(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n\$a = 1; \$b = 2;");
        self::assertSame(';', $tokens->at((int) $tokens->find(0, [';']))->text);
        self::assertNull($tokens->find(0, ['{']));
    }

    public function testColumnIsOneBasedWithinTheLine(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\n    public function f() {}");
        $public = (int) $tokens->find(0, ['public']);
        self::assertSame(5, $tokens->column($public));
        self::assertSame(1, $tokens->column(0));
    }

    public function testTextReturnsTheSourceBetweenTwoTokensInclusive(): void
    {
        $tokens = new Tokens("<?php\nfunction f() {}");
        self::assertSame('function f', $tokens->text(1, 3));
    }
}

#[CoversClass(Payload::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
final class PayloadTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testFloatAcceptsIntegersAndFloats(): void
    {
        $payload = new Payload(['a' => 1, 'b' => 0.5], 'ctx');
        self::assertSame(1.0, $payload->float('a'));
        self::assertSame(0.5, $payload->float('b'));
    }

    public function testFloatRejectsAMissingField(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Jev response.answers: field "noul" must be a number, but it is missing.');
        (new Payload([], 'Jev response.answers'))->float('noul');
    }

    public function testStringRejectsANonString(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('x', (new Payload(['s' => 'x'], 'ctx'))->string('s'));
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('field "s" must be a string, but it is 3');
        (new Payload(['s' => 3], 'ctx'))->string('s');
    }

    public function testStringOrFallsBackForAnAbsentOrNonStringValue(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('jev', (new Payload(['model' => 'jev'], 'ctx'))->stringOr('model', 'x'));
        self::assertSame('x', (new Payload(['model' => 1], 'ctx'))->stringOr('model', 'x'));
        self::assertSame('x', (new Payload([], 'ctx'))->stringOr('model', 'x'));
    }

    public function testNestedReadsAMappingWithAnExtendedContext(): void
    {
        $nested = (new Payload(['answers' => ['a' => ['noul' => 0.2]]], 'Jev response'))->nested('answers');
        self::assertSame(['a'], $nested->keys());
        self::assertSame(0.2, $nested->nested('a')->float('noul'));
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Jev response.answers: field "b" must be a mapping or list, but it is missing');
        $nested->nested('b');
    }

    public function testFloatsReadsADistribution(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['a' => 0.25, 'b' => 0.75], (new Payload(['p' => ['a' => 0.25, 'b' => 0.75]], 'ctx'))->floats('p'));
    }

    public function testEntriesReadsAListOfMappings(): void
    {
        $entries = (new Payload(['answers' => [['name' => 'x'], ['name' => 'y']]], 'ctx'))->entries('answers');
        self::assertCount(2, $entries);
        self::assertSame('y', $entries[1]->string('name'));
    }

    public function testKeysReturnsTheFieldNamesAsStrings(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['0', 'a'], (new Payload(['0' => 1, 'a' => 2], 'ctx'))->keys());
    }

    public function testHasTellsWhetherAFieldIsPresent(): void
    {
        $payload = new Payload(['present' => null], 'ctx');
        self::assertTrue($payload->has('present'));
        self::assertFalse($payload->has('absent'));
    }

    public function testProblemDescribesWhatWasFound(): void
    {
        $payload = new Payload([], 'OpenAI response');
        self::assertStringContainsString('field "x" must be a number, but it is array', $payload->problem('x', 'a number', []));
        self::assertStringContainsString('but it is \'abc\'', $payload->problem('x', 'a number', 'abc'));
        self::assertStringContainsString('report the response or update decisions-lint', $payload->problem('x', 'a number', null));
    }
}

final class JsonEndpointTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPostSendsEveryPayloadAndDecodesTheResponsesInOrder(): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            /** @var list<HttpRequest> */
            public array $sent = [];
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                $this->sent = $requests;
                $responses = [];
                foreach ($requests as $index => $request) {
                    $responses[] = new HttpResponse(200, '{"index":' . $index . '}');
                }

                return $responses;
            }
        };
        $endpoint = new JsonEndpoint($transport, ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), 'secret');
        $documents = $endpoint->post('/v1/systemone', [['a' => 1], ['a' => 2]]);
        self::assertSame([['index' => 0], ['index' => 1]], $documents);
        self::assertCount(2, $transport->sent);
        self::assertSame('https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone', $transport->sent[0]->url);
        self::assertSame('{"a":2}', $transport->sent[1]->body);
    }

    public function testRequestCarriesTheBearerTokenAndJsonHeaders(): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };
        $request = (new JsonEndpoint($transport, new ProviderSettings('openai', 'gpt-6-luna', 'OPENAI_API_KEY', 'https://proxy.test/'), 'k'))->request('/v1/decisions', ['model' => 'gpt-6-luna', 'text' => 'ü/']);

        self::assertSame('https://proxy.test/v1/decisions', $request->url);
        self::assertSame('Bearer k', $request->headers['Authorization']);
        self::assertSame('application/json', $request->headers['Content-Type']);
        self::assertSame('{"model":"gpt-6-luna","text":"ü/"}', $request->body);
    }

    public function testRequestRejectsAPayloadThatCannotBeEncoded(): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Could not encode a request for jev');
        (new JsonEndpoint($transport, ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), 'k'))->request('/v1/systemone', ['bad' => "\xB1\x31"]);
    }

    public function testDecodeReturnsTheObjectOfASuccessfulResponse(): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };

    }

    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };
        $endpoint = new JsonEndpoint($transport, ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), 'k');

     */
    public static function providerDecodeFailures(): iterable
    {
        yield 'unauthorized' => [new HttpResponse(401, '{"error":{"message":"bad key"}}'), 'jev returned HTTP 401 for POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone: bad key. Check that the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable holds a valid jev API key.'];

    }

     * @dataProvider providerFailureHints
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerFailureHints')]
    public function testFailureAddsTheHintForTheStatus(int $status, string $hint): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };
        $endpoint = new JsonEndpoint($transport, ProviderSettings::defaults('openai'), 'k');
        $message = $endpoint->failure(new HttpResponse($status, ''), new HttpRequest('POST', 'https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions', [], '{}'), []);
        self::assertStringContainsString($hint, $message);
        self::assertStringStartsWith(sprintf('openai returned HTTP %d for POST https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions. ', $status), $message);
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{int, string}>
     */
    public static function providerFailureHints(): iterable
    {
        yield 'forbidden' => [403, 'OPENAI_API_KEY'];
        yield 'not found' => [404, 'provider.base_url'];
        yield 'unprocessable' => [422, 'provider.model ("gpt-6-luna")'];
        yield 'bad request' => [400, 'provider.model'];
        yield 'rate limited' => [429, 'provider.concurrency'];
        yield 'server error' => [503, 'retry later'];
        yield 'other' => [418, 'Check the provider status'];
    }

    public function testDetailPrefersTheErrorMessageAndFallsBackToAnExcerpt(): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };
        $endpoint = new JsonEndpoint($transport, ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), 'k');
        self::assertSame('nope', $endpoint->detail(['error' => 'nope'], ''));
        self::assertSame('nested', $endpoint->detail(['error' => ['detail' => 'nested']], ''));
        self::assertSame('plain', $endpoint->detail(['message' => 'plain'], ''));
        self::assertSame('a b', $endpoint->detail([], "a\n\n  b"));
        self::assertSame(str_repeat('x', 200) . '…', $endpoint->detail([], str_repeat('x', 300)));
    }
}

#[CoversClass(JevDecision::class)]

#[UsesClass(ProviderSettings::class)]
final class JevDecisionTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testDecideSendsOneRequestPerInquiryAndReadsEveryAnswer(): void
    {
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            /** @var list<HttpRequest> */
            public array $sent = [];
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                $this->sent = $requests;

                return [new HttpResponse(200, '{"model":"jev-1.13.0","answers":{"p":{"type":"noul","noul":0.9},"c":{"type":"choice","choice":"b","confidence":0.8,"probabilities":{"a":0.2,"b":0.8}},"s":{"type":"score","score":1.5,"confidence":0.6,"legend":{"0":"low","1":"mid","2":"high"},"probabilities":{"0":0.1,"1":0.3,"2":0.6}}},"usage":{"input_tokens":10,"output_tokens":3}}')];
            }
        };
        $decision = new JevDecision(new JevClient(new JsonEndpoint($transport, ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), 'k'), 'jev-latest'));
        $inquiry = new Inquiry(['file' => 'a.php', 'declaration' => 'code'], [
            new Question('p', Question::PREDICATE, 'P?'),
            new Question('c', Question::CHOICE, 'C?', ['a' => 'A', 'b' => 'B']),
            new Question('s', Question::SCORE, 'S?', [], ['low', 'mid', 'high']),
            new Question('missing', Question::PREDICATE, 'M?'),
        ]);
        $verdicts = $decision->decide([$inquiry]);
        self::assertCount(1, $verdicts);
        self::assertSame('jev-1.13.0', $verdicts[0]->model);
        self::assertSame(0.9, $verdicts[0]->answer('p')->probability);
        self::assertSame('b', $verdicts[0]->answer('c')->choice);
        self::assertSame(['a' => 0.2, 'b' => 0.8], $verdicts[0]->answer('c')->probabilities);
        self::assertSame(1.5, $verdicts[0]->answer('s')->score);
        self::assertSame(Answer::REFUSAL, $verdicts[0]->answer('missing')->type);
        self::assertStringContainsString('"state":{"file":"a.php","declaration":"code"}', $transport->sent[0]->body);
    }

    public function testRequestKeysQuestionsByNameAroundTheSubjectState(): void
    {
        $decision = new JevDecision(new JevClient(new JsonEndpoint(new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {

    #[DataProvider('providerHasType')]
    public function testHasTypeMatchesJsonTypes(mixed $value, string $type, bool $expected): void

    {

    }

{
    public function testLoadReturnsAValidDocumentAsAMapping(): void
    {
        $path = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-' . uniqid() . '.yaml';
        file_put_contents($path, "version: 1\npaths: [src]\n");
        try {
            self::assertSame(['version' => 1, 'paths' => ['src']], (new DocumentLoader(new SchemaValidator()))->load($path, SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS, 'decisions.yaml'));
        } finally {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }

    public function testLoadRejectsAMissingConfiguration(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Configuration not found: /nonexistent/decisions.yaml. Run decisions-lint init to create it, or pass --config.');
        (new DocumentLoader())->load('/nonexistent/decisions.yaml', SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS, 'decisions.yaml');
    }

    public function testLoadRejectsAMissingRuleFileWithTheImportHint(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Rule file not found: /nonexistent/a.yaml. Check that the path is relative to the file that imports it.');
        (new DocumentLoader())->load('/nonexistent/a.yaml', SchemaCatalog::RULES, 'a.yaml');
    }

    public function testLoadRejectsInvalidYaml(): void
    {
        $path = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-' . uniqid() . '.yaml';
        file_put_contents($path, "version: 1\npaths: [src\n");
        try {
            $this->expectException(LintException::class);
            $this->expectExceptionMessage('decisions.yaml is not valid YAML:');
            (new DocumentLoader())->load($path, SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS, 'decisions.yaml');
        } finally {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }

    public function testLoadRejectsADocumentThatDepartsFromTheSchema(): void
    {
        $path = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-' . uniqid() . '.yaml';
        file_put_contents($path, "version: 1\nrules: []\n");
        try {
            $this->expectException(LintException::class);
            $this->expectExceptionMessage('rules/x.yaml: rules must be a mapping, not an empty list.');
            (new DocumentLoader())->load($path, SchemaCatalog::RULES, 'rules/x.yaml');
        } finally {
            unlink($path);
        }
    }
}

{
    public function testReadBuildsACompleteRuleWithDefaults(): void
    {
        $rule = (new RuleReader(new Template()))->read('a.b', [
            'source' => ['rules/a.yaml'],
            'target' => ['kind' => 'method', 'visibility' => ['public'], 'exclude_names' => ['__*'], 'static' => false],
            'decision' => ['type' => 'choice', 'instructions' => 'Classify {name}.', 'choices' => ['ok' => 'fine', 'leak' => 'bad'], 'threshold' => 0.6],
            'violations' => [['answer' => 'leak', 'message' => 'Leak in {name}.', 'fix' => 'Move it.']],
        ]);

        self::assertSame('method', $rule->target->kind);
        self::assertFalse($rule->target->static);

        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Rule "a.b" (decisions.yaml) has no target. Add it, or import the rule file that defines the rule before overriding it in decisions.yaml.');

    }

        self::assertNull($selector->static);
    }

            self::assertSame(7, count($plan->assignments));
            self::assertSame(4, $plan->targets());
            self::assertCount(1, (new Planner())->plan($configuration, ['src/notes.md'])->inquiries);

final class LinterTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testLintTurnsViolatingAnswersIntoSortedFindings(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('cohesion', '', 'warning', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Fits?', [], [], 0.7), [new Violation(false, null, null, '{name} misplaced.', 'Move {name}.')]);
        $first = new Target('method', 'zed', 'B::zed', '', 'B', 'src/B.php', 3, 5, 'function zed()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $second = new Target('method', 'foo', 'A::foo', '', 'A', 'src/A.php', 9, 5, 'function foo()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $third = new Target('method', 'bar', 'A::bar', '', 'A', 'src/A.php', 2, 5, 'function bar()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $plan = new Plan(['src/A.php', 'src/B.php'], [
            new Inquiry([], [new Question('cohesion', 'predicate', 'Fits?')]),
            new Inquiry([], [new Question('cohesion', 'predicate', 'Fits?')]),
            new Inquiry([], [new Question('cohesion', 'predicate', 'Fits?')]),
        ], [new Assignment(0, $rule, $first), new Assignment(1, $rule, $second), new Assignment(2, $rule, $third)]);
        $decision = new class () implements Decision {
            public function decide(array $inquiries): array
            {
                return [
                    new Verdict('jev-1.13.0', ['cohesion' => Answer::predicate(0.1)]),
                    new Verdict('jev-1.13.0', ['cohesion' => Answer::predicate(0.95)]),
                    new Verdict('jev-1.14.0', ['cohesion' => Answer::predicate(0.2)]),
                ];
            }
        };
        $report = (new Linter(new ViolationMatcher()))->lint($plan, $decision, 'warning');
        self::assertSame(['src/A.php:2 bar misplaced.', 'src/B.php:3 zed misplaced.'], array_map(static fn (Finding $finding): string => $finding->path . ':' . $finding->line . ' ' . $finding->message, $report->findings));
        self::assertSame(2, $report->files);
        self::assertSame(3, $report->targets);
        self::assertSame(3, $report->requests);
        self::assertSame(['jev-1.13.0', 'jev-1.14.0'], $report->models);
        self::assertTrue($report->failed());
    }

    public function testLintAsksNothingForAnEmptyPlan(): void
    {
        $decision = new class () implements Decision {
            public function decide(array $inquiries): array
            {
                throw new LogicException('must not be called');
            }
        };
        $report = (new Linter())->lint(new Plan([], [], []), $decision, 'error');
        self::assertSame([], $report->findings);
        self::assertSame(0, $report->requests);
        self::assertFalse($report->failed());
    }

    public function testSortOrdersByPathLineColumnAndRule(): void
    {
        $findings = [
            new Finding('b.php', 1, 1, 'a', 'error', 's', 'm', 'f', 1.0),

#[UsesClass(Severity::class)]
#[UsesClass(Report::class)]
#[UsesClass(Summary::class)]
final class TextReporterTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRenderGroupsFindingsByFileWithPositionMessageAndFix(): void
    {
        $report = new Report([
            new Finding('src/A.php', 12, 5, 'cohesion.method', 'error', 'App\A::foo', 'Method foo() <misplaced>.', 'Move foo().', 0.91),
            new Finding('src/B.php', 3, 1, 'naming.vague', 'info', 'App\B::doIt', 'Vague.', 'Rename.', 0.5),
        ], 2, 4, 3, ['jev-1.13.0'], 'error');
        $text = (new TextReporter(new Summary()))->render($report, false);
        self::assertStringContainsString("\nDecisions check\n", $text);
        self::assertStringContainsString("src/A.php\n  12:5 error cohesion.method App\A::foo (confidence 0.91)\n    Method foo() <misplaced>.\n    Fix: Move foo().\n", $text);
        self::assertStringContainsString("src/B.php\n  3:1 info naming.vague", $text);
        self::assertStringContainsString('1 error · 0 warnings · 1 info · 2 files with findings · 4 targets · 3 requests to jev-1.13.0', $text);
        self::assertStringEndsWith("Decisions check failed: a finding is at least error and fail_on is error.\n", $text);
        self::assertStringNotContainsString("\033[", $text);
    }

    public function testRenderColoursTheOutputWhenDecorated(): void
    {
        $report = new Report([new Finding('src/A.php', 1, 1, 'r', 'warning', 's', 'm', 'f', 1.0)], 1, 1, 1, [], 'error');
        $text = (new TextReporter())->render($report, true);
        self::assertStringContainsString("\033[", $text);
        self::assertStringContainsString('Decisions check passed.', $text);
    }

    public function testColorMapsSeverities(): void
    {
        $reporter = new TextReporter();
        self::assertSame('red', $reporter->color('error'));
        self::assertSame('yellow', $reporter->color('warning'));
        self::assertSame('blue', $reporter->color('info'));
    }
}

#[UsesClass(Severity::class)]
#[UsesClass(Report::class)]
#[UsesClass(Summary::class)]

{
    public function testRenderWritesWorkflowCommandsPerFinding(): void
    {

            new Finding('src/A.php', 12, 5, 'cohesion.method', 'error', 'App\A::foo', "Misplaced,\nreally.", 'Move it: now.', 0.9),
            new Finding('src/A.php', 13, 1, 'naming.vague', 'info', 'App\A::bar', 'Vague.', 'Rename.', 0.6),

        $text = (new GithubReporter(new Summary()))->render($report, false);
        self::assertStringContainsString("::error file=src/A.php,line=12,col=5,title=cohesion.method::Misplaced,%0Areally. Fix: Move it: now.\n", $text);
        self::assertStringContainsString("::notice file=src/A.php,line=13,col=1,title=naming.vague::Vague. Fix: Rename.\n", $text);

    {

    }

    public function testDataEscapesNewlinesAndPercentOnly(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('a:b,c%0D%0A%25', (new GithubReporter())->data("a:b,c\r\n%"));
