<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Http;

use CurlHandle;
use CurlMultiHandle;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;

/**
 * Sends requests over cURL, several at a time, so a lint run is bounded by the provider and not by one connection.
 */
final class CurlTransport implements Transport
{
    /**
     * Creates a transport that keeps at most a number of requests in flight and gives up on each after a timeout.
     */
    public function __construct(private int $concurrency = 8, private int $timeout = 60)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Sends every request, at most the configured number at a time, and returns the responses in request order.
     *
     * @param list<HttpRequest> $requests
     * @return list<HttpResponse>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails before a response arrives
     */
    public function send(array $requests): array
    {
        $responses = [];
        foreach (array_chunk($requests, max(1, $this->concurrency), true) as $chunk) {
            foreach ($this->sendChunk($chunk) as $index => $response) {
                $responses[$index] = $response;
            }
        }
        ksort($responses);

        return array_values($responses);
    }

    /**
     * Sends one group of requests concurrently and returns the responses keyed like the requests.
     *
     * @param array<int, HttpRequest> $requests
     * @return array<int, HttpResponse>
     * @throws LintException when a request fails before a response arrives
     */
    public function sendChunk(array $requests): array
    {
        $multi = curl_multi_init();
        $handles = [];
        foreach ($requests as $index => $request) {
            $handles[$index] = $this->handle($request);
            curl_multi_add_handle($multi, $handles[$index]);
        }
        $results = $this->drive($multi);
        $responses = [];
        foreach ($handles as $index => $handle) {
            $responses[$index] = $this->response($handle, $requests[$index], $results[spl_object_id($handle)] ?? CURLE_OK);
            curl_multi_remove_handle($multi, $handle);
        }
        curl_multi_close($multi);

        return $responses;
    }

    /**
     * Builds the cURL handle for one request.
     */
    public function handle(HttpRequest $request): CurlHandle
    {
        $handle = curl_init();
        $headers = [];
        foreach ($request->headers as $name => $value) {
            $headers[] = $name . ': ' . $value;
        }
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_URL, $request->url);
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST, $request->method);
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $request->body);
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $headers);
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_TIMEOUT, $this->timeout);
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT, min(10, $this->timeout));
        curl_setopt($handle, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, false);

        return $handle;
    }

    /**
     * Runs the multi handle until every transfer has finished and returns each transfer's cURL result code by handle object id.
     *
     * @return array<int, int>
     */
    public function drive(CurlMultiHandle $multi): array
    {
        $results = [];
        do {
            $status = curl_multi_exec($multi, $running);
            while (($message = curl_multi_info_read($multi)) !== false) {
                $results[spl_object_id($message['handle'])] = $message['result'];
            }
            if ($running > 0) {
                curl_multi_select($multi, 1.0);
            }
        } while ($running > 0 && $status === CURLM_OK);

        return $results;
    }

    /**
     * Reads the response of a finished handle.
     *
     * @param int $result the cURL result code of the transfer, CURLE_OK when it completed
     * @throws LintException when the transfer failed before a response arrived
     */
    public function response(CurlHandle $handle, HttpRequest $request, int $result): HttpResponse
    {
        $body = curl_multi_getcontent($handle);
        $status = curl_getinfo($handle, CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE);
        if ($result !== CURLE_OK || $body === null || $status === 0) {
            $reason = $result === CURLE_OK ? 'no response' : (curl_strerror($result) ?? 'cURL error ' . $result);
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not reach %s: %s. Check the network connection, provider.base_url and provider.timeout in decisions.yaml.', $request->url, $reason));
        }

        return new HttpResponse($status, $body);
    }
}

            new Question('p', Question::PREDICATE, 'P?'),
            new Question('c', Question::CHOICE, 'C?', ['a' => 'A', 'b' => 'B']),
            new Question('s', Question::SCORE, 'S?', [], ['low', 'mid', 'high']),

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Config;

/**

#[CoversClass(SchemaValidator::class)]
#[UsesClass(SchemaCatalog::class)]

final class SchemaValidatorTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testValidateAcceptsACompleteConfiguration(): void
    {
        (new SchemaValidator(new SchemaCatalog()))->validate([
            'version' => 1,
            'provider' => ['name' => 'jev', 'model' => 'jev-latest', 'api_key_env' => 'TYPESAFE_API_KEY', 'base_url' => 'https://api.typesafe.ai', 'timeout' => 30, 'concurrency' => 4],
            'paths' => ['src'],
            'exclude' => [],
            'fail_on' => 'warning',
            'imports' => ['rules/a.yaml'],
            'rules' => ['a.b' => ['severity' => 'info', 'decision' => ['threshold' => 0.9]]],
        ], SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS, 'decisions.yaml');
        self::assertTrue(true);
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerConfigurationProblems
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerConfigurationProblems')]
    public function testValidateNamesThePathTheProblemAndTheFix(array $document, string $expected): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage($expected);
        (new SchemaValidator())->validate($document, SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS, 'decisions.yaml');
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{array<string, mixed>, string}>
     */
    public static function providerConfigurationProblems(): iterable
    {
        yield 'missing version' => [[], 'decisions.yaml: the document is missing the key "version". Add it: the configuration format version; always 1.'];
        yield 'wrong version' => [['version' => 2], 'decisions.yaml: version must be 1. Set it to 1.'];
        yield 'unknown key' => [['version' => 1, 'pahts' => ['src']], 'decisions.yaml: the document has the unknown key "pahts". Remove it or rename it to one of: version, provider, paths, exclude, fail_on, imports, rules.'];
        yield 'enum' => [['version' => 1, 'provider' => ['name' => 'anthropic']], 'decisions.yaml: provider.name must be one of "jev", "openai", not "anthropic". Replace it with one of those values.'];
        yield 'type' => [['version' => 1, 'provider' => ['timeout' => 'fast']], 'decisions.yaml: provider.timeout must be an integer, not "fast". Change the value to an integer.'];
        yield 'minimum' => [['version' => 1, 'provider' => ['timeout' => 0]], 'decisions.yaml: provider.timeout must be at least 0, not 0'];
        yield 'maximum' => [['version' => 1, 'provider' => ['concurrency' => 65]], 'decisions.yaml: provider.concurrency must be at most 64, not 65. Lower the value.'];
        yield 'pattern' => [['version' => 1, 'provider' => ['api_key_env' => '1BAD']], 'decisions.yaml: provider.api_key_env must be the environment variable that holds the API key; never the key itself, not "1BAD". Change the value.'];
        yield 'min length' => [['version' => 1, 'paths' => ['']], 'decisions.yaml: paths[0] must not be empty. Write a value.'];
        yield 'min items' => [['version' => 1, 'paths' => []], 'decisions.yaml: paths must have at least 1 entry, not 0. Add entries.'];
        yield 'list expected' => [['version' => 1, 'paths' => 'src'], 'decisions.yaml: paths must be a list, not "src". Change the value to a list.'];
        yield 'rule id' => [['version' => 1, 'rules' => ['Bad Id' => []]], 'decisions.yaml: rules has the key "Bad Id", which is not a rule id made of lower-case letters, digits, dots and hyphens, such as cohesion.method-belongs-to-class. Rename the key.'];
        yield 'nested rule key' => [['version' => 1, 'rules' => ['a' => ['severty' => 'error']]], 'decisions.yaml: rules.a has the unknown key "severty". Remove it or rename it to one of: description, severity, enabled, paths, exclude, target, context, decision, violations.'];
        yield 'nested enum' => [['version' => 1, 'rules' => ['a' => ['decision' => ['type' => 'boolean']]]], 'decisions.yaml: rules.a.decision.type must be one of "predicate", "choice", "score", not "boolean".'];
        yield 'answer type' => [['version' => 1, 'rules' => ['a' => ['violations' => [['answer' => 1, 'message' => 'm', 'fix' => 'f']]]]], 'decisions.yaml: rules.a.violations[0].answer must be true or false or a string, not 1.'];
        yield 'levels count' => [['version' => 1, 'rules' => ['a' => ['decision' => ['levels' => ['only']]]]], 'decisions.yaml: rules.a.decision.levels must have at least 2 entries, not 1.'];
        yield 'mapping expected' => [['version' => 1, 'provider' => 'jev'], 'decisions.yaml: provider must be a mapping, not "jev". Change the value to a mapping.'];
    }

    public function testValidateRequiresTheRulePartsInARuleFile(): void
    {
        $validator = new SchemaValidator();
        $validator->validate(['version' => 1, 'rules' => ['a' => ['target' => ['kind' => 'method'], 'decision' => ['type' => 'predicate', 'instructions' => 'Q?'], 'violations' => [['answer' => false, 'message' => 'm', 'fix' => 'f']]]]], SchemaCatalog::RULES, 'rules/a.yaml');
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('rules/a.yaml: rules.a is missing the key "decision". Add it.');

    public function testCheckFollowsReferencesIntoAnotherSchemaFile(): void
    {
        $catalog = new SchemaCatalog();

        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('f: id must be a rule id made of lower-case letters');
        $validator->check('A', ['$ref' => 'rules.schema.json#/$defs/ruleId'], $catalog->schema(SchemaCatalog::DECISIONS), $catalog, 'f', 'id');

    public function testCheckScalarAcceptsAnyOfSeveralTypes(): void
    {
        $validator = new SchemaValidator();
        $validator->checkScalar(true, ['type' => ['boolean', 'string']], 'f', 'p');
        $validator->checkScalar('x', ['type' => ['boolean', 'string']], 'f', 'p');

        $this->expectExceptionMessage('f: p must be true or false or a string, not 1.5.');

    }

    public function testCheckBoundsAcceptsTheEdges(): void
    {
        $validator = new SchemaValidator();
        $validator->checkBounds(0, ['minimum' => 0, 'maximum' => 1], 'f', 'p');

        $validator->checkString('ab', ['minLength' => 3], 'f', 'p');
    }

    {

    }

    public function testCheckObjectLeavesFreeMappingsAlone(): void
    {
        $catalog = new SchemaCatalog();
        $validator = new SchemaValidator($catalog);
        $validator->checkObject(['anything' => 1], ['type' => 'object'], [], $catalog, 'f', 'p');
        $validator->checkObject(['known' => 1, 'extra' => 2], ['properties' => ['known' => ['type' => 'integer']]], [], $catalog, 'f', 'p');
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('f: p.extra must be a string, not 2.');
        $validator->checkObject(['extra' => 2], ['additionalProperties' => ['type' => 'string']], [], $catalog, 'f', 'p');
    }

    public function testCheckPropertyNameRephrasesTheFailureAroundTheKey(): void
    {
        $catalog = new SchemaCatalog();
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('f: rules has the key "x y", which is not a valid key. Rename the key.');
        (new SchemaValidator($catalog))->checkPropertyName('x y', ['pattern' => '^[a-z]+$'], [], $catalog, 'f', 'rules');
    }

    public function testCheckListReportsTooManyEntriesAndValidatesEach(): void
    {
        $catalog = new SchemaCatalog();
        $validator = new SchemaValidator($catalog);
        $validator->checkList(['a', 'b'], ['maxItems' => 2, 'items' => ['type' => 'string']], [], $catalog, 'f', 'p');
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('f: p must have at most 1 entries, not 2. Remove entries.');
        $validator->checkList(['a', 'b'], ['maxItems' => 1], [], $catalog, 'f', 'p');
    }

    public function testResolveRejectsADanglingReference(): void
    {
        $catalog = new SchemaCatalog();
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Schema reference "#/$defs/missing" points to nothing.');
        (new SchemaValidator($catalog))->resolve('#/$defs/missing', $catalog->schema(SchemaCatalog::RULES), $catalog);
    }

    /**
     * @dataProvider providerHasType
     */
    #[DataProvider('providerHasType')]
    public function testHasTypeMatchesJsonTypes(mixed $value, string $type, bool $expected): void
    {
        self::assertSame($expected, (new SchemaValidator())->hasType($value, [$type]));
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{mixed, string, bool}>
     */
    public static function providerHasType(): iterable
    {
        yield 'empty array is an object' => [[], 'object', true];
        yield 'empty array is a list' => [[], 'array', true];
        yield 'list is not an object' => [[1], 'object', false];
        yield 'mapping is not a list' => [['a' => 1], 'array', false];
        yield 'integer is a number' => [1, 'number', true];
        yield 'float is not an integer' => [1.5, 'integer', false];
        yield 'null' => [null, 'null', true];
        yield 'unknown type' => ['x', 'date', false];
    }

    public function testProblemFormatsTheMessage(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('f: the document is broken. Fix it.', (new SchemaValidator())->problem('f', '', 'is broken', 'Fix it.')->getMessage());
    }

    public function testDescribeQuotesStringsAndNamesShapes(): void
    {
        $validator = new SchemaValidator();
        self::assertSame('"x"', $validator->describe('x'));
        self::assertSame('an empty list', $validator->describe([]));
        self::assertSame('a list', $validator->describe([1]));
        self::assertSame('a mapping', $validator->describe(['a' => 1]));
        self::assertSame('true', $validator->describe(true));
    }

    public function testDescribeTypesJoinsReadableNames(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('a mapping or a list or a number or null', (new SchemaValidator())->describeTypes(['object', 'array', 'number', 'null']));
    }

    public function testTypesReadsOneOrSeveralTypes(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['string'], (new SchemaValidator())->types('string'));
        self::assertSame(['string', 'null'], (new SchemaValidator())->types(['string', 1, 'null']));
    }

    public function testObjectReturnsAMappingOrNothing(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['a' => 1], (new SchemaValidator())->object(['a' => 1]));
        self::assertSame([], (new SchemaValidator())->object('x'));
    }

    public function testListReturnsAListOrNothing(): void
    {
        self::assertSame([1, 2], (new SchemaValidator())->list(['a' => 1, 'b' => 2]));
        self::assertSame([], (new SchemaValidator())->list(null));
    }
}

    public function testResolveLaysLaterImportsAndTheProjectOverTheEarlierOnes(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-import-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root . '/rules', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents($root . '/rules/a.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  a.one:\n    severity: warning\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: predicate, instructions: 'Q?', threshold: 0.5}\n    violations: [{answer: false, message: m, fix: f}]\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/rules/b.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  a.one:\n    severity: info\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: predicate, instructions: 'Q?'}\n    violations: [{answer: false, message: m, fix: f}]\n  b.two:\n    target: {kind: file}\n    decision: {type: predicate, instructions: 'F?'}\n    violations: [{answer: true, message: m, fix: f}]\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nimports: [rules/a.yaml, rules/b.yaml]\nrules:\n  a.one:\n    decision: {threshold: 0.9}\n  c.three:\n    enabled: false\n");
        try {
            $document = (new ImportResolver(new DocumentLoader(), new DocumentMerger()))->resolve($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            $rules = $document['rules'];
            self::assertIsArray($rules);
            self::assertSame(['a.one', 'b.two', 'c.three'], array_keys($rules));
            self::assertSame('info', $rules['a.one']['severity']);
            self::assertSame(['type' => 'predicate', 'instructions' => 'Q?', 'threshold' => 0.9], $rules['a.one']['decision']);
            self::assertSame(['rules/a.yaml', 'rules/b.yaml', 'decisions.yaml'], $rules['a.one']['source']);
            self::assertSame(['rules/b.yaml'], $rules['b.two']['source']);
            self::assertSame(['enabled' => false, 'source' => ['decisions.yaml']], $rules['c.three']);
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/rules/a.yaml');
            unlink($root . '/rules/b.yaml');
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root . '/rules');
            rmdir($root);
        }

    public function testOverlayMergesByIdAndRecordsTheSources(): void
    {
        $rules = (new ImportResolver())->overlay(['a' => ['severity' => 'warning', 'source' => ['x.yaml']]], ['a' => ['severity' => 'error'], 'b' => ['enabled' => true]], 'y.yaml');
        self::assertSame(['severity' => 'error', 'source' => ['x.yaml', 'y.yaml']], $rules['a']);

    }

    public function testMappingReadsMappingsAndIgnoresOtherValues(): void
    {

    }

    public function testStringsKeepsOnlyStrings(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['a', 'b'], (new ImportResolver())->strings(['a', 1, 'b']));
        self::assertSame([], (new ImportResolver())->strings(null));
    }
}

final class RuleReaderTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testReadBuildsACompleteRuleWithDefaults(): void
    {
        $rule = (new RuleReader(new Template()))->read('a.b', [
            'source' => ['rules/a.yaml'],
            'target' => ['kind' => 'method', 'visibility' => ['public'], 'exclude_names' => ['__*'], 'static' => false],
            'decision' => ['type' => 'choice', 'instructions' => 'Classify {name}.', 'choices' => ['ok' => 'fine', 'leak' => 'bad'], 'threshold' => 0.6],
            'violations' => [['answer' => 'leak', 'message' => 'Leak in {name}.', 'fix' => 'Move it.']],
        ]);
        self::assertSame('a.b', $rule->id);
        self::assertSame('', $rule->description);
        self::assertSame('error', $rule->severity);
        self::assertTrue($rule->enabled);
        self::assertSame([], $rule->paths);
        self::assertSame('class', $rule->context);
        self::assertSame('method', $rule->target->kind);
        self::assertFalse($rule->target->static);
        self::assertSame(['ok' => 'fine', 'leak' => 'bad'], $rule->decision->choices);
        self::assertSame(0.6, $rule->decision->threshold);

#[UsesClass(ViolationMatcher::class)]
#[UsesClass(Target::class)]
final class LinterTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testLintTurnsViolatingAnswersIntoSortedFindings(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('cohesion', '', 'warning', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Fits?', [], [], 0.7), [new Violation(false, null, null, '{name} misplaced.', 'Move {name}.')]);
        $first = new Target('method', 'zed', 'B::zed', '', 'B', 'src/B.php', 3, 5, 'function zed()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $second = new Target('method', 'foo', 'A::foo', '', 'A', 'src/A.php', 9, 5, 'function foo()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $third = new Target('method', 'bar', 'A::bar', '', 'A', 'src/A.php', 2, 5, 'function bar()', 'public', [], 'D', 'C', 'F');
        $plan = new Plan(['src/A.php', 'src/B.php'], [
            new Inquiry([], [new Question('cohesion', 'predicate', 'Fits?')]),
            new Inquiry([], [new Question('cohesion', 'predicate', 'Fits?')]),
            new Inquiry([], [new Question('cohesion', 'predicate', 'Fits?')]),
        ], [new Assignment(0, $rule, $first), new Assignment(1, $rule, $second), new Assignment(2, $rule, $third)]);
        $decision = new class () implements Decision {
            public function decide(array $inquiries): array
            {
                return [
                    new Verdict('jev-1.13.0', ['cohesion' => Answer::predicate(0.1)]),
                    new Verdict('jev-1.13.0', ['cohesion' => Answer::predicate(0.95)]),
                    new Verdict('jev-1.14.0', ['cohesion' => Answer::predicate(0.2)]),
                ];
            }
        };
        $report = (new Linter(new ViolationMatcher()))->lint($plan, $decision, 'warning');
        self::assertSame(['src/A.php:2 bar misplaced.', 'src/B.php:3 zed misplaced.'], array_map(static fn (Finding $finding): string => $finding->path . ':' . $finding->line . ' ' . $finding->message, $report->findings));
        self::assertSame(2, $report->files);
        self::assertSame(3, $report->targets);
        self::assertSame(3, $report->requests);
        self::assertSame(['jev-1.13.0', 'jev-1.14.0'], $report->models);
        self::assertTrue($report->failed());
    }

    public function testLintAsksNothingForAnEmptyPlan(): void
    {
        $decision = new class () implements Decision {
            public function decide(array $inquiries): array
            {
                throw new LogicException('must not be called');
            }
        };
        $report = (new Linter())->lint(new Plan([], [], []), $decision, 'error');
        self::assertSame([], $report->findings);
        self::assertSame(0, $report->requests);
        self::assertFalse($report->failed());
    }

    public function testSortOrdersByPathLineColumnAndRule(): void
    {
        $findings = [
            new Finding('b.php', 1, 1, 'a', 'error', 's', 'm', 'f', 1.0),
            new Finding('a.php', 2, 1, 'b', 'error', 's', 'm', 'f', 1.0),
            new Finding('a.php', 2, 1, 'a', 'error', 's', 'm', 'f', 1.0),
            new Finding('a.php', 1, 9, 'a', 'error', 's', 'm', 'f', 1.0),
        ];
        self::assertSame(['a.php:1:9:a', 'a.php:2:1:a', 'a.php:2:1:b', 'b.php:1:1:a'], array_map(static fn (Finding $finding): string => $finding->path . ':' . $finding->line . ':' . $finding->column . ':' . $finding->rule, (new Linter())->sort($findings)));
    }
}

 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Cli\ClosureOutput
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 */

#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
final class ClosureOutputTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testGetErrorOutputIsTheOutputItselfWithoutASeparateSink(): void
    {
        $written = '';
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text) use (&$written): void {
            $written .= $text;
        });
        self::assertSame($output, $output->getErrorOutput());
        $output->getErrorOutput()->writeln('oops');
        self::assertSame("oops\n", $written);
    }

    public function testSetErrorOutputRedirectsErrors(): void
    {
        $errors = new BufferedOutput();
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text): void {
        });
        $output->setErrorOutput($errors);
        $output->getErrorOutput()->write('bad');
        self::assertSame('bad', $errors->fetch());
    }

    public function testSectionIsRefused(): void
    {
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        (new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text): void {
        }))->section();
    }

    public function testSetVerbosityPropagatesToTheErrorOutput(): void
    {
        $errors = new BufferedOutput();
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text): void {
        }, $errors);
        $output->setVerbosity(OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_QUIET);
        self::assertSame(OutputInterface::VERBOSITY_QUIET, $errors->getVerbosity());
    }

    public function testSetDecoratedPropagatesToTheErrorOutput(): void
    {
        $errors = new BufferedOutput();
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text): void {
        }, $errors);
        $output->setDecorated(true);
        self::assertTrue($errors->isDecorated());
    }

    public function testSetFormatterPropagatesToTheErrorOutput(): void
    {
        $errors = new BufferedOutput();
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text): void {
        }, $errors);
        $formatter = new OutputFormatter();
        $output->setFormatter($formatter);
        self::assertSame($formatter, $errors->getFormatter());
    }
}

    public function testRunLintsAProjectWithTheShippedRulesAgainstAFakeJev(): void
    {
        $project = new class ([
            'src/Analysis/Analyzer.php' => "<?php\nnamespace App\\Analysis;\n\nfinal class Analyzer\n{\n    public function analyze(string \$input): array\n    {\n        return [];\n    }\n\n    public function sendReport(string \$to): void\n    {\n    }\n}\n",
            'src/UseCase/PlaceOrder.php' => "<?php\nnamespace App\\UseCase;\n\nfinal class PlaceOrder\n{\n    public function handle(int \$total): bool\n    {\n        return \$total > 10000;\n    }\n}\n",
            'decisions.yaml' => "version: 1\nprovider:\n  name: jev\n  api_key_env: DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY\npaths: [src]\nimports:\n  - " . dirname(__DIR__, 2) . "/rules/cohesion.yaml\n  - " . dirname(__DIR__, 2) . "/rules/ddd.yaml\nrules:\n  cohesion.method-belongs-to-class: {severity: error}\n  cohesion.property-belongs-to-class: {enabled: false}\n",
        ]) {
            public string $root;
            /**
             * @param array<array-key, string> $files
             */
            public function __construct(array $files = [])
            {
                $this->root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-behavior-' . uniqid('', true);
                mkdir($this->root);
                foreach ($files as $path => $source) {
                    $this->write((string) $path, $source);
                }
            }
            public function write(string $path, string $source): void
            {
                $directory = dirname($this->root . '/' . $path);
                if (!is_dir($directory)) {
                    mkdir($directory, 0777, true);
                }
                file_put_contents($this->root . '/' . $path, $source);
            }
            public function remove(): void
            {
                foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($this->root, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS), RecursiveIteratorIterator::CHILD_FIRST) as $file) {
                    if ($file instanceof SplFileInfo) {
                        if ($file->isDir() && !$file->isLink()) {
                            rmdir($file->getPathname());
                        } else {
                            unlink($file->getPathname());
                        }
                    }
                }
                rmdir($this->root);
            }
        };
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            /** @var list<string> */
            public array $bodies = [];
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                $responses = [];
                foreach ($requests as $request) {
                    $this->bodies[] = $request->body;
                    $body = json_decode($request->body, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                    $answers = [];
                    foreach ($body['questions'] as $name => $question) {
                        $subject = $body['state']['name'];
                        if ($question['type'] === 'noul') {
                            $answers[$name] = ['type' => 'noul', 'noul' => str_contains($subject, 'sendReport') ? 0.05 : 0.97];
                        } else {
                            $choice = str_contains($subject, 'handle') ? 'domain_rule' : 'orchestration';
                            $answers[$name] = ['type' => 'choice', 'choice' => $choice, 'confidence' => 0.88, 'probabilities' => [$choice => 0.9, 'infrastructure' => 0.1]];
                        }
                    }
                    $responses[] = new HttpResponse(200, json_encode(['model' => 'jev-1.13.0', 'answers' => $answers, 'usage' => ['input_tokens' => 100, 'output_tokens' => 10]], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
                }

                return $responses;
            }
        };
        $before = getenv('DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY');
        $output = '';
        $app = new Application($project->root, static function (string $text) use (&$output): void {
            $output .= $text;
        }, $transport);
        try {
            putenv('DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY=secret');
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['validate']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('decisions.yaml is valid: 4 rules, 3 enabled, provider jev (jev-latest).', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['plan']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('src/Analysis/Analyzer.php:6:5 method App\Analysis\Analyzer::analyze (class) <- cohesion.method-belongs-to-class', $output);
            self::assertStringContainsString('src/UseCase/PlaceOrder.php:6:5 method App\UseCase\PlaceOrder::handle (class) <- cohesion.method-belongs-to-class, ddd.usecase-domain-leak', $output);
            self::assertStringContainsString('2 files, 3 targets, 3 requests, 4 questions. Nothing was sent.', $output);
            self::assertSame([], $transport->bodies);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(1, $app->run(['check', '--format=json']));
            $decoded = json_decode($output, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            self::assertSame(['src/Analysis/Analyzer.php:11 cohesion.method-belongs-to-class error', 'src/UseCase/PlaceOrder.php:6 ddd.usecase-domain-leak error'], array_map(static fn (array $finding): string => $finding['path'] . ':' . $finding['line'] . ' ' . $finding['rule'] . ' ' . $finding['severity'], $decoded['findings']));
            self::assertSame('Method sendReport() does not belong to Analyzer: it is not part of the responsibility the class name promises.', $decoded['findings'][0]['message']);
            self::assertSame('Move the rule into the entity, value object or domain service it describes, and have handle() call that method so the use case only orchestrates.', $decoded['findings'][1]['fix']);
            self::assertSame(3, $decoded['requests']);
            self::assertSame(['jev-1.13.0'], $decoded['models']);
            self::assertCount(3, $transport->bodies);
            self::assertStringContainsString('"class_source":"', $transport->bodies[0]);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['check', '--format=checkstyle', '--rule=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class', 'src/UseCase']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('<checkstyle version="decisions-lint">', $output);
            self::assertStringNotContainsString('<error', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(1, $app->run(['check', '--format=github', '--fail-on=warning']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('::error file=src/Analysis/Analyzer.php,line=11,col=5,title=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class::', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['rules', '--format=json']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('"count": 4', $output);
            $output = '';
            $project->write('decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  ghost: {severity: error}\n");
            self::assertSame(2, $app->run(['check']));
            self::assertStringStartsWith('Decisions error: Rule "ghost" (decisions.yaml) has no target.', $output);
        } finally {
            putenv($before === false ? 'DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY' : 'DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY=' . $before);
            $project->remove();
        }
    }

    public function testRunUsesOpenAiWhenConfiguredAndReportsProviderFailures(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-openai-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root . '/src', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/A.php', "<?php\nclass A {\n    public function f(): void {}\n}\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nprovider: {name: openai, api_key_env: DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY}\nrules:\n  r:\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: score, instructions: 'Rate {name}.', levels: [bad, ok, good]}\n    violations: [{max_score: 0.5, message: 'Bad {name} ({score}).', fix: 'Improve {name}.'}]\n");
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public int $calls = 0;
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                ++$this->calls;
                if ($this->calls === 1) {
                    return [new HttpResponse(200, '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","answers":[{"type":"score","name":"r","score":0.2,"confidence":0.9,"probabilities":[{"value":"0","label":"0","probability":0.8},{"value":"1","label":"1","probability":0.2}]}]}')];
                }

                return [new HttpResponse(429, '{"error":{"message":"Rate limit reached"}}')];
            }
        };
        $before = getenv('DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY');
        $output = '';
        $app = new Application($root, static function (string $text) use (&$output): void {
            $output .= $text;
        }, $transport);
        try {
            putenv('DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY=secret');
            self::assertSame(1, $app->run(['check', '--format=ai']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('error: src/A.php:3:5 [r] A::f confidence=0.90 Bad f (0.20). Fix: Improve f.', $output);
            self::assertStringContainsString('1 request to gpt-6-luna.', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(2, $app->run(['check']));
            self::assertSame("Decisions error: openai returned HTTP 429 for POST https://api.openai.com/v1/decisions: Rate limit reached. Lower provider.concurrency in decisions.yaml or retry later.\n", $output);
            putenv('DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY');
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(2, $app->run(['check']));
            self::assertStringStartsWith('Decisions error: The DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY environment variable is not set.', $output);
        } finally {
            putenv($before === false ? 'DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY' : 'DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY=' . $before);
            unlink($root . '/src/A.php');
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root . '/src');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }

    public function testRunInitialisesAProjectThatThenValidates(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-init-flow-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root . '/src', 0777, true);
        $output = '';
        $app = new Application($root, static function (string $text) use (&$output): void {
            $output .= $text;
        });
        try {
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['init']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('Wrote ' . $root . '/decisions.yaml.', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['validate']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('decisions.yaml is valid: 5 rules, 5 enabled, provider jev (jev-latest).', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['plan', '--format=json']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('"requests": []', $output);
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root . '/src');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }
}

            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['plan']));

':' . $finding['line'] . ' ' . $finding['rule'] . ' ' . $finding['severity'], $decoded['findings']));

            self::assertSame('Move the rule into the entity, value object or domain service it describes, and have handle() call that method so the use case only orchestrates.', $decoded['findings'][1]['fix']);
            self::assertSame(3, $decoded['requests']);
            self::assertSame(['jev-1.13.0'], $decoded['models']);
            self::assertCount(3, $transport->bodies);
            self::assertStringContainsString('"class_source":"', $transport->bodies[0]);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['check', '--format=checkstyle', '--rule=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class', 'src/UseCase']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('<checkstyle version="decisions-lint">', $output);
            self::assertStringNotContainsString('<error', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(1, $app->run(['check', '--format=github', '--fail-on=warning']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('::error file=src/Analysis/Analyzer.php,line=11,col=5,title=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class::', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['rules', '--format=json']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('"count": 4', $output);
            $output = '';
            $project->write('decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  ghost: {severity: error}\n");
            self::assertSame(2, $app->run(['check']));
            self::assertStringStartsWith('Decisions error: Rule "ghost" (decisions.yaml) has no target.', $output);
        } finally {
            putenv($before === false ? 'DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY' : 'DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY=' . $before);
            $project->remove();
        }

    public function testRunUsesOpenAiWhenConfiguredAndReportsProviderFailures(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-openai-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root . '/src', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/A.php', "<?php\nclass A {\n    public function f(): void {}\n}\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nprovider: {name: openai, api_key_env: DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY}\nrules:\n  r:\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: score, instructions: 'Rate {name}.', levels: [bad, ok, good]}\n    violations: [{max_score: 0.5, message: 'Bad {name} ({score}).', fix: 'Improve {name}.'}]\n");
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public int $calls = 0;
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                ++$this->calls;
                if ($this->calls === 1) {
                    return [new HttpResponse(200, '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","answers":[{"type":"score","name":"r","score":0.2,"confidence":0.9,"probabilities":[{"value":"0","label":"0","probability":0.8},{"value":"1","label":"1","probability":0.2}]}]}')];
                }

                return [new HttpResponse(429, '{"error":{"message":"Rate limit reached"}}')];
            }
        };
        $before = getenv('DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY');
        $output = '';
        $app = new Application($root, static function (string $text) use (&$output): void {
            $output .= $text;
        }, $transport);

        } finally {
            putenv($before === false ? 'DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY' : 'DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY=' . $before);
            unlink($root . '/src/A.php');
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root . '/src');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }

use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Formatter\OutputFormatter;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\BufferedOutput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Cli\ClosureOutput
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 */
#[CoversClass(ClosureOutput::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
final class ClosureOutputTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testGetErrorOutputIsTheOutputItselfWithoutASeparateSink(): void
    {
        $written = '';
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text) use (&$written): void {
            $written .= $text;
        });
        self::assertSame($output, $output->getErrorOutput());
        $output->getErrorOutput()->writeln('oops');
        self::assertSame("oops\n", $written);
    }

    public function testSetErrorOutputRedirectsErrors(): void
    {
        $errors = new BufferedOutput();
        $output = new ClosureOutput(static function (string $text): void {
        });

            {
                return [new HttpResponse(200, '{"model":"jev-1.13.0","answers":{"r":{"type":"noul","noul":0.0}}}')];

        };

            unlink($root . '/src/A.php');
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');

"/rules/cohesion.yaml\n  - " . dirname(__DIR__, 2) . "/rules/ddd.yaml\nrules:\n  cohesion.method-belongs-to-class: {severity: error}\n  cohesion.property-belongs-to-class: {enabled: false}\n",
        ]) {
            public string $root;
            /**
             * @param array<array-key, string> $files
             */
            public function __construct(array $files = [])
            {
                $this->root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-behavior-' . uniqid('', true);
                mkdir($this->root);
                foreach ($files as $path => $source) {
                    $this->write((string) $path, $source);
                }
            }
            public function write(string $path, string $source): void
            {
                $directory = dirname($this->root . '/' . $path);
                if (!is_dir($directory)) {
                    mkdir($directory, 0777, true);
                }
                file_put_contents($this->root . '/' . $path, $source);
            }
            public function remove(): void
            {
                foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator($this->root, FilesystemIterator::SKIP_DOTS), RecursiveIteratorIterator::CHILD_FIRST) as $file) {
                    if ($file instanceof SplFileInfo) {
                        if ($file->isDir() && !$file->isLink()) {
                            rmdir($file->getPathname());
                        } else {
                            unlink($file->getPathname());
                        }
                    }
                }
                rmdir($this->root);
            }
        };
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            /** @var list<string> */
            public array $bodies = [];
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                $responses = [];
                foreach ($requests as $request) {
                    $this->bodies[] = $request->body;
                    $body = json_decode($request->body, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                    $answers = [];
                    foreach ($body['questions'] as $name => $question) {
                        $subject = $body['state']['name'];
                        if ($question['type'] === 'noul') {
                            $answers[$name] = ['type' => 'noul', 'noul' => str_contains($subject, 'sendReport') ? 0.05 : 0.97];
                        } else {
                            $choice = str_contains($subject, 'handle') ? 'domain_rule' : 'orchestration';
                            $answers[$name] = ['type' => 'choice', 'choice' => $choice, 'confidence' => 0.88, 'probabilities' => [$choice => 0.9, 'infrastructure' => 0.1]];
                        }
                    }
                    $responses[] = new HttpResponse(200, json_encode(['model' => 'jev-1.13.0', 'answers' => $answers, 'usage' => ['input_tokens' => 100, 'output_tokens' => 10]], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
                }

                return $responses;
            }
        };
        $before = getenv('DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY');
        $output = '';
        $app = new Application($project->root, static function (string $text) use (&$output): void {
            $output .= $text;
        }, $transport);
        try {
            putenv('DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY=secret');
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['validate']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('decisions.yaml is valid: 4 rules, 3 enabled, provider jev (jev-latest).', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['plan']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('src/Analysis/Analyzer.php:6:5 method App\Analysis\Analyzer::analyze (class) <- cohesion.method-belongs-to-class', $output);
            self::assertStringContainsString('src/UseCase/PlaceOrder.php:6:5 method App\UseCase\PlaceOrder::handle (class) <- cohesion.method-belongs-to-class, ddd.usecase-domain-leak', $output);
            self::assertStringContainsString('2 files, 3 targets, 3 requests, 4 questions. Nothing was sent.', $output);
            self::assertSame([], $transport->bodies);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(1, $app->run(['check', '--format=json']));
            $decoded = json_decode($output, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            self::assertSame(['src/Analysis/Analyzer.php:11 cohesion.method-belongs-to-class error', 'src/UseCase/PlaceOrder.php:6 ddd.usecase-domain-leak error'], array_map(static fn (array $finding): string => $finding['path'] . ':' . $finding['line'] . ' ' . $finding['rule'] . ' ' . $finding['severity'], $decoded['findings']));
            self::assertSame('Method sendReport() does not belong to Analyzer: it is not part of the responsibility the class name promises.', $decoded['findings'][0]['message']);
            self::assertSame('Move the rule into the entity, value object or domain service it describes, and have handle() call that method so the use case only orchestrates.', $decoded['findings'][1]['fix']);
            self::assertSame(3, $decoded['requests']);
            self::assertSame(['jev-1.13.0'], $decoded['models']);
            self::assertCount(3, $transport->bodies);
            self::assertStringContainsString('"class_source":"', $transport->bodies[0]);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['check', '--format=checkstyle', '--rule=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class', 'src/UseCase']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('<checkstyle version="decisions-lint">', $output);
            self::assertStringNotContainsString('<error', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(1, $app->run(['check', '--format=github', '--fail-on=warning']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('::error file=src/Analysis/Analyzer.php,line=11,col=5,title=cohesion.method-belongs-to-class::', $output);
            $output = '';
            self::assertSame(0, $app->run(['rules', '--format=json']));
            self::assertStringContainsString('"count": 4', $output);
            $output = '';
            $project->write('decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  ghost: {severity: error}\n");
            self::assertSame(2, $app->run(['check']));
            self::assertStringStartsWith('Decisions error: Rule "ghost" (decisions.yaml) has no target.', $output);
        } finally {
            putenv($before === false ? 'DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY' : 'DECISIONS_BEHAVIOR_KEY=' . $before);
            $project->remove();
        }
    }

        file_put_contents($root . '/src/A.php', "<?php\nclass A {\n    public function f(): void {}\n}\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nprovider: {name: openai, api_key_env: DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY}\nrules:\n  r:\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: score, instructions: 'Rate {name}.', levels: [bad, ok, good]}\n    violations: [{max_score: 0.5, message: 'Bad {name} ({score}).', fix: 'Improve {name}.'}]\n");
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public int $calls = 0;
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                ++$this->calls;
                if ($this->calls === 1) {
                    return [new HttpResponse(200, '{"model":"gpt-6-luna","answers":[{"type":"score","name":"r","score":0.2,"confidence":0.9,"probabilities":[{"value":"0","label":"0","probability":0.8},{"value":"1","label":"1","probability":0.2}]}]}')];
                }

                return [new HttpResponse(429, '{"error":{"message":"Rate limit reached"}}')];
            }
        };
        $before = getenv('DECISIONS_OPENAI_KEY');
        $output = '';
        $app = new Application($root, static function (string $text) use (&$output): void {
            $output .= $text;

            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root . '/src');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Cli\Command;

use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\CheckCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\LintCommand;
use DecisionsLint\Cli\FormatDetector;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Http\Transport;
use DecisionsLint\Reporting\ReporterFactory;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Completion\CompletionInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Completion\CompletionSuggestions;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArrayInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\BufferedOutput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Tester\CommandTester;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\LintCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\CheckCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\FormatDetector
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 */
#[CoversClass(LintCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(CheckCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(FormatDetector::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
final class LintCommandTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testRunReportsACommandLineItCannotRead(): void
    {
        $tester = new CommandTester(new CheckCommand('/project'));
        self::assertSame(LintCommand::INVALID, $tester->execute(['--nope' => true]));
        self::assertStringContainsString('Decisions error: The "--nope" option does not exist.', $tester->getDisplay());
        self::assertStringContainsString('Run "decisions-lint check --help" to see its options.', $tester->getDisplay());
    }

    public function testCompleteSuggestsTheFormats(): void
    {
        $command = new CheckCommand('/project');
        $suggestions = new CompletionSuggestions();
        $command->complete(CompletionInput::fromTokens(['check', '--format', ''], 2), $suggestions);
        self::assertSame(ReporterFactory::FORMATS, array_map('strval', $suggestions->getValueSuggestions()));
    }

    public function testDirectoryReturnsTheProjectDirectory(): void
    {
        self::assertSame('/project', (new CheckCommand('/project'))->directory());
    }

    public function testTransportReturnsTheInjectedTransportOrNull(): void
    {
        self::assertNull((new CheckCommand('/project'))->transport());
        $transport = new class () implements Transport {
            public function send(array $requests): array
            {
                return [];
            }
        };
        self::assertSame($transport, (new CheckCommand('/project', $transport))->transport());
    }

    public function testConfigPathResolvesRelativeToTheDirectory(): void
    {
        $command = new CheckCommand('/project');
        $command->mergeApplicationDefinition();
        $input = new ArrayInput(['--config' => 'team.yaml'], $command->getDefinition());
        self::assertSame('/project/team.yaml', $command->configPath($input));
        self::assertSame('/abs/decisions.yaml', $command->configPath(new ArrayInput(['--config' => '/abs/decisions.yaml'], $command->getDefinition())));
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Provide a non-empty --config path');
        $command->configPath(new ArrayInput(['--config' => ''], $command->getDefinition()));
    }

    public function testFormatValidatesAgainstTheAllowedFormats(): void
    {
        $command = new CheckCommand('/project');
        self::assertSame('json', $command->format(new ArrayInput(['--format' => 'json'], $command->getDefinition()), ['text', 'json']));
        self::assertContains($command->format(new ArrayInput([], $command->getDefinition()), ['text', 'ai']), ['text', 'ai']);
        self::assertSame('text', $command->format(new ArrayInput([], $command->getDefinition()), ['text']));
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Unsupported --format "yaml". Use --format=text, json.');
        $command->format(new ArrayInput(['--format' => 'yaml'], $command->getDefinition()), ['text', 'json']);
    }

    public function testRuleIdsReadsTheRepeatableOption(): void
    {
        $command = new CheckCommand('/project');
        self::assertSame(['a.b', 'c'], $command->ruleIds(new ArrayInput(['--rule' => ['a.b', ' c ']], $command->getDefinition())));
        self::assertSame([], $command->ruleIds(new ArrayInput([], $command->getDefinition())));
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Provide a rule id for --rule');
        $command->ruleIds(new ArrayInput(['--rule' => ['']], $command->getDefinition()));
    }

    public function testPathsReadsTheArguments(): void
    {
        $command = new CheckCommand('/project');
        self::assertSame(['src/A.php', 'tests'], $command->paths(new ArrayInput(['paths' => ['src/A.php', ' tests ', '']], $command->getDefinition())));
        self::assertSame([], $command->paths(new ArrayInput([], $command->getDefinition())));
    }

    public function testErrorWritesToStandardErrorEvenWhenQuiet(): void
    {
        $output = new BufferedOutput(BufferedOutput::VERBOSITY_QUIET);
        (new CheckCommand('/project'))->error($output, 'Broken.', 'Try again.');
        self::assertSame("Decisions error: Broken.\nTry again.\n", $output->fetch());
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Config;

use DecisionsLint\Config\DocumentLoader;
use DecisionsLint\Config\DocumentMerger;
use DecisionsLint\Config\ImportResolver;
use DecisionsLint\Config\SchemaCatalog;
use DecisionsLint\Config\SchemaValidator;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Config\ImportResolver
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Config\DocumentLoader
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Config\DocumentMerger
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Config\SchemaCatalog
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Config\SchemaValidator
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException
 */
#[CoversClass(ImportResolver::class)]
#[UsesClass(DocumentLoader::class)]
#[UsesClass(DocumentMerger::class)]
#[UsesClass(SchemaCatalog::class)]
#[UsesClass(SchemaValidator::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
final class ImportResolverTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testResolveLaysLaterImportsAndTheProjectOverTheEarlierOnes(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-import-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root . '/rules', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents($root . '/rules/a.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  a.one:\n    severity: warning\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: predicate, instructions: 'Q?', threshold: 0.5}\n    violations: [{answer: false, message: m, fix: f}]\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/rules/b.yaml', "version: 1\nrules:\n  a.one:\n    severity: info\n    target: {kind: method}\n    decision: {type: predicate, instructions: 'Q?'}\n    violations: [{answer: false, message: m, fix: f}]\n  b.two:\n    target: {kind: file}\n    decision: {type: predicate, instructions: 'F?'}\n    violations: [{answer: true, message: m, fix: f}]\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nimports: [rules/a.yaml, rules/b.yaml]\nrules:\n  a.one:\n    decision: {threshold: 0.9}\n  c.three:\n    enabled: false\n");
        try {
            $document = (new ImportResolver(new DocumentLoader(), new DocumentMerger()))->resolve($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            $rules = $document['rules'];
            self::assertIsArray($rules);
            self::assertSame(['a.one', 'b.two', 'c.three'], array_keys($rules));
            self::assertSame('info', $rules['a.one']['severity']);
            self::assertSame(['type' => 'predicate', 'instructions' => 'Q?', 'threshold' => 0.9], $rules['a.one']['decision']);
            self::assertSame(['rules/a.yaml', 'rules/b.yaml', 'decisions.yaml'], $rules['a.one']['source']);
            self::assertSame(['rules/b.yaml'], $rules['b.two']['source']);
            self::assertSame(['enabled' => false, 'source' => ['decisions.yaml']], $rules['c.three']);
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/rules/a.yaml');
            unlink($root . '/rules/b.yaml');
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root . '/rules');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }

    public function testResolveRejectsAMissingImport(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-import-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root);
        file_put_contents($root . '/decisions.yaml', "version: 1\nimports: [rules/missing.yaml]\n");
        try {
            $this->expectException(LintException::class);
            $this->expectExceptionMessage('Rule file not found: ' . $root . '/rules/missing.yaml. Check that the path is relative to the file that imports it.');
            (new ImportResolver())->resolve($root . '/decisions.yaml');
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/decisions.yaml');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }

    public function testOverlayMergesByIdAndRecordsTheSources(): void
    {
        $rules = (new ImportResolver())->overlay(['a' => ['severity' => 'warning', 'source' => ['x.yaml']]], ['a' => ['severity' => 'error'], 'b' => ['enabled' => true]], 'y.yaml');
        self::assertSame(['severity' => 'error', 'source' => ['x.yaml', 'y.yaml']], $rules['a']);
        self::assertSame(['source' => ['y.yaml'], 'enabled' => true], $rules['b']);
    }

    public function testMappingReadsMappingsAndIgnoresOtherValues(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['a' => 1], (new ImportResolver())->mapping(['a' => 1]));
        self::assertSame([], (new ImportResolver())->mapping('x'));
    }

    public function testStringsKeepsOnlyStrings(): void
    {
        self::assertSame(['a', 'b'], (new ImportResolver())->strings(['a', 1, 'b']));
        self::assertSame([], (new ImportResolver())->strings(null));
    }
}

use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\CoversClass;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\UsesClass;

use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\ArrayInput;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\BufferedOutput;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Cli\DecisionsConsole
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\CheckCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\InitCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\LintCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\PlanCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\RulesCommand
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Cli\Command\ValidateCommand
 */
#[CoversClass(DecisionsConsole::class)]
#[UsesClass(CheckCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(InitCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(PlanCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(RulesCommand::class)]
#[UsesClass(ValidateCommand::class)]
final class DecisionsConsoleTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testGetHelpExplainsTheDefaultCommand(): void
    {
        $console = new DecisionsConsole('/project');
        self::assertStringContainsString('Running decisions-lint without a command runs check.', $console->getHelp());
        self::assertSame('decisions-lint', $console->getName());
        self::assertSame(DecisionsConsole::VERSION, $console->getVersion());
        self::assertTrue($console->has('check'));
        self::assertTrue($console->has('plan'));
        self::assertTrue($console->has('rules'));
        self::assertTrue($console->has('validate'));
        self::assertTrue($console->has('init'));
    }

    public function testDoRunListsCommandsForBareHelpAndRejectsUnknownCommands(): void
    {
        $console = new DecisionsConsole('/project');
        $output = new BufferedOutput();
        self::assertSame(0, $console->doRun(new ArrayInput(['--help' => true]), $output));
        self::assertStringContainsString('Available commands:', $output->fetch());
        self::assertSame(LintCommand::INVALID, $console->doRun(new ArrayInput(['command' => 'chekc']), $output));
        self::assertSame("Decisions error: Command \"chekc\" is not defined. Did you mean check?\nRun \"decisions-lint list\" to see the available commands.\n", $output->fetch());
        self::assertSame(0, $console->doRun(new ArrayInput(['command' => 'li']), $output));
        self::assertStringContainsString('Available commands:', $output->fetch());
    }

    public function testUnknownCommandExplainsAmbiguityAndSuggestsNames(): void
    {
        $console = new DecisionsConsole('/project');
        self::assertNull($console->unknownCommand('check'));
        self::assertNull($console->unknownCommand('val'));
        self::assertSame('Command "zzzzzz" is not defined.', $console->unknownCommand('zzzzzz'));
        self::assertSame('Command "rule" is not defined. Did you mean rules?', $console->unknownCommand('rule'));
    }

    public function testRestoreShellVerbosityPutsTheEnvironmentBack(): void
    {
        $before = getenv('SHELL_VERBOSITY');
        try {
            putenv('SHELL_VERBOSITY=3');
            (new DecisionsConsole('/project'))->restoreShellVerbosity(false, null, null);
            self::assertFalse(getenv('SHELL_VERBOSITY'));
            self::assertArrayNotHasKey('SHELL_VERBOSITY', $_ENV);
            (new DecisionsConsole('/project'))->restoreShellVerbosity('1', '1', '1');
            self::assertSame('1', getenv('SHELL_VERBOSITY'));
            self::assertSame('1', $_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY']);
            self::assertSame('1', $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY']);
        } finally {
            unset($_ENV['SHELL_VERBOSITY'], $_SERVER['SHELL_VERBOSITY']);
            putenv($before === false ? 'SHELL_VERBOSITY' : 'SHELL_VERBOSITY=' . $before);
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Lint;

use DecisionsLint\Config\Configuration;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\QuestionBuilder;
use DecisionsLint\Rule\Rule;
use DecisionsLint\Source\FileFinder;
use DecisionsLint\Source\GlobMatcher;
use DecisionsLint\Source\Target;
use DecisionsLint\Source\TargetExtractor;

/**
 * Works out which rules apply to which declarations and groups the questions per target.
 *
 * Every rule that judges the same declaration with the same context shares one
 * inquiry, so the model reads the source once and answers every question in
 * one request.
 */
final class Planner
{
    /**
     * Creates a planner, optionally with shared collaborators.
     */
    public function __construct(private ?TargetExtractor $extractor = null, private ?QuestionBuilder $questions = null, private ?GlobMatcher $matcher = null)
    {
    }

    /**
     * Plans a run over the configured paths, or over the given paths, with the enabled rules, or the given rule ids.
     *
     * @param list<string> $paths
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds
     * @throws LintException when a path does not exist, a file cannot be read, or a rule id is unknown
     */
    public function plan(Configuration $configuration, array $paths = [], array $ruleIds = []): Plan
    {
        $rules = $this->rules($configuration, $ruleIds);
        $files = (new FileFinder($configuration->directory, $this->matcher))->find($paths === [] ? $configuration->paths : $paths, $configuration->exclude);
        $groups = [];
        foreach ($files as $file) {
            foreach ($this->candidates($file, $configuration->directory, $this->applicable($rules, $file)) as $candidate) {
                $key = $candidate['target']->file . '|' . $candidate['target']->qualifiedName . '|' . $candidate['target']->line . '|' . $candidate['target']->kind . '|' . $candidate['rule']->context;
                $groups[$key] ??= ['target' => $candidate['target'], 'context' => $candidate['rule']->context, 'rules' => []];
                $groups[$key]['rules'][] = $candidate['rule'];
            }
        }
        $builder = $this->questions ?? new QuestionBuilder();
        $inquiries = [];
        $assignments = [];
        foreach (array_values($groups) as $index => $group) {
            $inquiries[] = $builder->inquiry($group['target'], $group['context'], $group['rules']);
            foreach ($group['rules'] as $rule) {
                $assignments[] = new Assignment($index, $rule, $group['target']);
            }
        }

        return new Plan($files, $inquiries, $assignments);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rules to run, rejecting an id the configuration does not define.
     *
     * @param list<string> $ruleIds
     * @return list<Rule>
     * @throws LintException when a requested id matches no rule
     */
    public function rules(Configuration $configuration, array $ruleIds): array
    {
        $known = array_map(static fn (Rule $rule): string => $rule->id, $configuration->rules);
        foreach ($ruleIds as $id) {
            if (!in_array($id, $known, true)) {
                throw new LintException(sprintf('Unknown rule "%s". Use one of the configured rule ids: %s.', $id, $known === [] ? '(none)' : implode(', ', $known)));
            }
        }

        return $configuration->activeRules($ruleIds);
    }

    /**
     * Returns the rules whose path globs select a file.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     * @return list<Rule>
     */
    public function applicable(array $rules, string $file): array
    {
        $matcher = $this->matcher ?? new GlobMatcher();
        $applicable = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if (($rule->paths === [] || $matcher->matchesAny($rule->paths, $file)) && !$matcher->matchesAny($rule->exclude, $file)) {
                $applicable[] = $rule;
            }
        }

        return $applicable;
    }

    /**
     * Returns every rule-and-target pair of one file.
     *
     * @param list<Rule> $rules
     * @return list<array{rule: Rule, target: Target}>
     * @throws LintException when the file cannot be read
     */
    public function candidates(string $file, string $directory, array $rules): array
    {
        if ($rules === []) {
            return [];
        }
        $code = file_get_contents($directory . '/' . $file);
        if ($code === false) {
            throw new LintException(sprintf('Could not read %s. Check the file permissions.', $directory . '/' . $file));
        }
        $extractor = $this->extractor ?? new TargetExtractor();
        $declarations = null;
        $candidates = [];
        foreach ($rules as $rule) {
            if ($rule->target->kind === Target::FILE) {
                $candidates[] = ['rule' => $rule, 'target' => $extractor->file($file, $code)];
                continue;
            }
            if (!str_ends_with(strtolower($file), '.php')) {
                continue;
            }
            $declarations ??= $extractor->extract($file, $code);
            foreach ($declarations as $target) {
                if ($rule->target->selects($target)) {
                    $candidates[] = ['rule' => $rule, 'target' => $target];
                }
            }
        }

        return $candidates;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Unit\Lint;

use DecisionsLint\Config\Configuration;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Inquiry;
use DecisionsLint\Decision\Question;
use DecisionsLint\Diagnostic\LintException;
use DecisionsLint\Lint\Assignment;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

/**
 * @covers \DecisionsLint\Lint\Planner
 * @uses \DecisionsLint\Config\Configuration

#[CoversClass(Planner::class)]
#[UsesClass(Configuration::class)]
#[UsesClass(Inquiry::class)]
#[UsesClass(Question::class)]
#[UsesClass(LintException::class)]
#[UsesClass(Assignment::class)]

#[UsesClass(ProviderSettings::class)]

#[UsesClass(Template::class)]
#[UsesClass(Declaration::class)]
#[UsesClass(DeclarationScanner::class)]
#[UsesClass(FileFinder::class)]
#[UsesClass(GlobMatcher::class)]
#[UsesClass(Target::class)]
#[UsesClass(TargetExtractor::class)]
#[UsesClass(Tokens::class)]
final class PlannerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testPlanGroupsRulesPerTargetAndContext(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-planner-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root . '/src/UseCase', 0777, true);
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/Analyzer.php', "<?php\nnamespace App;\nclass Analyzer {\n    public function analyze(): void {}\n    private function helper(): void {}\n}\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/UseCase/Order.php', "<?php\nnamespace App\\UseCase;\nclass Order {\n    public function handle(): void {}\n}\n");
        file_put_contents($root . '/src/notes.md', '# notes');
        $methods = new Rule('cohesion', '', 'warning', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method', ['public']), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Fits {class}?'), []);
        $naming = new Rule('naming', '', 'info', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('score', 'Rate.', [], ['a', 'b']), []);
        $usecase = new Rule('ddd', '', 'error', true, ['src/UseCase/**'], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'declaration', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Leak?'), []);
        $files = new Rule('docs', '', 'info', true, ['src/*.md'], [], new TargetSelector('file'), 'file', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Readable?'), []);
        $disabled = new Rule('off', '', 'info', false, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'X?'), []);
        $configuration = new Configuration($root . '/decisions.yaml', ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), ['src'], [], 'error', [$methods, $naming, $usecase, $files, $disabled]);
        try {
            $plan = (new Planner(new TargetExtractor(), new QuestionBuilder(), new GlobMatcher()))->plan($configuration);
            self::assertSame(['src/Analyzer.php', 'src/UseCase/Order.php', 'src/notes.md'], $plan->files);
            self::assertCount(5, $plan->inquiries);
            self::assertSame(['cohesion', 'naming'], array_map(static fn (Question $question): string => $question->name, $plan->inquiries[0]->questions));
            self::assertSame(['naming'], array_map(static fn (Question $question): string => $question->name, $plan->inquiries[1]->questions));
            self::assertSame(['ddd'], array_map(static fn (Question $question): string => $question->name, $plan->inquiries[3]->questions));
            self::assertSame(['docs'], array_map(static fn (Question $question): string => $question->name, $plan->inquiries[4]->questions));
            self::assertSame('Fits Analyzer?', $plan->inquiries[0]->questions[0]->instructions);
            self::assertSame(7, count($plan->assignments));
            self::assertSame(4, $plan->targets());
            self::assertCount(1, (new Planner())->plan($configuration, ['src/notes.md'])->inquiries);
            self::assertSame(['ddd'], array_map(static fn (Assignment $assignment): string => $assignment->rule->id, (new Planner())->plan($configuration, [], ['ddd'])->assignments));
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/src/Analyzer.php');
            unlink($root . '/src/UseCase/Order.php');
            unlink($root . '/src/notes.md');
            rmdir($root . '/src/UseCase');
            rmdir($root . '/src');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }

    public function testRulesRejectsAnUnknownId(): void
    {
        $rule = new Rule('known', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?'), []);
        $configuration = new Configuration('/p/decisions.yaml', ProviderSettings::defaults('jev'), ['src'], [], 'error', [$rule]);
        self::assertSame([$rule], (new Planner())->rules($configuration, ['known']));
        $this->expectException(LintException::class);
        $this->expectExceptionMessage('Unknown rule "typo". Use one of the configured rule ids: known.');
        (new Planner())->rules($configuration, ['typo']);
    }

    public function testApplicableKeepsRulesWhosePathsSelectTheFile(): void
    {
        $everywhere = new Rule('a', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?'), []);
        $scoped = new Rule('b', '', 'error', true, ['src/UseCase/**'], ['src/UseCase/Legacy/**'], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?'), []);
        $planner = new Planner();
        self::assertSame([$everywhere], $planner->applicable([$everywhere, $scoped], 'src/A.php'));
        self::assertSame([$everywhere, $scoped], $planner->applicable([$everywhere, $scoped], 'src/UseCase/B.php'));
        self::assertSame([$everywhere], $planner->applicable([$everywhere, $scoped], 'src/UseCase/Legacy/C.php'));
    }

    public function testCandidatesSkipsNonPhpFilesForDeclarationRulesAndRejectsUnreadableFiles(): void
    {
        $root = sys_get_temp_dir() . '/decisions-candidates-' . uniqid();
        mkdir($root);
        file_put_contents($root . '/notes.md', '# notes');
        $method = new Rule('a', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('method'), 'class', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?'), []);
        $file = new Rule('b', '', 'error', true, [], [], new TargetSelector('file'), 'file', new DecisionSpec('predicate', 'Q?'), []);
        try {
            $planner = new Planner();
            self::assertSame([], $planner->candidates('notes.md', $root, []));
            $candidates = $planner->candidates('notes.md', $root, [$method, $file]);
            self::assertCount(1, $candidates);
            self::assertSame('b', $candidates[0]['rule']->id);
            self::assertSame('file', $candidates[0]['target']->kind);
            $this->expectException(LintException::class);
            $this->expectExceptionMessage('Could not read ' . $root . '/missing.php. Check the file permissions.');
            @$planner->candidates('missing.php', $root, [$file]);
        } finally {
            unlink($root . '/notes.md');
            rmdir($root);
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace DecisionsLint\Decision;

/**
 * The typed answer a decision model gave to one question.
 *
 * A predicate carries a probability that the statement holds. A choice carries
 * the chosen option, the probability of every option and a confidence. A score
 * carries the probability-weighted level, the probability of every level and a
 * confidence. A refusal carries nothing but the fact that the model declined.
 *
 * @property-read string $type predicate, choice, score or refusal
 * @property-read float $probability the probability that a predicate holds, from 0 to 1
 * @property-read string $choice the chosen option of a choice, or an empty string
 * @property-read float $score the weighted level of a score, from 0 to the number of levels minus one
 * @property-read float $confidence how peaked the distribution is, from 0 to 1
 * @property-read array<string, float> $probabilities the probability of every option or level
 */
final class Answer
{
    /**
     * The type of an answer the model declined to give.
     */
    public const REFUSAL = 'refusal';

    /**
     * Creates the immutable value.
     *
     * @param array<string, float> $probabilities
     */
    public function __construct(
        /** @readonly */
        private string $type,
        /** @readonly */
        private float $probability = 0.0,
        /** @readonly */
        private string $choice = '',
        /** @readonly */
        private float $score = 0.0,
        /** @readonly */
        private float $confidence = 0.0,
        /** @readonly */
        private array $probabilities = [],
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Creates the answer to a predicate from the probability that it holds.
     */
    public static function predicate(float $probability): self
    {
        return new self(Question::PREDICATE, $probability, '', 0.0, max($probability, 1.0 - $probability), ['true' => $probability, 'false' => 1.0 - $probability]);
    }

    /**
     * Creates the answer to a choice from the chosen option and the distribution.
     *
     * @param array<string, float> $probabilities
     */
    public static function choice(string $choice, float $confidence, array $probabilities): self
    {
        return new self(Question::CHOICE, 0.0, $choice, 0.0, $confidence, $probabilities);
    }

    /**
     * Creates the answer to a score from the weighted level and the distribution.
     *
     * @param array<string, float> $probabilities
     */
    public static function score(float $score, float $confidence, array $probabilities): self
    {
        return new self(Question::SCORE, 0.0, '', $score, $confidence, $probabilities);
    }

    /**
     * Creates the answer of a model that declined to judge the subject.
     */
    public static function refusal(): self
    {
        return new self(self::REFUSAL);
    }

    /**
     * Returns a declared immutable property.
     *
     * @return mixed
     */
    public function __get(string $name): mixed
    {
        return match ($name) {
            'type' => $this->type,
            'probability' => $this->probability,
            'choice' => $this->choice,
            'score' => $this->score,
            'confidence' => $this->confidence,
            'probabilities' => $this->probabilities,
            default => null,
        };
    }
}
